title: Creating the Next Generation of AI Bots Powered by Amazon Bedrock with Enterprise Bot

To address these needs, the company evaluated new providers and ultimately chose AWS to support its technical and business goals. Enterprise Bot migrated its AI workloads to AWS and adopted Amazon Bedrock, a fully managed service for building generative AI applications with security, privacy, and responsible AI. In fewer than 5 months, the company put the new system into production. Enterprise Bot received technology support and market insights throughout the process. “From the start, the collaboration with the AWS team was open and the support loop quick. It’s been an amazing relationship,” says Jain.

title: AWS EMEA Narrative Case Study
summary: Motability Operations provides vehicles to over 700,000 disabled people in the United Kingdom through the Motability Scheme. Unexpected vehicle breakdown is always inconvenient, but for Motability Operations’ customers, it can be significantly more challenging. So, the company used Amazon Web Services (AWS) and collaborated with AWS Professional Services—a global team of experts—to deliver a 6-month pilot for predictive maintenance. Enhancing Customer Experience with Connected Vehicle Data To qualify for the Motability Scheme, a customer must receive an eligible mobility allowance. Since 1978, every vehicle lease has breakdown and maintenance included. Using its connected vehicle data, Motability Operations wanted to run a pilot for predictive vehicle maintenance using artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services on AWS to enhance the accuracy of its predictions. It recognized that preventing unplanned events, such as vehicle breakdowns, could greatly secure and simplify its customers’ driving experience. Motability Operations worked closely alongside AWS Professional Services to establish an initial proof of concept for its pilot program as it built its technical team. Motability Operations chose to use a variety of AWS serverless and managed services for flexibility, scalability, and cost-efficiency. “Using AWS services was the right decision,” says Vijay Srinivasan, principal architect at Motability Operations. “Not worrying about the complexity of infrastructure and complicated security management, we could focus on building architecture that would deliver business value quickly.” Motability Operations spent 6 months collecting and training data for its solution’s foundational ML models. title: Com IA AWS, Nextios desenvolve Professor Digital para a Positivo Tecnologia
summary: A Positivo Tecnologia, empresa brasileira fundada em 1989, destaca-se no setor educacional desenvolvendo soluções tecnológicas. Através do Educacional – Ecossistema de Tecnologia e Inovação, a Positivo oferece plataformas de aprendizagem, conteúdos interativos e ferramentas de gestão escolar. Um marco significativo foi a integração do assistente de IA generativa, Maria, na plataforma Aprimora em 2023, aprimorando o suporte aos alunos. Em parceria com a Nextios e a AWS, a Positivo lançou o projeto Professor Digital, um assistente de IA generativa para apoiar professores, alunos e gestores com tarefas diversas, como resumos de aulas e elaboração de provas, integrado ao Hub Educacional. O projeto foi apresentado com sucesso na Bett Educar 2024, destacando uma arquitetura inovadora baseada em serviços AWS, como Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, e Amazon Transcribe. A solução utiliza uma técnica chamada prompt chain, proporcionando respostas rápidas e eficazes, criando uma experiência fluida para os usuários. A evolução do Professor Digital inclui a integração com edtechs e a capacidade de gerar conteúdos automaticamente. A Positivo continua a explorar novas funcionalidades e a melhorar a ferramenta, visando implementar soluções educacionais mais inteligentes e eficientes. O objetivo futuro é "produtizar" o Professor Digital, tornando-o amplamente disponível para escolas, e continuar a agregar valor através da IA generativa, facilitando a gestão educacional e melhorando a experiência de aprendizado.

No entanto, a empresa precisava ter bases financeiras para justificar o uso de ferramentas tecnológicas, e isso só poderia ser alcançado pelo monitoramento em tempo real das necessidades e das potenciais soluções tecnológicas para medir a eficiência de custo. Dessa maneira, com a implementação do FinOps e dos serviços da AWS, com os quais já trabalhava há muitos anos, obtiveram uma otimização de 90% do investimento em infraestrutura. A empresa, que atualmente processa 25 milhões de pedidos por mês, adquiriu flexibilidade para executar mais de 10 mil instâncias spot do Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) em horários de pico.

O banco tem a missão de se tornar cada vez mais digital, em uma estratégia que envolve mudanças na forma com que seus times trabalham, a modernização de suas tecnologias e uma transformação em sua cultura, com foco em fortalecer a centralidade no cliente e o uso de dados em escala para o desenvolvimento de soluções. Neste vídeo, Moisés Nascimento, chief data officer do Itaú Unibanco, e Roberto Figueira, superintendente de engenharia e plataforma de dados da instituição, contam como o banco reestruturou sua estratégia de dados e implementou a arquitetura data mesh para que eles pudessem ser distribuídos pelas comunidades que desenvolvem seus produtos. Moisés afirma que esses dados foram disponibilizados através da nova arquitetura e, em menos de seis meses, centenas de usuários já estavam criando contas dentro do data mesh.

Using storage, compute, and database solutions on AWS helped Expedia Group enhance travelers’ booking experiences, speed up vendor payment transactions from 1 day to seconds, save millions of dollars, and scale to handle hundreds of million website visits each month.

title: Dallara Uses HPC on AWS to Off-Load Peak CFD Workloads for Race Car Simulations
summary: Italian race car manufacturer Dallara built a computing engine for simulations in less than 5 months using HPC on AWS, tripling the compute capacity it had on premises and meeting customer demand.

title: Amazon Ads Uses AWS for Real-Time Machine Learning in Ad Serving
summary: Hear from Kun Liu, director of machine learning at Amazon Ads, on how the company uses AWS solutions, such as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), to scale machine learning inferencing systems for real-time ad selection.

title: Air Canada Builds Revamped Loyalty Program and Improves Customer Experience Using AWS
summary: In this video, Mel Crocker, vice president and chief information officer at Air Canada, shares how the company revamped its Aeroplan loyalty platform on AWS to be serverless, event-driven, and help the company achieve full product control.

title: Acxiom Uses Amazon SageMaker for Propensity Scoring 3 Trillion Records
summary: Hear from Varadarajan Srinivasan, senior director of data science and machine learning engineering at Acxiom, on how the company uses Amazon SageMaker for propensity model scoring on a scalable machine learning platform.

title: Fix This Podcast #67: Fostering a creative and inclusive gaming industry
summary: Learn how Creative Assembly, an AWS customer, aims to build a more inclusive world by improving access to education for under-represented groups in the games industry through its Legacy Project.

title: Sprout Social Reduces Costs by 40% and Improves Performance by 50% Using Amazon EMR
summary: Social media management software company Sprout Social reduced costs by 40 percent and reduced batch job processing times by 30–50 percent using Amazon EMR.

title: Sony Interactive Entertainment Launches PlayStation 5 Without Downtime Using AWS
summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is a global leader in interactive and digital entertainment that is responsible for creating the world-renowned PlayStation brand and family of products. This session explores how SIE prepared for the launch of PlayStation 5 (PS5) against the backdrop of a global pandemic. Learn how SIE delivered PS5 without downtime to millions of players around the world using a coordinated-operations planned response program and a robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure using AWS services, including Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), Amazon Route 53, and Amazon CloudWatch.

title: ŠKODA Uses AWS to Predict and Prevent Production Line Breakdowns
summary: ŠKODA’s MAGIC EYE compute vision and predictive maintenance solution uses AWS services to transform production processes from reactive to proactive, reducing costly downtime.

title: Salesforce Creates a Single Source of Data Truth for Its Customer Data Platform Using AWS
summary: Salesforce is a cloud-based software company that provides customer relationship management services and a complementary suite of enterprise applications focused on customer service, marketing automation, analytics, and application development. In this video, Muralidhar Krishnaprasad, executive vice president (EVP) of engineering for Salesforce, describes how the company creates a single source of truth for customer data in the company's Customer Data Platform (CDP), utilizing AWS services such as Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon EMR to provide marketers with a detailed view of their consumers and improve business outcomes.

title: Olli Salumeria Saves 80% on Disaster Recovery for SAP ERP Infrastructure Using AWS
summary: Using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, Olli Salumeria saved 80 percent on disaster recovery while making core business applications ready to recover in minutes.

title: Intuit Modernizes AI and ML on AWS to Derive Customer Benefits
summary: Intuit is a business and financial software company that develops and sells financial, accounting, and tax preparation software and related services for small businesses, accountants, and individuals. Learn how Intuit accelerated its artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) progress to create game-changing customer experiences. By using AWS to modernize its data and ML infrastructure, the company freed up its data scientists and tripled its speed to delivery, helping to direct more resources to customers.

title: Expedia Group Scales Database-as-a-Service Platform Using AWS Service Catalog
summary: Travel company Expedia Group used AWS Service Catalog to scale its database-as-a-service platform, facilitating simple database deployments, management, and support with a lean team of engineers.

title: Esports Engine Delivers Global Gaming Broadcasts with Single-Digit Millisecond Latency Using AWS Local Zones
summary: Esports Engine, a Vindex company, brings gaming entertainment events to life, producing large-scale live broadcasts for publishers, teams, and fans with ultralow latency from AWS Local Zones.

title: CI Financial Overhauls Call Center, Gains Data Insights in Minutes Using AWS
summary: Global investment and wealth management firm CI Financial used AWS Partner VoiceFoundry to transform its telephony in 6 months using Amazon Connect, improving customer service and business operations.

title: CalvertHealth Improves Electronic Health Records System Resilience and Shortens Recovery Time Using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery
summary: Rural hospital CalvertHealth used solutions like AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery and AWS Backup with its primary electronic healthcare records system to improve its recovery time by 97 percent.

title: 23andMe Innovates Drug and Therapeutic Discovery with HPC on AWS
summary: 23andMe, a biotechnology company, increased its scalability and optimized cost efficiency by migrating multiple petabytes of data to run its HPC clusters on Amazon EC2 instances.

title: PBS on AWS
summary: PBS innovates using Amazon Web Services (AWS) to bring its annual Short Film Festival to a virtual format, improve the performance of video streams, enhance its archives with deep search functionality, and more using artificial intelligence (AI).

title: myposter Scales, Modernizes, and Future-Proofs its Business Using AWS
summary: myposter is an ecommerce and photo production business based near Munich, Germany. Its customers upload photos to create personalized photobooks, greeting cards, calendars, posters, and other printed items. myposter turned to AWS to create an infrastructure that could scale in times of high demand, such as during Black Friday sales promotions and over the Christmas period. Using AWS has helped the company innovate faster and also launch a second business, Kartenliebe, which makes personalized cards for weddings, birthdays, religious festivals, and other social occasions.

title: Glossika Builds Language-Learning Platform on AWS to Serve Users in 148 Countries
summary: Glossika built its language learning platform on AWS to ensure low latency for users in 148 countries and access to on-demand compute and storage as it expands. Glossika is an education technology company that uses syntax-sorted and customized content to train people to understand and speak foreign languages. The startup uses Amazon RDS to store lesson data, Amazon ElastiCache for Redis for caching, and Amazon CloudFront as a content delivery network.

title: Spryker Brings Composable Commerce to Global Businesses in Days Using AWS
summary: Spryker provides a cloud-based platform that global businesses rely on to run their B2B, marketplace, and direct-to-consumer (D2C) commerce businesses. When Spryker noticed customers were running complex backends to support its software, it turned to AWS. Using AWS, it improved the customer experience and shortened customer onboarding from months to days. Spryker has also expanded its operations worldwide, including launching in APAC, and improved its ability to innovate.

title: Playtech Improves Reliability by Delivering Low-Latency Video Globally Using Amazon CloudFront and Lambda@Edge
summary: Online gaming software supplier Playtech PLC migrated its video streaming infrastructure to AWS, improving its scalability to support more concurrent players while reducing latency and improving reliability.

title: Medtronic Improves Patient Access to Colorectal Cancer Screening with an Artificial Intelligence–Assisted “Colonoscopy Pill” Built on AWS
summary: Colon cancer is the second-deadliest cancer worldwide but treatable 90 percent of the time if doctors catch it early. Yet tens of millions of individuals either don’t have access to a colonoscopy or choose not to be screened because they don’t want to undergo the unpleasant procedure. Medtronic wanted to use technology to develop a more appealing, patient-friendly screening that people can do at home and to improve access to screenings for underserved or hard-to-reach patient populations.

title: HMRC Supports Millions of UK Jobs and Businesses with COVID-19 Pandemic Response Built in 4 Weeks on AWS
summary: HMRC delivered a solution for COVID-19 pandemic relief in 4 weeks, paying out more than £69.3 billion, supporting more than 11.7 million jobs, and achieving 90 percent customer satisfaction.

title: Buildigo Scales at Speed While Delivering for Customers with AWS
summary: Buildigo offers an easy way to link homeowners and renters with local craftspeople who can work on their houses and gardens. The Swiss startupneeds to quickly scale its IT systems as customer demand increaseswhile minimizingcosts andmaintenance tasks for its small team. It built its platform on AWS, runningits customer-facing website, databases,data lake, and development pipeline in the AWS cloud.

title: Fix This Podcast #66 - Powering creativity and collaboration with Netflix
summary: Discover how Netflix uses AWS to build flexible, remote workstations to attract and retain creative talent that can now collaborate from virtually anywhere.

title: WirelessCar Connects Millions of Vehicles to the Cloud Using AWS IoT Core
summary: WirelessCar is connecting millions of vehicles to the cloud using AWS IoT Core, increasing speed to market and reducing manual labor with fully managed services.

title: Toppan Reskills on AWS to Lift Its Digital Transformation to a New Stage
summary: Toppan Inc. worked with AWS Training and Certification to train over 1,600 employees, accelerating its digital business and actively promoting digital transformation.

title: Tempus Ex Processes Live Video for NFL at 40x Speed in Hybrid Solution Using Amazon ECS Anywhere
summary: Sports technology company Tempus Ex Machina used Amazon ECS Anywhere to deploy its solutions on specialized on-premises hardware, increasing processing speeds by 40 times while keeping workflows simple for its lean team.

title: Sixth Force Solutions Delivers Cloud Version of Enterprise Architect Software to Meet Customer Demand for Rapid Tool Deployment
summary: Sixth Force Solutions uses AWS to increase revenue by 150 percent in one and a half years, grow cloud-hosted and SaaS solutions from zero to more than 60 in less than a year, help employees collaborate reliably across the globe, and cut deployment time from months to weeks. The company provides Enterprise Architecture consulting for customers in a range of industries.

title: Return Entertainment Speeds Up Development of Cloud-Native Games Using AWS
summary: Finnish startup Return Entertainment built cloud-native gaming infrastructure in a few months using AWS. By saving time and money on AWS, Return Entertainment can focus on innovative cloud-native game design.

title: Measurable AI Empowers Businesses with Faster Insights from Alternative Data on AWS
summary: Measurable AI leverages managed services from AWS to maintain a lean team while scaling its business internationally, saving 20% of developers’ time. Measurable AI provides businesses with aggregated, anonymized insights gathered from consumers in Southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. The company uses Amazon OpenSearch Service for querying, Amazon EKS for Kubernetes orchestration, and Amazon S3 for secure data transfers and storage.

title: Lendingkart Builds Digital Underwriting Platform with AWS SaaS Factory to Close MSME Credit Gap in India
summary: Lendingkart enrolled in the AWS SaaS Factory Program to build its Lending 2gthr platform, relying on expert guidance to accelerate time-to-market and develop a customer-oriented product. Lendingkart is a Fintech in India that uses machine learning-driven underwriting to provide unstructured business loans to MSMEs.

title: LactApp Optimizes Breastfeeding Support with VOD on AWS Foundation
summary: LactApp is making breastfeeding education simpler and more accessible by supporting video content using streaming solutions from AWS.

title: Infor Bulks up AWS Expertise, Trains Over 2,400 Employees to Meet Customer Needs
summary: Software solutions provider Infor worked with AWS Training and Certification to provide training to over 2,500 employees, improving the performance of its solutions and optimizing its costs.

title: immowelt Modernizes Real Estate Portal, Controls Costs, and Boosts Innovation Using AWS
summary: Germany-based, immowelt Group migrated to AWS and simultaneously re-architected its core infrastructure. Using AWS, immowelt has achieved greater visibility of IT costs, lowered maintenance overheads, and created a more efficient, flexible development process for future growth.

title: CaratLane Scales To Meet Seasonal Peaks and Deliver Seamless Customer Experience With AWS
summary: Since 2012, CaratLane has been working with AWS to build a scalable, cost-effective infrastructure for its ecommerce platform. On top of that, CaratLane engaged various AWS services to expand its Machine Learrning (ML) capabilities and improve customer experience on its ecommerce platform.

title: AU Small Finance Bank Delights Customers by Offering Video Banking Services Seven Days a Week
summary: AU Small Finance Bank deployed a video banking platform using WorkApps to securely serve customers across the country seven days a week, from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. AU Small Finance Bank is India’s largest small finance bank, with more than 900 banking touchpoints and 2.7 million customers.

title: Optoma Facilitates Virtual Collaboration with Hybrid Learning Platform on AWS
summary: By leveraging the AWS Cloud, Optoma can launch new products 56 percent faster while ensuring service stability and real-time interaction around the globe. Optoma is a leader in the display technology market, serving corporate, education, and individual customers in 159 countries. The company uses Amazon S3 for reliable data storage, Amazon RDS for MariaDB to manage its databases, and Amazon CloudFront as a low-latency content delivery network.

title: Fix This Podcast #65 - Working for planet Earth with Salesforce
summary: Hear how Salesforce builds on AWS to advance its sustainability goals and to further its sustainability mission through the customers it serves. Committed to leading by example in sustainable business practices, Salesforce is a signatory of The Climate Pledge co-founded by Amazon, and it is an AWS Partner and customer.

title: Tangent Works Puts Machine Learning Modeling into Business Users’ Hands Using AWS
summary: Tangent Works helps companies get more value from their time-series data by automating the machine learning modeling process. Its Tangent Information Modeler (TIM) technology makes artificial intelligence technology accessible and affordable to businesses that don’t have dedicated data science teams. Tangent Works used AWS to launch its services, manage customers’ compute and storage needs, and support its rapid growth.

title: LifeOmic Achieves up to 50% Cost Savings after Building Serverless Architecture on AWS
summary: Software company LifeOmic built a serverless architecture on AWS, achieving 30–50 percent cost savings and faster time to market as it launched its healthcare data solution, Precision Health Cloud.

title: Making America's Neighborhoods Safer with IDEMIA Cloud-Based Fingerprinting Software
summary: To expand their market range and serve more customers, IDEMIA needed to adapt their enterprise application into a lightweight, cloud-based software as a service (SaaS) solution, which would offer a subscription cost model that small agencies could deploy. IDEMIA leveraged the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud and the AWS Go to Market team to bring their new solution, STORM ABIS, to life.

title: GE Aviation Modernizes Technology Stack and Improves Data Accessibility Using Amazon Redshift
summary: GE Aviation is using Amazon Redshift as the centerpiece of its technology stack modernization, migrating from a large-scale on-premises data platform to the cloud and improving data accessibility and analytics.

title: Climedo Health Captures Patient-Centric, Compliant, and Secure Clinical Data Using AWS
summary: German EDC (electronic data capture) software provider Climedo Health used AWS to create secure, cloud-native, and scalable solutions to better capture and manage clinical data used by pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, hospitals, and around 150 public health offices. The fast-growing company accelerated its customers’ clinical trials and onboarded hundreds of thousands of patients in a short period of time.

title: Armut Teknoloji Improves Customer Experience with Scalable Notification System Using AWS
summary: Turkey-based Armut connects consumers with professionals offering a wide variety of services, including home improvement, tuition, home moving, and health and wellness. To manage jobs effectively, its service uses a matching algorithm and digital notifications. As the company grew, its legacy technology no longer met its needs, so Armut developed a new system using AWS, which increased notification reliability and the volume of jobs it could handle. The business is now generating more income and supporting a greater number of customers without any additional staff.

title: Amazon Search Empowers Teams Across Amazon to Bring Deep Learning to Their ML Applications Using AWS
summary: Search M5, a team within Amazon Search, used various AWS solutions to run deep learning experiments with tens of billions of parameters.

title: 6sense Insights Inc. Improves Scalability and Accelerates Speed to Market by Migrating to Amazon EKS
summary: 6sense improved its workload throughput by 400 percent and freed its employees to focus on innovation by migrating to fully managed Amazon EKS clusters.

title: Mobileye: How to Process Data from 70 Million Cars Driving Around the World
summary: Mobileye provides camera based driving assistance solution and data services, based on data collected from 70 million vehicles, driving all over the world. In this episode of This is My Architecture, Ido from Mobileye will walk us through their data collection and analytics system, the evolution of it and how they provide important insights to their customers, based on this data.

title: Traeger Provisions: Personalizing Customer Support Experiences on AWS
summary: Learn how Traeger Grills processes orders and personalizes their customer support experience for their newly launched Traeger Provisions service. You'll learn how they use EventBridge in conjunction with Kinesis Data Firehose to send real time data to S3 which is then processed and stored in Dynamo DB. You'll also see how they personalize customer experience using Amazon Connect along with Pinpoint and use Lex to get input from customer to send them to specialized queues.

title: Tyson Foods Improves Efficiency with Computer Vision and Machine Learning Using AWS Services
summary: Tyson Foods Inc. improved efficiency in its production facilities using AWS services to develop computer vision solutions powered by machine learning for inventory management and product carrier inspections.

title: Tyler Technologies Recovers Mission-Critical Workloads 12x Faster Using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery
summary: Tyler Technologies implemented a disaster recovery solution using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, achieving a 12-times-faster recovery time than with its previous solution and recovery point objectives of seconds.

title: The Cantabrian Health Service improves its service to citizens with AWS
summary: The Cantabrian Health Service is fully migrating to SAP for the unified purchase of health materials, changing from an on-premises to a cloud model.

title: Savana Builds World’s Only Natural Language Processing Clinical Research Network on AWS
summary: Madrid-based Savana helps healthcare providers to unlock the value of their electronic medical records (EMRs) for research purposes. It combines research-grade methodology with natural language processing (NLP) and predictive analytics to obtain relevant results for healthcare and life science providers investigating disease prevention and treatment.

title: ResMed Improves Agility and User Satisfaction Using AWS AppSync
summary: Digital health company ResMed reduced operational overhead by 80 percent and decreased application latency using AWS AppSync alongside other serverless solutions.

title: Proscia Brings Artificial Intelligence to Cancer Research and Diagnostics on AWS Using Concentriq
summary: Proscia used a suite of AWS services to create and operate Concentriq, a pathology software solution aimed at accelerating life sciences research and improving patient outcomes with cloud-based management and computational analysis of biomedical data.

title: LexisNexis Uses Amazon Redshift to Drive Powerful Data Analytics
summary: LexisNexis Legal & Professional reduced costs and improved its data analytics and business intelligence capabilities by migrating its data warehouse to Amazon Redshift on AWS.

title: Kasasa Automates Sensitive Information Detection Using Amazon Macie
summary: Wholesale financial services provider Kasasa uses AWS solutions like Amazon Macie, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon Athena to improve data security and build trust among its clients.

title: IPS Built on AWS to Bring Better Pension Services to 2 Million Chileans
summary: The Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS), or Social Security Institute, is responsible for bringing various social benefits to people in Chile. In January of 2022, following the approval of the Universal Guaranteed Pension (PGU), IPS needed a rapid process for its digital platform to simultaneously support consultations for about 2 million people—and be available to receive benefit applications. Using Amazon Web Services (AWS) was key to making this platform available to citizens in just 6 days and to meet user demands, as the number of requests increased by almost 900 percent.

title: Goldman Sachs on AWS
summary: Goldman Sachs builds on Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help advance its business and accelerate innovation for its customers. Using the cloud, Goldman Sachs has transformed the way it operates internally—from automated digital forensics to digital supply chain and procurement—and externally by serving customers through innovations such as the Goldman Sachs Financial Cloud for Data, which is a suite of cloud-based data and analytics solutions for financial institutions that integrates with AWS Data Exchange. It helps financial institutions securely integrate data alongside Goldman Sachs’s curated financial markets data to improve decision making.

title: GoDaddy Centralizes Security Findings and Gains Insights Using AWS Security Hub
summary: As it migrated to the cloud, GoDaddy used AWS Security Hub to help create a centralized dashboard for security findings and establish best practices in security protocols.

title: DataFarming Processes Data from 35 Million Acres Using Amazon ECS
summary: DataFarming, a precision agriculture company based in Australia, reached 40 percent of the Australian grains market in 4 years using Amazon ECS in its digital solution, which delivers data quickly and cost effectively to farmers.

title: Bayer Centralizes and Standardizes Data from the Carbon Program Using AWS
summary: To help Brazilian farmers adopt climate–smart agricultural practices and reduce carbon emissions in their activities, Bayer created the Carbon Program, which aims to build carbon neutral agriculture practices. The initiative is part of the company's commitment to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 30 percent in the agricultural sector by 2030. To centralize and standardize the data received from the different partners involved in the project, Bayer uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) to have the scalability and agility the project needs.

title: PureWeb: Building a Global 3D Streaming Platform For Limitless Experiences
summary: Learn how PureWeb intelligently routes streaming requests from any device, anywhere on the planet, with decisioning based on network latency, and system preference and load. PureWeb's architecture leverages both serverless and provisioned compute to deliver 3D streaming for limitless experiences.

title: Zego Drives Down Insurance Premiums and Keeps Roads Safer Using AWS
summary: When Zego acquired driving telematics company Drivit, it needed to rapidly and securely migrate Drivit’s systems from another cloud provider onto AWS. The move avoided the expense of running two parallel systems.

title: Supr Daily Improves Partner and Customer Experiences Using Machine Learning on AWS
summary: Supr Daily, a subsidiary of Swiggy, used machine learning on AWS to accelerate image recognition and enhance inventory forecasting while scaling seamlessly with little overhead to meet higher demand.

title: Registers of Scotland modernises the world’s oldest land register using AWS
summary: Moving to AWS serverless cloud, supported by AWS Professional Services (AWS ProServe) and deploying technologies like AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) and AWS Lambda, has enabled RoS to scale cost effectively, accelerate innovation and ultimately deliver a better user experience for Scottish citizens.

title: Intuit Migrates Apache Cassandra Workloads to Amazon Keyspaces with High Availability and Reliability
summary: The Intuit data exchange platform team migrated more than 120 TB of data, which it was managing in Apache Cassandra, to Amazon Keyspaces, enhancing efficiency for its team and reliability for its users.

title: HM Land Registry Cuts Document Review Time in Half Using Amazon Textract
summary: HM Land Registry (HMLR) reduced document review times by 50 percent after working alongside AWS Advanced Partner Kainos Software Limited (Kainos) to build and implement an automated comparison tool on AWS.

title: Baylor College of Medicine’s HGSC Analyzes Genomics Data Faster Using Illumina DRAGEN on AWS
summary: Baylor College of Medicine used bioinformatics solution Illumina DRAGEN from AWS Partner Illumina, bolstered by Amazon EC2 F1 Instances, to analyze data faster and streamline genomics research.

title: Rappi: Leveraging EKS, DocumentDB, RDS and ElastiCache to Quickly Scale Kubernetes Clusters
summary: In this episode of This Is My Architecture, you'll learn how the financial vertical of Rappi (Rappi Pay) offers Kubernetes as a service to more easily scale, increase performance, and improve security. You'll see how they choose purpose-built AWS database and data caching services for different types of data within their solution. You'll also see how they leverage AWS CloudFront and AWS Direct Connect in a multi-tenant environment.

title: ResMed: Improving Patient Outcomes with Serverless at Scale
summary: Learn how ResMed built ‘myAir', a patient engagement platform, that helps patients track and engage with their sleep therapy for conditions like sleep apnea. ResMed moved from an on-premises environment to a fully serverless architecture on AWS to power myAir. The solution uses services such as AWS AppSync to manage data flow from the patient mobile and website experience, Amazon Kinesis Video Streams for IOT data, AWS Lambda, Amazon SNS, Amazon Dynamo DB, Amazon S3 and CloudFront to scale globally, improve system performance and provide proactive care notifications.

title: Treezor : Comment répondre aux enjeux de scalabilité et de sécurité tout en se recentrant sur son cœur de métier, le banking-as-a-service
summary: Treezor, leader européen du Banking-as-a-Service, permet à des entreprises (Fintechs & corporates) d’intégrer des services bancaires dans leur expérience client. Treezor est un établissement de monnaie électronique et de paiement régulé autorisé à opérer des flux dans 25 pays. Avec plus de 100 clients entreprises, le principal défi de Treezor est de pouvoir accompagner la croissance de ses clients, avec de vrais enjeux de scalabilité et de sécurité. Julien MORTUAIRE et Nicolas BORDES, respectivement CTO de Treezor et Architecte Cloud chez Treezor, expliquent être passés sur le cloud pour pouvoir se concentrer sur leur cœur de métier : le développement de leur logiciel grâce à une technologie serverless. La résilience, la garantie de différentes zones de disponibilité dans plusieurs régions, la sécurité de l’infrastructure et des données, mais aussi la scalabilité et les services disponibles pour exploiter au mieux leur architecture, ont fait basculer leur choix vers le Cloud AWS. Un des résultats probants : l’élasticité du cloud afin d’absorber les pics de trafic ainsi que les 3 millions d’événements journaliers.

summary: In this video, Anu Dodda, Head of Engineering and CTO for Corporate Tax and Trade Technology at Thomson Reuters, describes how Thomson Reuters is working with AWS to acceerate application development, and implement a modern data strategy with services like Amazon Redshift, providing their customers with next generation reporting and analytics capabilities.

title: Sky Group Upskills Workforce, Improves Time to Market Using AWS Training and Certification Program
summary: Sky Group Ltd. uses the AWS Training and Certification program supported by AWS experts to train employees so that they are better equipped to meet business objectives quickly and effectively.

title: Regeneron Brings Large-Scale Genomics to Drug Discovery Using AWS
summary: Regeneron is helping the industry shift toward accelerating and improving drug discovery through the integration of genomic insights using AWS. The Regeneron Genetics Center is a research initiative focused on sequencing exomes and enabling large-scale analysis of genomic and health data to yield actionable scientific results that can be applied in Regeneron’s own drug development programs and by the broader research community.

title: How Data Engineering Supports Neumora's R&D Programs Using AWS
summary: Using AWS, Neumora created an integrated data platform that allowed scientists to generate and test hypotheses from complex, multi-class data sets of patient genomic data and imaging data, to drive precision medicine in neuroscience.

title: Maze Therapeutics Applies Genetics Insights to Accelerate Drug Discovery Using AWS
summary: San Francisco-based biotech company Maze Therapeutics built its proprietary COMPASS data analysis platform on AWS to deliver precision medicines based on genetic insights into metabolic, cardiovascular, renal, neurological and ophthalmic diseases.

title: Iktos : Le déploiement rapide et à grande échelle de solutions clients d’une entreprise d’IA en pleine croissance
summary: Société d’intelligence artificielle spécialisée dans la chimie, Iktos concentre l’ensemble de son activité à aider les acteurs de l’industrie pharmaceutique à accélérer le processus de développement de nouveaux médicaments. Nicolas DO HUU, Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer chez Iktos, nous exprime les besoins et les problématiques d’Iktos et comment AWS a su accompagner l’entreprise en pleine croissance à déployer rapidement ses solutions dans le cloud tout en bénéficiant de la puissance de calcul pour la recherche interne. Iktos a décidé de migrer vers le cloud pour faciliter la gestion du datacenter notamment la sécurité et afin de gagner en scalabilité. Les bases de données, le message passing et l’accès à des GPU performants, font partie des services proposés par le cloud AWS nécessaires à l’infrastructure d’Iktos. Cela a permis à leurs déploiements de passer de 3 semaines à 1 jour et demi. Après le développement de l’infrastructure de production sur AWS, la prochaine étape est de migrer l’infrastructure de R&D.

title: Gold Coast University Hospital Optimizes ICU Efficiency Through Datarwe Solutions Running on AWS and Intel
summary: AWS Public Sector Partner Datarwe worked with Gold Coast University Hospital to build an acute care medical research data platform on AWS powered by Intel. Using this solution, the hospital can collect and analyze a growing volume of medical device and patient data and gain better visibility into ICU bed supply and demand.

title: AstraZeneca Uses AWS in Quest to Accelerate Identification and Development of Life-Changing Medications
summary: AstraZeneca uses AWS in reimagining its drug discovery process, with a goal to develop medicines more quickly, cost effectively, and with a higher probability of success. Scientists now have access to data that is findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable so that they can quickly generate actionable insights that previously took days or weeks, ultimately benefiting millions of patients.

title: Ares Genetics Tests for Antimicrobial Susceptibility With Machine Learning Using AWS
summary: Building infrastructure on AWS, Ares Genetics developed an anti-microbial resistance knowledge base called ARESdb to comprehensively detect and determine the genetic profile of bacterial pathogens, to enable better infection control and more targeted patient care.

title: Aircall : Une solution de téléphonie intransigeante sur la fiabilité de ses services, visant une empreinte mondiale
summary: Fondée en 2014, Aircall est une société qui fournit une solution de téléphonie d’entreprise intégrée aux outils quotidiens tels que Salesforce ou Hubspot. Elle comprend l’achat de numéros de téléphone à l’international et la possibilité de passer et recevoir des appels très simplement via une application complète et interactive. Pierre-Baptiste BECHU, Co-founder & VP, témoigne de leur plus grand défi et leur plus grande force : la fiabilité des services. L’entreprise s’est naturellement tournée vers AWS dès 2014 pour 2 raisons : la présence à l’international et la fiabilité des services. La logique de partenariat technologique avec AWS a permis de résoudre la problématique de la croissance exponentielle d’Aircall tout en répondant aux meilleurs standards de qualité et de sécurité des données clients. Le Cloud AWS a contribué à scaler le business d’Aircall, dont le trafic est multiplié par deux tous les 18 mois, ainsi qu’à intégrer des fonctionnalités d’IA et de machine learning.

title: GoDaddy: Empowering Agility with Zero-Trust Environment Best Practices
summary: Learn from GoDaddy's Director of Information Security on Best Practices to enable Agility in a Zero Trust Environment. Security is in GoDaddy's DNA and to enable it they practice the zero trust architecture. GoDaddy took approach that every org is separated and isolated. The Dev accounts are isolated by account boundary. Every account setup has it's own VPC with isolated subnet and private IPs. GoDaddy also does node rotation daily with updated Golden AMIs. GoDaddy rotates this from the EC2 instances to the whole EKS clusters. Because they update and rotate the Golden AMI images frequently, GoDaddy never have to patch. GoDaddy built an OSS tool that runs configuration scans, but also runs scans looking for GoDaddy standards. Another way to stop horizontal movement within the group is that they do not allow VPC peering. The Accounts would talk to each other via NAT Gateway. They can quickly isolate an Account to reduce the blast radius if that Account were to get compromised. GoDaddy governs the account creation through their Cloud Portal that performs Cloud Readiness Review. The process checks to see if the application follows best practices/standards. Once approved, the application team is onboard through the portal and baseline environment is created with security approved CloudFormation templates. This automation enables GoDaddy to make it easier to spin-up a new account with best practices in an isolated fashion with security built in.

Data is securely migrated from the source systems on-premises to AWS using AWS Direct Connect and ingested in data integration tools running on Amazon EC2 such as Kafka, Talend, and Databricks. Data is pushed into different layers for transformation with Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon RDS. To obtain read-optimized data, data is ingested into Amazon Redshift. Amazon Redshift Spectrum and Amazon Athena are leveraged by Toyota's Data Scientists, Analysts, and Business user teams to produce self-service reports. title: Marathon Oil: Automating Drone Image Processing to Monitor Equipment Health

The event-driven architecture then calls a series of AWS Lambda functions to determine when new images are available for processing, store the images on Amazon S3, and further optimize the images in Amazon S3. With the images in Amazon S3, AWS Storage Gateway allows the team to access image files from their on-prem mapping applications to Amazon S3 without re-writing their existing applications. title: DISH Network: Building a Self-Service Portal to Create Multiple Accounts at Scale
summary: DISH Network is deploying the first standalone, cloud-based 5G network. To simplify and scale infrastructure delivery on AWS, DISH has built a self-service portal. New AWS account requests are created in an IT Service Management (ITSM) tool by internal users, and approved workflow requests kick off the Account factory service in AWS Control Tower from the root or management account. With Control Tower, new AWS accounts are created and standardized with baselines. After the new vended accounts are created, AWS Service Catalog provisions a new VPC in each vended account with tags and also allows for the deployment of resources such as Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS and Amazon RDS within the new VPC. AWS Serverless Transit Network Orchestrator (STNO) simplifies the Transit Gateway setup by automatically adding the VPCs tagged with configuration details in each vended account to the Transit Gateway setup in the Central Networking Account. AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub to connect the new vended accounts to a Central Networking account. With the self-service portal, DISH Network is able to provision several hundreds of accounts in only 6 months.

title: Helping Prevent Opioid Overdoses: Student Developers Build Web App on AWS
summary: San Luis Obispo (SLO) County in California formed the SLO Opioid Safety Coalition (SLO OSC) in 2016 to address opioid misuse in the region. To help the community, prevent overdose deaths, and support people struggling with addiction, SLO County decided to build a web application, Naloxone Now, in collaboration with the Cal Poly Digital Transformation Hub (DxHub) powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help connect those in need to the life-saving drug Naloxone. The student developers and designers at the DxHub built SLO County’s application using Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) to host web pages with text and videos about how to obtain and administer Naloxone. To support the app’s delivery feature, the developers leveraged Amazon DynamoDB (DynamoDB), AWS Lambda, and Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Cities, counties, and community members alike who are looking to help save hundreds, even thousands, of lives and prevent fatal opioid overdoses can adopt the app.

title: Discover Financial Services: Enabling a PCI Compliant Data Science Platform
summary: Discover Financial Services empowers their Data Scientists to build rapid data models on their Advanced Analytics Framework. For separation of concerns, the raw PCI data is placed in a tightly controlled Amazon S3 bucket, then is tokenized into another S3 in a different account. This enables data scientists from different business units to perform machine learning and data science work in a single platform without having data silos across the organization. Data Scientists can confidently build financial data models in a secured and compliant manner. By leveraging Kubernetes on Amazon EC2 compute and storage with Amazon EFS and Amazon S3, the data scientists can rapidly build data models on demand with significant reduction in storage costs and complexity.

title: Shaping the Future of Life Sciences with ZS China ’s ZAIDYN Platform powered By AWS
summary: ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond. They leverage leading-edge analytics, plus the power of data, science, and products, to help clients make more intelligent decisions, deliver innovative solutions, and improve outcomes for all. Founded in 1983, ZS has more than 12,000 employees in 35 offices worldwide. More than 130 companies have already used ZS’s products to drive business decisions, and over 100,000 pharmaceutical field reps worldwide have used ZS’s insights to engage their customers. To further enhance their capabilities in the healthcare industry, ZS is continuing to enhance its portfolio of products. In 2021, ZS launched ZAIDYNTM, an intelligent, cloud-native platform that helps life sciences organizations shape the future. Its analytics, algorithms and workflows empower people, transform processes, and unlock real value. Designed to learn and grow with our clients, the platform is modular, future-ready and fueled by global connectivity. And as more people engage, share and build, our platform gets smarter—helping organizations fuel discovery, connect with customers, deliver treatments, and improve lives. Today, ZAIDYN, built on Amazon Web Services, has been launched and operated in the Chinese market.

title: ZooParc de Beauval : le défi de la saisonnalité et du nombre exponentiel de visiteurs et de données
summary: Fondé en 1980, le ZooParc de Beauval est le premier zoo de France et le 4ème plus beau zoo du monde. Il abrite plus de 35,000 animaux et plus de 800 espèces différentes, au premier rang desquelles les fameux pandas géants. Au global, ce sont 1,6 millions de visiteurs qui profitent du parc chaque année. Comprenant également 4 établissements hôteliers, des points de restauration et des boutiques, le zoo permet à ses visiteurs de réserver leur séjour intégralement en ligne. Amené à accueillir un nombre important et variable de connexions, le site Internet du ZooParc de Beauval tire parti de la scalabilité et de l’élasticité du cloud AWS pour adapter son infrastructure à la demande et garantir à ses utilisateurs une disponibilité constante. Dans cette vidéo, Sylvain Spodar, Directeur des Systèmes Informatiques du ZooParc de Beauval, nous explique comment le cloud permet à l’entreprise de coordonner l'ensemble de son système informatique et plus spécifiquement comment ses équipes utilisent les services de la plateforme pour stocker, extraire, traiter et analyser des quantités de données très utiles au pilotage et à la planification de leur activité.

title: YPF mejora su TCO en tecnología con nueva estructura basada en AWS

Además, la compañía ya disfruta de un acceso más ubicuo a sus datos y también se beneficia de una postura de ciber seguridad más robusta. Los próximos pasos de la empresa incluyen aprovechar de tecnologías como la inteligencia artificial y la analítica avanzada para mejorar la toma de decisiones.

title: Velliv Completes Secure, Compliant Migration Using AWS
summary: Operating in the highly regulated financial services industry, Velliv is one of Denmark’s largest pension companies, with more than 360,000 customers. When it separated from its parent company, Nordea, in 2018, Velliv had a chance to build a completely new, independent IT infrastructure.

title: Velliv schließt sichere, konforme Migration mit AWS ab
summary: Velliv ist in der stark regulierten Finanzdienstleistungsbranche tätig und mit mehr als 360 000 Kunden eines der größten dänischen Rentenversicherungsunternehmen. Als sich Velliv 2018 von seiner Muttergesellschaft Nordea trennte, bot sich die Chance, eine völlig neue, unabhängige IT-Infrastruktur aufzubauen. Die Unternehmensarchitekten von Velliv haben jedoch mit Unterstützung unseres AWS-Partners Cognizant gezeigt, dass die Migration zu AWS machbar ist. Wir haben die Migration in nur 1 Jahr abgeschlossen. Es ist ein großer Erfolg, dass wir es in dieser kurzen Zeit geschafft haben.“
