title: Estudiantes e investigadores mejor preparados para el futuro a través de AWS
summary: La Universidad Andrés Bello es una universidad privada chilena creada en 1988. Desde 2020, pertenece a la Fundación Educación y Cultura. Es una de las cuatro universidades chilenas que figuran en el Academic Ranking of World Universities, adjudicándose el lugar 4. El desafío que enfrentan y en el cual están trabajando es la transformación digital de la institución, que posibilite la automatización de varios de sus procesos y poner a disposición de sus cerca de 60 mil estudiantes, las herramientas tecnológicas que les ayuden a llevar a buen puerto (y con gran velocidad) sus investigaciones y la obtención de nuevas habilidades para su vida profesional futura. Es decir, a mejorar la experiencia de los estudiantes y potenciar la investigación al interior de la universidad.

title: Con AWS, UNAM marca hito en materia de valoración a gran escala de maestras y maestros en México
summary: La Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM), es la más grande e importante universidad pública de México e Iberoamérica. En abril de 2021 firmó un convenio de colaboración con la Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP) en México, para llevar a cabo los diversos procesos de selección de las maestras y los maestros de Educación Básica y Educación Media Superior. Para ello, la UNAM tuvo como objetivo proveer diferentes servicios de proctoring basados en los servicios de AWS, los cuales incluyeron tanto el diseño, el desarrollo, la aplicación y análisis de resultados, así como la seguridad de los instrumentos de valoración.

title: Con AWS, UNAM marca hito en materia de valoración a gran escala de maestras y maestros en México
summary: La Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM), es la más grande e importante universidad pública de México e Iberoamérica. En abril de 2021 firmó un convenio de colaboración con la Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP) en México, para llevar a cabo los diversos procesos de selección de las maestras y los maestros de Educación Básica y Educación Media Superior. Para ello, la UNAM tuvo como objetivo proveer diferentes servicios de proctoring basados en los servicios de AWS, los cuales incluyeron tanto el diseño, el desarrollo, la aplicación y análisis de resultados, así como la seguridad de los instrumentos de valoración.

title: Universidade da Família consolida estrutura de TI na AWS
summary: A Universidade da Família (UDF) é uma organização cristã, criada em 1992 com o objetivo de oferecer cursos e seminários que abordam, em uma perspectiva bíblica, os mais diversos aspectos da vida familiar e do desenvolvimento pessoal. Desde sua criação, a UDF estabeleceu parcerias com mais de 4 mil igrejas, capacitando mais de 130 mil líderes em todo o Brasil. Nesse período, a instituição criou uma arquitetura de TI heterogênea, difícil de gerenciar por conta do grande número de soluções e fornecedores envolvidos. Por isso a instituição optou por consolidar toda a sua infraestrutura na AWS.

title: TWAICE Improves Battery Life by 20%, Speeds Customer Onboarding Using AWS
summary: TWAICE provides predictive analytics to help electric vehicle makers and renewable energy firms optimize their use of battery technology. To manage growth driven by rising consumer interest in reducing emissions, TWAICE developed a cloud-native platform built on AWS. The company improved the speed and accuracy of its data analytics by 300 percent, helping customers get the most out of their batteries, as well as cutting battery purchasing and maintenance costs by 20 percent. It also boosted IT team efficiency, reducing development time from several months to 2 weeks, and decreased deployment times from 3 days to a few hours. The time required to onboard customers was cut from weeks to hours and TWAICE was able to maintain the size of its DevOps team, reducing internal costs by 60 percent.

title: Trustpilot, Building on AWS, Scales to House 190M Reviews That Help Consumers and Businesses to Make Better Decisions
summary: Trustpilot director of engineering, Angela Timofte, shares how Trustpilot supports its mission to be the most recognized symbol of trust on the internet—between consumers and businesses—through the use of an event-driven architecture (EDA), powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS).

title: Toyota and CFS speed up engineering and design with AWS
summary: hear from the Toyota North America Emerging Technologies team and nuclear fusion startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) about how they use AWS products and services to improve design productivity, reduce costs, and accelerate the product development process.

title: How Toyota and VW build autonomous driving simulation and validation on AWS
summary: Hear from leading automotive companies on their progress toward autonomous driving with large-scale simulations and data ingestion.

title: TMR Migrates to the Cloud, Reskills Employees, and Builds a Culture of Collaboration Using AWS
customer: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR)
summary: TMR underwent an infrastructure migration to the cloud and now uses over 90 AWS services to achieve benefits such as cost transparency, faster time to value, enhanced security, and team collaboration.

title: Central Group’s The 1 Rearchitects Loyalty Program on AWS to Accelerate Analysis and Personalize Customer Experiences
summary: The 1 re-architected its data pipeline on AWS to improve query performance, access big data processing engines, and reduce infrastructure costs by 20 percent. Central Group is a leading Thai retail conglomerate whose loyalty program, The 1, has more than 19 million members.

title: Taxilla Runs on AWS Graviton Processors to Halve Data Processing Costs
summary: Taxilla migrated to AWS Graviton processors to halve the costs of data processing while maintaining equal performance levels. Taxilla is a compliance and digital transformation platform based in India that helps businesses capture and process big data for reporting.

title: Tapestry Gains 360-Degree View of Customers by Powering Data and Analytics on AWS
summary: Fashion house Tapestry has broken down data silos and expanded its ML capabilities by using Amazon API Gateway, helping it fulfill half a million API calls daily and personalized customer service.

title: SURF Brings Compute Power to Modern Research Using AWS
summary: SURF, the National Research and Education Network (NREN), has a publicly funded mission to bring the latest IT capabilities to education and research communities. In 2020, SURF called for proposals to support research projects using Amazon Web Services (AWS) across the Netherlands. It has since used AWS for projects focused on motor neurone disease, machine learning, and geodata for ecological insights. Bringing research loads to the cloud is shortening the journey from research to scientific discovery and making data more shareable and accessible.

title: Uso de Serviços Profissionais AWS reduz em 25% gastos totais com nuvem do Stoodi
summary: Criada em 2013, o Stoodi é uma startup de educação, parte do grupo Cogna, que tem o objetivo de ajudar estudantes do ensino médio a ingressarem no ensino superior. Desde sua fundação, os recursos de preparação para o Enem e vestibulares da startup foram utilizados por mais de 8 milhões de alunos. A operação do Stoodi já nasceu na nuvem AWS, mas o crescimento acelerado alavancado pelo período de pandemia exigiu da startup uma operação mais eficiente da nuvem, garantindo estabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança. O Stoodi passou a contar com a área de Professional Services da AWS, obtendo ganhos como redução anual total de 25% dos custos totais de AWS que foram parcialmente investidos para melhorar a estabilidade e postura de segurança dos seus produtos.

title: Starbucks Uses Data on AWS to Improve Customer Service
summary: The Starbucks analytics and data ecosystem is heavily reliant on its systems of record for digital ordering and loyalty that run on AWS.

title: Skyangel confía en AWS para proteger los activos de sus clientes en todas partes y en todo momento
summary: Skyangel es una compañía que se especializa en proveer servicios de rastreo, geolocalización y seguridad de activos en México, Estados Unidos y Centroamérica, y realiza más de 200 mil entregas exitosas al año. Hoy cuenta con más de 650 clientes y el más amplio conocimiento e innovación tecnológica. Desde 2016 trabajan con AWS, con quien lograron una flexibilidad que les permitió ajustar la operación a sus demandas, crecimiento y nuevos servicios; asimismo, obtuvieron una continuidad operativa que les permite brindar un servicio continuo las 24 horas de los 365 días del año.

title: Bogotá más limpia gracias a SIGAB, que vive en la nube de AWS
summary: El Sistema de Información para la Gestión y Operación del Servicio Público de Aseo de Bogotá (SIGAB) es el nuevo esquema de aseo para la ciudad de Bogotá, capital de Colombia, que cuenta con 7.9 millones de habitantes a 2022; a través de este sistema se da servicio a 2.5 millones de usuarios, con 588 camiones recolectores, que requerían tener un mayor control tanto de actividades como monitoreo de rutas y tiempos. El nuevo esquema de aseo requería información de la operación y gestión del servicio que prestan los concesionarios (Promoambiental Distrito, Limpieza Metropolitana, Cuidad Limpia, Bogotá Limpia y Área Limpia) en cada área de servicio exclusivo asignada, información que será consolidada en el SIGAB que usa los servicios de AWS para tener una disponibilidad de la información y la posibilidad de dar seguimiento en tiempo real al servicio.

title: Siemens Helps Companies Become Digital Enterprises
summary: Hear from Tosh Tambe, VP Software as a Service (SaaS) portfolio Strategy on how Siemens is helping make their software tools more accessible, scalable and flexible to reduce the time to value for their customers.

title: Siemens and Carrier: Smart manufacturing & supply chain in the cloud
summary: Siemens, Airbus, and Carrier discuss making industrial digital transformation faster, easier, and scalable.

title: Siemens Helps Shape the "Fourth Industrial Revolution" by Combining Its Software and AWS Cloud Capabilities
summary: Siemens is a global leader in software and automation for industry, infrastructure, and healthcare. 24 out of the 25 largest car manufacturers in the world use Siemens software—as do 92 percent of all Fortune 500 companies.

title: Nuvem AWS apoia jornada de transformação digital do Sicredi
summary: O Sicredi é uma instituição financeira cooperativa que conta hoje com mais de 2,4 mil agências e está presente fisicamente em todos os estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal, disponibilizando mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros. Com o objetivo de ampliar a sua base de associados, levando o cooperativismo de crédito para mais pessoas, desde 2016 o Sistema tem colocado em prática seu plano de transformação digital em um processo que, realizado na nuvem AWS, vem possibilitando a evolução dos sistemas que processas os produtos e serviços da instituição e a transformando sua área de TI em uma das mais desejadas para se trabalhar por profissionais brasileiros da área.

title: Shaadi.com Goes Serverless to Serve Its Growing User Base
summary: Shaadi.com is a pioneering matchmaking service that strives to provide Indians all over the world with quality matchmaking experiences. To capture a larger market share, Shaadi.com turned to AWS serverless computing. Shaadi.com reduced user profile activation time by more than 50 percent, and shortened the DevOps cycle timeframe from 2 months to 2 weeks.

title: El Servicio Cántabro de Salud mejora su servicio al ciudadano con AWS
summary: El Servicio Cántabro de Salud está haciendo una migración completa a SAP para la compra unificada de material sanitario, cambiando de un modelo on-premise a uno en la nube. La participación del Servicio Cántabro de Salud en el Proyecto EHDEN (para el almacenamiento y compartición de los historiales médicos) y del Proyecto CAÑIA (que emplea servicios de Inteligencia Artificial para reconocer el resultado de las pruebas Covid) también han sido posible gracias a las tecnologías de AWS.

title: Scuderia Ferrari utilizza l’IA e il ML su AWS per innovare e rafforzare il proprio vantaggio competitivo
summary: In collaborazione con Amazon Web Services (AWS), Scuderia Ferrari ha sviluppato un sensore virtuale di velocità al suolo, esterno all'auto, basato sull'intelligenza artificiale (IA) e sul machine learning (ML) grazie a Amazon SageMaker (SageMaker).

title: Scuderia Ferrari Uses AI and ML on AWS to Innovate—and Sharpen Its Competitive Edge
summary: Scuderia Ferrari comprises the racing division and teams of luxury Italian auto manufacturer, Ferrari S.p.Ais (Ferrari), based in Maranello, Italy.

title: Saras migliora le prestazioni e accelera la digital transformation con AWS
summary: Nell’ambito del percorso di trasformazione digitale, Saras, Gruppo italiano leader nei settori della raffinazione e dell’energia, ha scelto AWS per migrare in cloud una parte importante dei suoi applicativi. È riuscita non solo a guadagnare in prestazioni e flessibilità, ma anche a migliorare la business continuity. Ora Saras guarda al futuro con l’estensione delle tecnologie innovative come il machine learning e all’ottimizazione dei costi di gestione con i modelli FinOPS.

title: AWS re:Invent 2022: AWS on Air ft. Salesforce Genie's Integration with Amazon SageMaker
summary: Salesforce Genie is a new data platform that connects 300,000+ Salesforce customers’ marketing, sales, commerce, service, and IT teams with a single view of customer data, helping organizations to grow relationships with their customers and employees.

title: Salesforce’s journey of more than a billion messages: Innovating with AWS
summary: Salesforce migrates its legacy Messaging and Journeys (M&J) application from on premises to SQL Server on Amazon EC2, providing a secure, cloud-based solution that can reliably send 8 billion messages per day to consumers around the globe.

title: Salesforce Accommodates Data Residency and Deploys Hyperforce in 9 New Countries on AWS
summary: Ken D’Amico, Senior Vice President, Engineering, Salesforce discusses Hyperforce on AWS, a new infrastructure architecture that allows Salesforce to scale rapidly and securely using public cloud partners like AWS. By working with AWS, Salesforce was able to establish a presence in more countries and quickly accommodate data residency and data sovereignty regulations.

title: Nuvem AWS alavanca expansão da Sala do Saber
summary: Uma das maiores plataformas de ensino online do Brasil, a Sala do Saber foi criada em 2015. Com o crescimento de suas operações, quatro anos depois, a iniciativa enfrentava o desafio de entregar suas videoaulas sem latência para seus alunos, além de reduzir os custos operacionais de sua plataforma. A solução foi a migração do processamento e otimização de seus vídeos para a nuvem AWS e o posterior desenvolvimento de APIs com múltiplas integrações de serviços AWS.

title: RTVC utiliza AWS para llevar contenidos al 93% de la población en Colombia
summary: Radio Televisión Nacional de Colombia (RTVC) es el sistema de medios públicos de los colombianos. Con una cobertura cercana al 93% de la población total, RTVC es la única opción en muchos lugares de Colombia para acceder a contenidos de entretenimiento, informativos y culturales. La compañía tenía los desafíos de aumentar la flexibilidad en la operación, la eficiencia en el gasto y de eliminar activos por obsolescencia. Para eso implementó la tecnología en la nube de AWS. RTVC tiene con AWS más de 25 servicios en la actualidad

title: RS2 Speeds Up Customer Onboarding for BankWORKS Payment Platform Using AWS
summary: Payment technology company RS2 moved its BankWORKS payment processing platform to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to support growth. BankWORKS helps over 250 banks and financial services businesses to execute 80 million transactions an hour. Created by RS2, BankWORKS struggled to maintain growth because of lengthy customer onboarding times. Using AWS, BankWORKS has reduced customer onboarding to 1 month from as much as 1 year and can quickly scale compute resources to accommodate increased demand for its platform. The IT team has also reduced maintenance tasks so it can focus on improving its core products.

title: Rotoplas reduce en un 50% los tiempos de downtime de sistemas con migración de su negocio a la nube en tiempo récord
summary: Grupo Rotoplas es una empresa mexicana con presencia en 15 países y con 27 líneas de productos, 17 plantas, más de 3,300 colaboradores y 12 mil distribuidores. Posee 29 mil puntos de venta y 50 mil puntos de servicios. La empresa contaba con un data center propio para su operación desde Estados Unidos hasta Argentina, y ante la edad de sus 300 servidores y la demanda por más capacidad, buscaron un proveedor que les ayudara a tener mayor escalabilidad, seguridad y disponibilidad. AWS fue su aliado en la migración de su negocio a la nube, la cual, además, se realizó en tiempo récord.

title: Ricoh Singapore Drives Innovation, Flexibility, and Cost Savings by Migrating Windows Workloads to AWS
summary: Ricoh Singapore migrates its Windows applications to AWS without impacting customers, giving sales teams remote demo capabilities, allowing the IT team to focus on innovation instead of IT, and achieving double-digit cost savings. The company is a leading manufacturer of office automation equipment.

title: AWS Announces Two New Capabilities to Move Toward a Zero-ETL Future on AWS
summary: At AWS re:Invent, Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced two new integrations that make it easier for customers to connect and analyze data across data stores without having to move data between services.

title: AWS Announces Eight New Amazon SageMaker Capabilities
summary: At AWS re:Invent, Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced eight new capabilities for Amazon SageMaker, its end-to-end machine learning (ML) service.

title: AWS Announces Five New Capabilities for Amazon QuickSight
summary: At AWS re:Invent, Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced five new capabilities to help customers streamline business intelligence (BI) operations using Amazon QuickSight, the most popular serverless BI service built for the cloud

title: Executive insights panel: Changing your culture in the age of cloud
summary: In this session, learn how leaders that focus on cultivating a cloud-ready culture can help their organizations become more innovative.

title: AWS Announces Five New Database and Analytics Capabilities
summary: At AWS re:Invent, Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced five new capabilities across its database and analytics portfolios that make it faster and easier for customers to manage and analyze data at petabyte scale.

title: AWS Announces Amazon DataZone
summary: At AWS re:Invent, Amazon Web Services Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced Amazon DataZone, a new data management service that makes it faster and easier for customers to catalog, discover, share, and govern data stored across AWS, on-premises, and third-party sources.

title: Razer Achieves Over 70 Percent Cost Savings in Compute Spend Using Amazon EC2 Spot Instances and Amazon ECS
summary: Razer, a leading lifestyle brand for gamers, achieved affordability by running over 80 percent of its Amazon EC2 instances, including all production workloads, on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances.

title: Raiffeisen Bank International startet skalierbare Finanzplattform mit AWS
summary: Vor etwa 5 Jahren brauchte Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) eine Veränderung. Die IT-Organisation hatte Schwierigkeiten, die von der RBI erwartete Agilität und Flexibilität zu bieten. Die Mitarbeiter waren damit beschäftigt, Kapazitätsprobleme zu lösen und den Datenverarbeitungsbedarf zu decken, also beschloss die Bank, alle neuen Initiativen mit Blick auf eine Cloud-Lösung zu entwickeln.

title: Raiffeisen Bank International Launches Scalable Finance Platform Using AWS
summary: RBI selected Amazon Web Services (AWS) as its first public cloud provider and began developing the Merlin platform, which would support its ambition to create and provide digital products that were more customer focused. These products include a mobile banking app, its corporate web portal, and open banking capabilities compliant with the Revised Payment Services Directive regulations.

title: Estrutura em nuvem AWS permite à Quasar levar serviços a pequenos municípios
summary: Criada em 2019, a Quasar é uma consultoria especializada no desenvolvimento de softwares de gestão pública. No início de 2021, a empresa fechou um grande contrato com o governo de Minas Gerais, que representou crescimento e, ao mesmo tempo, o desafio de adequar seus preços para que pudesse levar suas soluções a municípios com até 20 mil habitantes. Com o apoio da AWS, a Quasar conseguiu redesenhar sua arquitetura, reduzindo seus custos em 90% e deixando-a pronta para atender este novo público.

title: Puraset Provides Safe Drinking Water to At-Risk Communities Using AWS
summary: Puraset aims to create a solution that can deliver safe drinking water for less than a tenth of the cost that people were paying for bottled water in at-risk communities. The Hungary-based company uses AWS to remotely manage its innovative, portable water treatment units from anywhere in the world. Using AWS IoT Core, Puraset can monitor its PurAID portable water purifiers to ensure they are operating effectively in the field with just two operators for up to 100 units. It can also collect and analyze usage data to improve the quality of water treatment over time, and ease infrastructure maintenance so that it can focus on designing long-term solutions for the developing world.

title: Prime Focus Technologies Gains Speed and Agility for its Media ERP Platform on the AWS Cloud
summary: Prime Focus Technologies (PFT) manages 14 million assets annually with over 13.5 PB of total storage used on the cloud. By migrating one of its on-premises data center at a colocation facility to AWS, PFT improved its customer experience by cutting average customer onboarding time from 5 to 3 weeks.

tag_names.fsx-windows: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

title: Postis Simplifies International Deliveries Using ML and AWS SageMaker
summary: Postis provides a real-time digital platform for logistics automation, optimization, and tracking, helping retailers and delivery companies master the last mile of the journey to their customers, ensuring a good experience from ordering all the way through to receiving goods. The fast-growing Romanian startup uses machine learning to help sellers find the most suitable and cost-effective delivery solution for every type of product, customer journey, or destination. It used AWS to create a scalable system with the power to run heavy machine learning workloads and support its global growth. Postis now serves more than 200 customers in 25 countries using AWS, including big names such as Ikea, Carrefour, Auchan, and Intersport.

title: Speed Up Development Times Using S3 and IAM with Pinterest
summary: In this video, learn how Pinterest uses Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to create a FGAC system to speed up development times.

title: How Pinterest Engaged with AWS Proserve to Ensure Pinners have Always-On Access to their Platform
summary: Pinterest is a visual-discovery platform and social commerce network with a mission to inspire. Building on AWS storage and compute solutions, Pinterest uses sophisticated machine learning engines to deliver personalized content to its users.

title: Philips HealthSuite Platform Delivers Insights at Scale on AWS
summary: Dr. Shez Partovi, Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer, discusses how Philips enables customers to unlock insights at scale from their data by using cloud health applications running on HealthSuite Platform (HSP) built on AWS.

title: PayU Helps Customers Make Secure Online Payments Faster by Streamlining Firewall Management on AWS
summary: PayU improves application performance by 50 percent, increases intrusion protection, and cuts audit time from days to minutes. The company provides payment gateway solutions to online businesses worldwide, serving more than 4.5 million merchants across India.

title: Paytron Launches and Scales Global Payments Platform Processing Millions of Dollars of Monthly Payments on AWS
summary: Paytron launches its business on AWS and process millions of dollars of payments per month in more than 180 countries, deploys new features 20 times daily, launches new corporate credit card, and attracts top engineering talent.

title: Paytm Supports Rapid Growth with Robust Reporting by Migrating to SAP on AWS
summary: By migrating its SAP applications to AWS, Paytm gains scalability and stability, increases invoices processed per minute by thousandfold, completes reports in 4 hours instead of 30 hours, and decreases backup times by 60 percent.

title: Papyrus Studio Creates Brand New Service Stream on AWS
summary: Papyrus Studio is a Thailand-based company that provides visual effects and animation services for films, television shows, commercials, as well as video games. It chose to work with AWS as the AWS Cloud would provide the flexibility to adapt to future business needs without overcommitting on its initial budgets.

title: La piattaforma dati di Openpay su AWS guida l'espansione e l'innovazione a livello internazionale
summary: Openpay utilizza l'intero stack tecnologico su Amazon Web Services (AWS), dall'integrazione sicura delle applicazioni con i commercianti alla facilitazione ed elaborazione delle richieste di prestito fino all'informazione dei richiedenti se le loro richieste di prestito hanno avuto successo.

title: Openpay Transforms Its Contact Center to Gain a 360-Degree View of Customers and Support Growth
summary: By using Amazon Connect, Openpay integrated its customer contact center and CRM system, improving customer service, resolving customer queries faster, and reducing costs by 30 percent.

title: Openpay’s Data Platform on AWS Fuels International Expansion and Innovation
summary: Openpay obtains the data for global reporting in 20 seconds and can build reports in 30 minutes using AWS. Openpay is an Australian fintech that offers “buy now, pay smarter” services to consumers online and in-store.

title: OLX Autos Consolidates Workloads on AWS to Improve Stability and Reduce Operational Complexity
summary: OLX Autos switched from a multi-cloud to a single-cloud environment on AWS to reduce engineering complexity, eliminate downtime and lags, and save $333,000 per year. OLX Autos is a global marketplace for buying and selling used vehicles and belongs to the OLX Group.

title: Create from Anywhere: The Netflix Workstations Story
summary: In this re:Invent 2022 session, learn how Netflix used AWS services such as NICE DCV, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) G4 instances, and also the open source continuous delivery platform, Spinnaker, developed by Netflix as its workstation solution.

title: Netflix Catalogs Objects Across Hybrid Cloud Storage Systems
summary: In this re:Invent 2022 session, learn how Netflix uses a hybrid cloud storage solution that combines Amazon Web Services (AWS) and on-premesis storage.

title: Netflix: Hybrid cloud approach to cataloging objects across storage systems
summary: learn how Netflix tracks, stores and moves assets across its hybrid cloud consisting of object stores and file systems.

title: The Evolution of Chaos Engineering at Netflix
summary: hear how Netflix has evolved chaos engineering into the discipline of infrastructure experimentation.

title: Netflix Drive: Cloud Filesystem in Studio Workflows
summary: Learn about the architecture that provides Netflix artists with a secure, performant, and seamless storage interface using Amazon S3.

title: How Netflix Plans Optimal Capacity in the Cloud
summary: Learn how Netflix selects the right Amazon EC2 options for a multitude of different stateful and stateless workloads that need different combinations of CPU, RAM, disk, and network.

title: Netflix Builds Resilient Multi-Site Workloads Using AWS Global Services
summary: Netflix uses AWS Global Infrastructure to create zonal, regional, and global services that prevent single points of failure.

title: Netflix Accelerates Insights Using AWS SDK Instrumentation
summary: Learn how Netflix Migrates application identity across AWS accounts and fills gaps in cloud data sources by instrumenting AWS SDKs to create new categories of visibility.

title: Netflix Reimagines Multi-Account Deployments for Security and Speed
summary: Netflix shares a new paradigm for multi-account architecture based on decoupling a workload’s identity and permissions from its underlying cloud infrastructure.

title: Nasdaq: Compute innovation to enable any application in the cloud
summary: Nasdaq discusses how AWS has developed custom silicon optimized for the cloud and how you can take advantage of AWS compute innovations including processors, machine learning chips, and high-performance storage products.

title: How Nasdaq get clarity on data in seconds with Amazon QuickSight Q
summary: Amazon QuickSight Q is a machine learning–powered natural language capability that empowers business users to ask questions about all of their data using everyday business language and get answers in seconds.

title: Nasdaq: Moving mission-critical, low-latency workloads to AWS
summary: Nasdaq is migrating its first US options market, Nasdaq MRX, to the cloud using edge compute capabilities available in jointly engineered AWS Outposts that are tailored to its ultra–low latency needs.

title: AWS se convierte en un acelerador del time to market en Naranja X
summary: Naranja X es una fintech argentina, siendo la tarjeta de crédito más elegida del país. La empresa se convirtió en una plataforma de acceso a productos y servicios financieros, y quiere dar oportunidades a millones de personas que quedan afuera del sistema financiero tradicional. Sus productos digitales son 100% cloud native, con infraestructura full AWS Cloud, con más de 140 cuentas, 100+ contenedores en Amazon EKS, más de 500 instancias de procesamiento en Amazon EC2, aproximadamente 7 mil funciones AWS Lambda y con más de 1500 tablas en Amazon DynamoDB.

title: La Municipalidad de San Luis consolida su infraestructura de nube para ofrecer mejores servicios al vecino
summary: Luego de migrar a la nube de AWS con el apoyo de Nubilink, la Municipalidad de San Luis solucionó el problema de inestabilidad de su plataforma tecnológica y hoy avanza en su proyecto de digitalización.

title: Comment Molotov vous fait adorer la télévision grâce à Ynpact et AWS
summary: Molotov, service de distribution de chaînes de télévision par Internet, s’est retrouvé lors des confinements confronté à des hausses de trafic importantes qui ont poussé son architecture à ses limites. La migration des multiples services qui sous-tendent Molotov sur le Cloud AWS, effectuée avec l’aide d’Ynpact, AWS Select Consulting Partner, a dé-risqué la plateforme, tout en permettant à Molotov de développer sa culture DevOps.

title: How Moderna and Takeda accelerate drug research using real-world data
summary: Moderna and Takeda, walk you through why they have adopted AWS Data Exchange and Amazon Redshift as integral components of their Real World Data strategy.

title: Commercial innovation at Moderna using Amazon Connect and AI
summary: learn how Moderna built an omnichannel AI engine using Amazon Lex, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Connect that can detect multifunctional intent and triage data into systems interconnected with categorical databases.

title: Moderna on AWS
summary: Founded in 2010, Moderna, Inc. is a biotechnology company pioneering a new class of messenger RNA (mRNA) medicines. Moderna has selected AWS as its preferred cloud provider, as well as its standard for analytics and machine learning workloads.

title: Miro Drives 500% Growth in Online Whiteboard Customers and Boosts Security Using AWS
summary: The accelerated adoption of remote and hybrid working over the last 2 years brought about an unprecedented need for businesses to collaborate virtually. Miro was on the front line of this rapid change. It provides an online whiteboarding platform that allows teams to collaborate from wherever they are in the world. When employees were required to work from home during the COVID-19 pandemic, Miro usage surged. Its user base grew by 500 percent to reach 30 million in January 2022. This includes both individual users and employees at its more than 130,000 paying customers, including 99 percent of the Fortune 100. Using Amazon Web Services (AWS), Miro drove this expansion and provided a reliable, speedy, and secure experience for its customers throughout the pandemic and beyond.

title: Mindtickle Expands to New Regions in One Day with Platform Automation on AWS
summary: Mindtickle automates more than 95 percent of deployment components, expands to new regions in one day instead of 6–8 months, lowers disaster recovery costs, and ensures data sovereignty and compliance by running on AWS. Mindtickle provides a platform for businesses to prepare and train their sales representatives.

title: METRON décarbone les entreprises du monde entier grâce à l’agilité de sa plateforme SaaS hébergée sur AWS
summary: METRON accompagne les industriels dans la gestion de leur énergie via une plateforme logicielle METRON SaaS afin de réduire leur empreinte carbone. Grâce à la couverture mondiale d’AWS, METRON peut implémenter sa plateforme SaaS pour fournir une visibilité complète de la gestion de l’énergie et les opportunités d'optimisation (Energy Management & Optimisation System) d’un site ou de plusieurs sites, en France et dans le monde.

title: Metro Brands Achieves 60% Data Compression and Resolves Server Lags by Migrating to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
summary: By leveraging Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, Metro Brands achieved a data deduplication ratio of 60 percent, reducing server maintenance time and resolving performance lags.

title: How customers bring Metaverse experiences to life with EC2 accelerated computing
summary: Learn how metaverse experiences are creating results for 3D content creation, product design, skilling, gaming, interactive events, and XR streaming

title: The Government of India Powers a Population-Scale Vaccine Drive on AWS
customer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: India’s Ministry of Health and Family Welfare engaged the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology to launch a countrywide scalable, resilient COVID-19 management portal powered by AWS.

title: Conexión de las operaciones del hospital con plataformas basadas en la nube AWS
summary: Saludness, una plataforma de atención médica en línea creada por la empresa Medicalware, sirve como una ubicación centralizada para archivos clínicos, citas, recetas, resultados de laboratorio, transferencias y todos los modelos que necesita una clínica u hospital.

title: AWS ayuda Mediastream a llevar servicios escalables a cualquier lugar del mundo
summary: Mediastream es una compañía que ayuda a los medios y a las grandes empresas que quieren usar las tecnologías de streaming de forma fácil. La empresa lleva más de 15 años en el mercado, con clientes en toda Latinoamérica, parte de Europa e los EE.UU. En este video, Luis Ahumada, fundador y CEO de Mediastream, detalla la evolución del uso de los servicios AWS en la compañía, lo que, sin embargo, formó las bases para que Mediastream lograra escalar y tener la infraestructura rápida y disponible para prestar servicios eficientes en cualquier lugar del mundo.

title: Malaysiakini Delivers Fast, Timely News to 1M+ Concurrent Viewers During Peak Periods at Half the IT Cost
summary: Malaysiakini migrated to AWS and halved its infrastructure costs, thanks to improved visibility into technology components and granular control of integrated compute and storage services. Malaysiakini is a leading independent media outlet in Malaysia, serving more than 10 million monthly viewers.

title: Lyell Immunopharma Creates Next-Frontier Cell Therapy to Precisely Target Cancerous Tissue, on AWS
summary: In this video, Liz Homans, chief executive officer (CEO) of Lyell, discusses the company’s next-frontier work in cell therapy, powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS).

title: Lion Parcel Gains Faster Data Insights on AWS to Enhance Customer Experience
summary: Lion Parcel built an end-to-end data pipeline in AWS in just six weeks, to speed up reporting and integrate machine learning for customer segmentation. Lion Parcel is a logistics company operating under the Lion Group Indonesia.

title: LINE GAMES Runs Its Global Infrastructure on AWS To Deliver Richer Customer Experiences
summary: Line Games develops and publishes mobile and PC games. After its first successful migration to AWS in 2016, Line Games has subsequently moved all its games and platforms to the AWS environment. It currently runs over 30 games globally, with more to be released to the global market.

title: Lensa Builds a Fast, Smart, and Scalable Job Search Platform Using AWS
summary: Hungary-based Lensa built a smart and scalable job search platform for the US market on AWS. It uses a wide variety of AWS solutions to collect and analyze vast quantities of data that connect employers with potential employees.

title: Completed 25PB large data migration in 2 years using 252 AWS Snowball Edges
summary: Completed 25PB large data migration in 2 years using 252 AWS Snowball Edges

title: Grupo Kaufmann aumenta ventas y la satisfacción de clientes con estrategia de datos basada en AWS
summary: Con presencia en Chile, Perú, Costa Rica y Panamá, Grupo Kaufmann tiene más de 2.300 colaboradores. El grupo está en la industria de automóviles y vehículos comerciales, y su área de analítica avanzada tenía el desafío de poder desarrollar soluciones basadas en datos de forma ágil y escalable para llevar los mejores servicios a los clientes. Para lograrlo, eligieron al partner Arkho, que les ayudó a dar vida a su estrategia de datos. En este video, Pablo Ardiles, Chief Data Officer de Kaufmann, detalla como la compañía está utilizando servicios como Amazon S3, Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon Athena y AWS Glue para desarrollar soluciones internas y externas que aumentaron sus ventas y la satisfacción de los clientes, generando revenue de forma incremental al negocio.

title: K9 Group triple son rythme d’innovation avec SAP sur AWS
summary: K9 Group bénéficie d’un environnement SAP plus agile et avantageux depuis sa migration vers AWS, et déploie de nouvelles fonctionnalités et applications trois fois plus rapidement. Le groupe gère les principaux revendeurs SAP et Partenaires Consultants Avancés AWS en France. Il a utilisé SAP ECC 6 sur des instances Amazon EC2 avec Amazon S3 et il convertit son environnement cloud vers SAP S/4HANA.

title: AWS ayuda a transformar JPS de una organización tradicional a una digital
summary: Jamaica Public Service (JPS) es el único distribuidor de electricidad en Jamaica. Hace aproximadamente tres años, la empresa tenía el desafío de poner una gran cantidad de información disponible para todos sus clientes. Con el apoyo de AWS, la compañía comenzó su camino hacia la transformación digital, moviendo su servicio al cliente de una manera rápida y eficiente, así como mejorando su rentabilidad a través de la nube AWS. Garry Barrow, director de operaciones en JPS, y Phillip Hamilton, especialista en TI para Infraestructura de la compañía, explican cómo lograron la capacidad de brindar soluciones en cuestión de minutos en lugar de semanas y ahorrar en almacenamiento al menos un 40%.

title: AWS Supports JPS on its Transformation Journey from Traditional to Digital
summary: Jamaica Public Service (JPS) is the only distributor of electricity in Jamaica. About three years ago, the company was challenged to make a vast amount of information available to all of its customers. Using Amazon Web Services (AWS) solutions, the company began its journey toward digital transformation, moving its customer service quickly and efficiently, as well as improving its profitability through the AWS Cloud.

title: AWS ayuda a transformar JPS de una organización tradicional a una digital

title: Modernizando a agricultura em grande escala com a nuvem AWS
summary: A Jotabasso é uma empresa brasileira de sementes e agricultura com sede no Cerrado, que é uma ecorregião de savana tropical que se estende por grande parte do Brasil central e se tornou popular para atividades agrícolas no final dos anos 1990 e início dos anos 2000. A empresa também trabalha com diversos setores de diferentes operações agrícolas. A Jotabasso se originou no Rio Grande do Sul antes de se mudar para a região do Cerrado na década de 1970. Foi uma das primeiras empresas de sementes daquela região e hoje tem mais de 900 funcionários, com cinco unidades de produção nas áreas centrais do Brasil. Hoje, a empresa é especializada no plantio de soja e outros grãos, como trigo, milho e sorgo, que são usados principalmente como ração animal. A Jotabasso também se aventurou na criação de gado de corte. A organização opera grandes laboratórios de análise de sementes e instalações de armazenamento e criou um sistema integrado de lavoura-pecuária e confinamento para ajudar os agricultores a aumentar a produtividade e a sustentabilidade. Para manter e expandir todas as suas atividades com maior eficiência, a Jotabasso decidiu procurar um provedor de nuvem que pudesse hospedar seus dados e ajudar a empresa a criar soluções tecnológicas inovadoras para suas operações e usuários.

title: iTom Boosts Business and Scales for Growth Using AWS
summary: iTom is a software development company based in Romania that creates innovative SaaS solutions to help the digitalization efforts of its customers. When it expanded into financial services, it turned to AWS to provide high levels of security and ensure compliance with European and local regulations. Using AWS, iTom can better manage its infrastructure and prevent unauthorized or accidental access to customer data by potential intruders or even its own staff. It has also improved its development processes so its entire team can proactively innovate and update features that improve the customer experience, rather than spending time maintaining infrastructure and reacting to problems.

title: Itaú Unibanco acelera desenvolvimento do Pix na nuvem AWS
summary: O Itaú Unibanco possui hoje a maior implementação de Pix do país, chegando a processar 20,9 milhões de transações diárias. Criado pelo Banco Central do Brasil, o serviço está disponível 24 horas por dia, sete dias por semana e sua operação é autorizada em mais de 700 instituições. Para atender os prazos determinados pelo Bacen para sua implementação, e a escalabilidade exigida pelo serviço, o Itaú fez 100% do desenvolvimento na nuvem AWS.

title: Itaú Unibanco entende perfil de 65 milhões de clientes com serviços AWS
summary: Ricardo Guerra, CIO do Itaú Unibanco, divide um pouco da história de transformação digital da instituição. Ele explica que, na visão do banco, transformar-se tecnologicamente significa olhar para os pilares de tecnologia, o uso de dados em escala e a capacidade de inovar, tudo para entender o comportamento e as necessidades dos seus cerca de 65 milhões de clientes. Para contar com a modernização e flexibilidade necessárias para promover essa transformação, a instituição fechou um contrato de longo prazo com a AWS. Veja como o banco realizou, a partir do uso de tecnologias AWS, mais de 100 mil implantações em 2021, reduziu em 75% os incidentes que impactam o cliente e criou o Pix 100% na nuvem AWS, sendo responsável hoje por 20% de todo o volume de PIX no Brasil.

title: Banco Itaú automatiza processo e reduz tempo de criação de contas AWS em mais de 4.000%
summary: Ao adotar a estratégia de modernização e migração de aplicações críticas para a nuvem, a área de Engenharia de Cloud do Itaú Unibanco estabeleceu como objetivo prover Cloud AWS como autosserviço para as áreas de Engenharia consumidoras da plataforma. Utilizando a abordagem de micro segmentação de contas, um dos desafios envolvidos era a automação do processo de criação de contas. No início esse processo levava em média 60 horas e, com o apoio da AWS, a instituição financeira conseguiu automatizar 100% do processo de criação de contas, reduzindo seu prazo para 1h20.

title: Itaú Unibanco acelera em 10x a análise de dados para ações de marketing com AWS
summary: O Itaú Unibanco vem investindo na modernização de sua plataforma tecnológica para incrementar os níveis de atração, retenção e engajamento de seus Clientes. Particularmente, a equipe de Cloud for Marketing busca entender melhor o comportamento deste Cliente quando está fora do ambiente Itaú, para oferecer produtos e serviços que façam sentido para seu momento de vida.

title: IPS utiliza tecnología en la nube para implementar la Pensión Garantizada Universal y llevar mejores servicios a 2 millones de chilenos
summary: El Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS) es la institución responsable de acercar diversos beneficios previsionales y sociales a las personas. En enero pasado, tras la aprobación de la Pensión Garantizada Universal (PGU), tuvo que poner en marcha un rápido proceso de habilitación de la plataforma digital para soportar un proceso de carga masiva de consultas en forma simultánea -lo que abarcaría a cerca de 2 millones de personas- además de estar disponible para recibir solicitudes del beneficio. La tecnología en la nube de AWS fue clave para que en solo seis días esta plataforma quedara a disposición de la ciudadanía, para atender las solicitudes de los usuarios que aumentaron en casi un 900%.

summary: learn how to use Amazon SageMaker Studio notebooks to perform end-to-end ML development in one unified notebook, driving seamless collaboration across data science, analytics, and engineering teams.

summary: The Intuit Data Exchange platform team migrates more than 120 TiB of data to Amazon Keyspaces, while delivering high availability and reliability to their users, using a dual-write approach.

summary: Intuit shares how to design a contact center for highly resilient operations at any scale with Amazon Connect.
