summary: Disney and Intuit are at the forefront of digital transformation, using modern application architectures like microservices as adaptive mechanisms for delivering value to customers at high velocity

title: Intraway Creates a High-Availability, Resilient, Multi-region Telecommunications Product on AWS
summary: Intraway and its software as a service (SaaS) orchestration solution, Symphonica, lead in cloud-based, no-code automation open source software systems for telecommunications providers. Headquartered in the United States, Intraway also has offices in Argentina, Colombia, Mexico, Peru and Uruguay. The company developed a high-resilience solution capable of operating across Amazon Web Services (AWS) multi-regions. Because of its innovative and disruptive approach, Symphonica provides new services faster with improved customer service quality.

title: InfoCert si affida a AWS per supportare l’espansione dei servizi in Europa e soddisfare le esigenze di sicurezza e durabilità dei dati
summary: La digitalizzazione di un numero sempre più elevato di processi nei settori delle imprese e della Pubblica Amministrazione spinge InfoCert a cercare una maggiore scalabilità per sostenere la crescita, migrando i dati dei clienti in cloud. Grazie ai servizi di Amazon Web Services (AWS), disponibili nella Regione AWS Europe (Milano), InfoCert può archiviare i dati in Italia, aumentando anche il livello di flessibilità.

title: ILSP redefine la administración de riesgo en la indústria con el apoyo de AWS
summary: ILSP es una compañía dedicada a la administración del riesgo logístico con más de 3,000 colaboradores. A medida que su negocio expandía, surgió la necessidad de ampliar su infraestrutura limitada para corregir problemas de ancho de banda, de calidad de sonido, etc. En este video, Pablo Ramírez, Tech Division Director de ILSP, explica de que manera soluciones como Amazon Connect y microsservicios Lambda le han permitido a la empresa redefinir la administración de riesgo en la indústria, dando una propuesta de valor al cliente. Ramírez también afirma que, con las soluciones de AWS implementadas con el apoyo de AWS Professional Services, ILSP pudo evolucionar y transformarse, mejorando el impacto en la materialización de riesgo en un 80%.

title: iFood utiliza treinamentos AWS para acelerar inovação interna
summary: Líder no segmento de delivery de alimentos na América Latina, há anos o iFood vem se destacando como empresa orientada a dados. Usuária de uma série de serviços da AWS, que permitem a utilização da Inteligência Artificial como elemento chave de seu crescimento, a companhia decidiu investir nos treinamentos técnicos de seu time interno, acelerando iniciativas de inovação com reflexo direto na melhoria da experiência de seus clientes.

title: IBS Software Stays Agile and Accelerates Innovation for the Global Travel and Hospitality Industry with SaaS on AWS
summary: IBS Software offers its SaaS solutions on the AWS Cloud for increased flexibility and agility, using AWS Graviton-based instances for lower costs and higher performance.

title: Fireside Chat: Banco Inter Grows to Over 20 Million Customers, Supported by IBM SaaS on AWS
summary: Learn how Strategic Alliance Partner, IBM, drives its Software as a Service (SaaS) transformation on AWS, with 19 products targeted to launch on AWS over the next 18 months.

title: HeyJobs Matches Millions of Candidates with Potential New Jobs, Cuts Costs by 30% Using AWS
summary: German recruitment technology company HeyJobs has developed a talent platform using Amazon Web Services (AWS) that simplifies and automates the job search and application process for millions of professionals. The platform uses machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) to locate and match the right job to the most qualified candidate. Using AWS, HeyJobs has simplified its IT and reduced costs by 30 percent, while increasing its responsiveness to customer needs and supporting rapid growth and innovation.

title: HealthPlix Empowers Doctors in India with AI-Powered Electronic Medical Records Platform on AWS
summary: HealthPlix Technologies relies on scalable data and storage architecture on AWS to expand its electronic medical record (EMR) platform, which is currently used by 2 percent of India’s population. HealthPlix aims to improve health outcomes throughout India and make doctors’ lives easier with its cloud-based EMR solution.

title: Grupo Bimbo reduce en un 75% los abandonos de llamadas y mejora la experiencia del cliente
summary: Con presencia en 33 países de América, Europa, Asia y África, Grupo Bimbo es una empresa multinacional mexicana que cuenta con un volumen de ventas anuales de 15 mil millones de dólares. Cuenta con 135 mil colaboradores, ​ 208 plantas panificadoras, ​ 2.9 millones de puntos de venta y una red de distribución con 57 mil rutas en todo el planeta. ​ Grupo Bimbo opera más de 100 marcas y más de 13 mil productos. Gracias a AWS hoy se tienen procesos estándar para escuchar y atender a los clientes, teniendo además mayor visibilidad de la atención que se le da a éstos y a los consumidores.

title: Growy Builds Circular and Autonomous Vertical Farms with Automated Robotics on AWS
summary: Growy is a Netherlands-based startup that builds fully automated, circular vertical farms where robots tend to plants instead of humans. Using AWS IoT Events, the company can manage its costs effectively and compete in the low-margin farming business. AWS also provides a reliable and flexible infrastructure to support innovative agricultural methods. Growy uses AWS to replicate this automated approach and quickly launch new farms around the world, which it can control from its Amsterdam headquarters.

title: GREENFEED Strengthens Production from Farm to Table with Big Data Pipeline on AWS
summary: GREENFEED VIETNAM is a leading agriculture-based company with three integrated divisions: feed, farms, and food. As part of its digital transformation, GREENFEED built a data pipeline on the AWS Cloud to eliminate data siloes.

title: Governança Brasil amplia em 40% o número de clientes em nuvem
summary: A Governança Brasil – GOVBR – é uma companhia privada focada no desenvolvimento de soluções de governança para o setor público. Há dois anos, a companhia percebeu que contar com suas soluções em nuvem era primordial para atender grandes e pequenas cidades em todo o território nacional que têm grande necessidade de infraestrutura, porém quase sempre não possuem recursos tecnológicos para hospedar e dar suporte às aplicações. Há cerca de três anos, a empresa ofereceu ao mercado a versão em nuvem de sua plataforma e, somente no estado de São Paulo, o número de clientes saltou de 4 para 70.

title: Reinventing financial data analytics on AWS with Goldmach Sachs
summary: In this video, learn how Goldman Sachs is addressing this challenge by building a cloud-native, modular, and integrated collection of services to enable innovation in financial data analytics.

title: Godrej Housing Finance Achieves Faster Time to Market and Fuels Innovation on AWS
summary: Godrej Housing Finance continues to focus on growing its business and enriching its SecOps pipeline on AWS. Its business model emphasizes continuous improvement to deliver the best possible experience for its customers.

title: GoDB Tech Helps Insurers Process 10 Million Policies a Year with Insillion on AWS
summary: GoDB Tech runs its Insillion platform on AWS to process 10 million insurance policies a year and onboard customers in three weeks. A software company, GoDB Tech solves business challenges for customers in insurance and manufacturing by developing mission-critical digital applications.

title: AWS ayuda a reducir la burocracia y acelerar la transformación digital en Buenos Aires
summary: El Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires es uno de los más importantes de Argentina. Uno de sus principales intereses es poner a los ciudadanos en el centro de las diversas decisiones políticas. Para ello resulta importante tener consolidada la información que el GCABA genera y recolecta para llevar adelante la operación que está en cabeza de las diferentes dependencias con el fin de posibilitar un re-diseño más efectivo de las políticas públicas en base a datos. Dichos datos están siendo consolidados en PIBA (Plataforma Inteligente de Buenos Aires), desarrollada en la nube de AWS.

title: Com serviços AWS, Gerencianet desenvolve nova infraestrutura para oferta do Pix a mais de 290 mil clientes
summary: Com quase 300 mil clientes cadastrados em todo o Brasil, a Gerencianet é uma conta digital focada em negócios para que empreendedores possam emitir e gerenciar recebimentos. Ela realizou, somente em 2021, mais de 60 milhões de cobranças, atendendo pessoas físicas e jurídicas que desejam receber suas cobranças de forma facilitada, agilizando processos operacionais. Para disponibilizar o Pix aos seus clientes dentro do prazo determinado pelo Banco Central, a Gerencianet utilizou uma série de serviços AWS, que possibilitaram a construção de uma nova infraestrutura adequada às demandas do novo serviço.

title: Geopagos logra más productividad y velocidad de desarrollo con servicios AWS
summary: Geopagos es la infraestructura de aceptación de pagos de Latinoamérica. La empresa opera en más de 15 países y procesa más de 150 millones de transacciones al año con un volumen de aproximadamente US$ 4 billones anuales. Geopagos adoptó los servicios de AWS, evitando así la carga operativa que significa gestionar y mantener su infraestructura. Esto permite que sus desarrolladores puedan enfocarse en la creación de nuevos productos. Actualmente utilizan servicios como Amazon Elastic compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), Amazon ElasticCache, Amazon Route 53 y Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).

title: GBM obtiene mayor fiabilidad gracias a un enfoque que prioriza AWS Marketplace
summary: El Grupo Bursátil Mexicano (GBM) ofrece productos y servicios financieros a empresas, instituciones y firmas de inversión. GBM se propuso fortalecer la fiabilidad de la infraestructura del sistema backend y, a través de Amazon Web Services (AWS), descubrió varias soluciones innovadoras que previamente no conocía. La compañía ahora administra 16 soluciones (cifra que va en aumento) adquiridas en AWS Marketplace y obtiene beneficios que van más allá del fortalecimiento de la fiabilidad del sistema. Entre los beneficios, se incluye un ahorro medio del 30 % en todas las adquisiciones hechas en AWS Marketplace, así como una reducción drástica del tiempo necesario para resolver los problemas de soporte de los productos.

title: Com infraestrutura centralizada na AWS, Faculdade Teológica Sul Americana zera incidentes com perdas de dados
summary: Reconhecida pelo MEC, a Faculdade Teológica Sul Americana (FTSA) tem mais de 2 mil alunos formados em seus cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e extensão. Criado em 2016, o curso de Teologia a Distância conta com cerca de 1,8 mil alunos matriculados. Com o crescimento dos cursos online, a instituição decidiu consolidar sua infraestrutura de TI na nuvem da AWS, garantindo maior estabilidade e eliminando incidentes com perdas de dados.

title: Freelance.com, la donnée au service du pilotage de l’activité
summary: Créé en 1996, Freelance.com est l'acteur européen leader du Freelancing et de l'intermédiation entreprise/talents externes. Freelance.com aide à initier, animer, simplifier et sécuriser la relation entre les entreprises et leurs talents externes. Observant une forte croissance, des besoins d'agilité, de réduction du temps de maintenance de son infrastructure et une volonté de se tourner vers des architectures en microservices, Freelance.com a fait le choix d’AWS. D'autre part, les acquisitions externes de Freelance.com ont introduit la nécessité d'une solution pour consolider les différentes sources de données de l'entreprise et d'avoir une vue en temps réel des opérations. Dans cette vidéo, Jean-Michel Mas, CTO de Freelance.com, nous raconte comment la collaboration entre les équipes de Freelance.com, d'AWS et de son partenaire Gekko Part of Accenture a permis la construction d’un Data Lake, qui consolide les données de l'entreprise, avec une visualisation des données opérationnelles sur Amazon QuickSight. À l'avenir, Freelance.com souhaite capitaliser sur son Data Lake et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités se basant sur l'intelligence artificielle, afin de servir au mieux ses clients.

title: FOX on AWS
summary: Millions of viewers engage with content from FOX through its broadcast and OTT platforms. FOX leverages AWS to pioneer the future of world-class live and on-demand content delivery.

title: Fivana adopta servicios AWS para llevar crédito a Pymes desatendidas
summary: Fivana es una empresa chilena que ofrece servicios de factoring y financiamiento a micro, pequeñas y medianas empresas. La implementación de AWS y sus apps, con una infraestructura Serverless e innumerables micro servicios, les permitió crear una plataforma escalable en tiempos, economía y costos, para seguir ofreciendo un servicio de calidad a más de seis mil organizaciones con las que trabajan, despachando oportunamente más de 53 mil operaciones que impactan directamente en sus negocios. Además, gracias a AWS, Fivana ha logrado reducir los tiempos de respuesta de financiamiento, de días a tan solo un par de horas, llevando servicios de financiamiento a empresas hasta entonces desatendidas por la banca tradicional.

title: Fi Uses Amazon Pinpoint to Improve Segmentation and Targeting, Sending over 12 Million Monthly Messages to Users
summary: Fi has improved user engagement with Amazon Pinpoint, using the service to send 11–12 million messages each month across SMS, email, and push, while analyzing the effectiveness of each communication. Fi is a neobank, currently used by over 1 million customers in India.

title: Expedia Group Innovates Across Multiple Tech Stacks Using AWS
summary: Founded in 1996, Expedia Group is a technology company that powers global travel for travelers around the world, connecting more than 50,000 business-to-business partners.

title: Euronext Securities migliora la customer experience dei servizi post-trade con AWS
summary: La ricerca di una customer experience sempre più appagante spinge Euronext Securities a realizzare modelli di analisi dati in grado di comprendere meglio il comportamento dei clienti e ottimizzare i propri servizi. Con Amazon Web Services (AWS), Euronext Securities trova l’elasticità e gli strumenti necessari per ridurre il time-to-market e soddisfare le regole italiane ed europee per la protezione dei dati.

title: Llamando al Doctor y Eudaimonia confían en escalabilidad con AWS en tiempos sin precedentes
summary: Llamando al Doctor es un servicio que ofrece consultas por video las 24 horas con profesionales de la salud a través de su aplicación y plataforma web. Eudaimonia, o Euda para abreviar, es una empresa de desarrollo de software que desarrolló la plataforma Llamando al Doctor para encontrar las mejores soluciones técnicas para brindar una atención accesible y fácil de usar.

title: Virtual Production ft. Epic Games and Amazon Studios
summary: In this AWS at SIGGRAPH 2021 video, Keynote speaker Eric Iverson is joined by David Morin of Epic Games and Ken Nakada of Amazon Studios to discuss modern virtual production (and whether it will be "a thing").

title: Epic Games Enables Creators to Build Over 2 Million Digital Humans and Launches RealityScan App on AWS
summary: Epic Games vice president of Unreal Engine Nathan Thomas shares how Epic is pushing technology to change how all industries engage with both physical and digital worlds using AWS.

title: Epic Games launches RealityScan app on AWS; announces 2M MetaHumans milestone at re:Invent
summary: AWS enables Epic to cost-efficiently scale RealityScan to support tens of thousands of creators, turning images into digital models of real-world objects that can be used in simulations, automotive, and film/TV projects.

title: Epic Games on AWS
summary: Epic Games is the interactive entertainment company behind Fortnite, one of the world's most popular video games with over 350 million players. Founded in 1991, Epic transformed gaming with the release of Unreal Engine—the 3D creation engine powering hundreds of games now used across industries, such as automotive, film and television, and simulation, for real-time production.

title: ENGIE auf AWS
summary: ENGIE ist ein globaler Energiekonzern, der sich dafür einsetzt, den Übergang zu einer kohlenstoffneutralen Welt zu beschleunigen, indem er kohlenstoffarme Energie und Services anbietet. Es setzt auf Amazon Web Services (AWS), um Innovationen und Nachhaltigkeit für sein Unternehmen und seine Kunden zu erreichen. Auf der Grundlage von AWS treibt ENGIE mit seinem Common Data Hub die digitale Transformation voran, unterstützt Unternehmen mit einer skalierbaren Lösung und betreibt mehr als 1 000 Machine-Learning-Modelle zur prädiktiven Wartung in seinen Kraftwerken.

title: ENGIE on AWS
summary: ENGIE is a global energy group working to accelerate the transition to a carbon-neutral world by offering low-carbon energy and services. It looks to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help it innovate and achieve sustainability for its business and customers.

title: ENGIE crea piattaforme digitali per accelerare la transizione energetica a zero emissioni di carbonio, alimentate da AWS
summary: Sviluppata utilizzando tecnologie AWS come Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue e Amazon SageMaker, ENGIE aiuta le città, come Barcellona, a ridurre il consumo energetico fino al 15%. Inoltre, la capacità di aumentare la scalabilità dell'infrastruttura aziendale durante gli orari di picco e ridurla durante le ore meno attive, consente a ENGIE di risparmiare il 60% dei costi di runtime del cloud.

title: ENGIE Creates Digital Platforms to Accelerate Zero-carbon Energy Transition, Powered by AWS
summary: ENGIE, headquartered in France, is a global energy company focused on renewable and low-carbon distributed energy infrastructures, helping its clients achieve a carbon-neutral future.

title: Scaleup Enerbrain si basa su AWS per sviluppare un sistema di gestione energetica intelligente degli edifici
summary: La scaleup italiana del settore proptech Enerbrain ha deciso di sviluppare un'architettura nativa del cloud su AWS sin dal primo giorno. Utilizza Amazon Lambda e Amazon Athena come elementi chiave della soluzione non proprietaria di ottimizzazione energetica IoT per gestire enormi volumi di dati dei sensori generati dai sistemi di gestione degli edifici (BMS) dei clienti. Il tratto distintivo di Enerbrain è l'uso dell'apprendimento automatico. Utilizza Amazon SageMaker per addestrare i suoi algoritmi e fornire la migliore strategia per ridurre il consumo di energia e le emissioni di carbonio, oltre a fornire report ESG, essenziali per la trasparenza dei dati nelle aziende di grandi dimensioni.

title: El Marqués digitaliza servicios para beneficio de la población, con AWS
summary: El Marqués es un importante municipio del estado de Querétaro, en México. Se caracteriza por las inversiones nacionales y transnacionales que recibe, tanto el sector industrial como comercial. Además de ser líder mundial en el sector aeronáutico y aeroespacial, tiene un desarrollo exponencial en proyectos habitacionales, centros comerciales, fábricas y bodegas logísticas. El trabajo en conjunto con AWS se encaminó hacia la mejora de los servicios digitales para la ciudadanía, lo cual redundó en mayor recaudación para el municipio y en más eficiencia para los procesos de cobro.

title: El Marqués digitaliza servicios para beneficio de la población, con AWS
summary: El Marqués es un importante municipio del estado de Querétaro, en México. Se caracteriza por las inversiones nacionales y transnacionales que recibe, tanto el sector industrial como comercial. Además de ser líder mundial en el sector aeronáutico y aeroespacial, tiene un desarrollo exponencial en proyectos habitacionales, centros comerciales, fábricas y bodegas logísticas. El trabajo en conjunto con AWS se encaminó hacia la mejora de los servicios digitales para la ciudadanía, lo cual redundó en mayor recaudación para el municipio y en más eficiencia para los procesos de cobro.

title: Dunelm Boosts SAP Performance by 30% with Migration to AWS
summary: Using Amazon Web Services (AWS) since 2019, Dunelm has improved the flexibility and resilience of its website and in-store operations, and supported innovation to create a better customer experience.

title: Building a Flexible, Multi-Tenant Data Platform for AI for Digital Oil & Gas
summary: The Drishya team left the AWS Data Lab with a clear direction for building their data platform and taking the solution to production. Drishya successfully launched their data platform with batch use cases only three months post-lab and has since seen a rapid progression in terms of efficiency, capacity, and revenue.

title: Dock cria plataforma ledger utilizando infraestrutura AWS
summary: Com uma estrutura que atende mais de 150 fintechs no Brasil, viabiliza mais de 160 milhões de contas e processa mais de US$ 50 bilhões em pagamentos na América Latina anualmente, a Dock iniciou este ano um processo mais intenso de expansão internacional. Para acelera-lo e se posicionar de forma diferenciada na região, a companhia iniciou o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma ledger totalmente baseada no Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB).

title: Dialog Axiata Migrates to AWS to Optimize Operating Costs by 18% While Meeting Dynamic Consumer Demands
summary: Dialog Axiata PLC migrated to AWS to achieve greater agility in meeting dynamic customer demands, and it has optimized costs by 18 percent while adding new capabilities. Dialog Axiata is a leading telecommunications provider in Sri Lanka.

title: Deutsche Börse Group Launches Data Analytics Platform in Rapid Time using AWS
summary: Deutsche Börse Group, an international exchange organization, built and launched A7, a new cloud-based data analytics platform, in just 4 months using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Market participants can use the platform to back-test and improve their algorithms, maximize the effectiveness of their trading strategies, or to increase investment returns.

title: Deutsche Börse Group Boosts Trading Platform Testing and Lowers TCO in Collaboration with AWS
summary: Deutsche Börse Group, an international exchange organization, built and launched A7, a new cloud-based data analytics platform, in just 4 months using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Market participants can use the platform to back-test and improve their algorithms, maximize the effectiveness of their trading strategies, or to increase investment returns.

title: Deliveroo on AWS
summary: Deliveroo has built its successful food delivery business by meeting customer needs quickly. Deliveroo uses AWS in every part of its core business: accepting orders, transmitting them to restaurants, and delivering meals to customers. On AWS, Deliveroo can go deeper into its data, using analytics and machine learning to enhance every part of the business.

title: El Banco Davivienda adopta un modelo de lugar de trabajo híbrido mediante Amazon WorkSpaces
summary: El Banco Davivienda (Davivienda), una entidad bancaria con sede en Colombia, fiel a su política de talento humano que busca desarrollar el máximo potencial de sus colaboradores y ofrecerles oportunidades de crecimiento, decidió apoyar al personal que trabaja a distancia al proporcionarles las herramientas que necesitan para realizar sus labores diarias desde casa. Aunque parte del personal ya había comenzado a trabajar a distancia, el banco tuvo que configurar una red privada virtual (VPN) para instalar nuevas estaciones de trabajo y establecer una conexión segura con los sistemas bancarios de Davivienda. Este proceso podía tardar hasta tres días en completarse y, en muchos casos, requería que el banco transportara el hardware de apoyo y otros activos fuera de las instalaciones.

title: DailyRounds Enhances the Learning Experience for 2 Million Medical Professionals With AWS
summary: DailyRounds is an India-based healthcare company that provides an online community for medical professionals and access a drug information database known as the India Drug Index. The company grew from around 500,000 to over 2 million users between 2018 to 2022. As it moves into its next phase, DailyRounds is exploring expanding into new markets, while enhancing its user experience. This started with a modernization of its infrastructure on AWS to improve its workflows and agility, allowing it to innovate at greater speed.

title: Fireside Chat: ISVs, Confluent, Nasdaq, and Infor Discuss How They’ve Helped Their Customers Grow and Transform Their Businesses
summary: Nasdaq, a global technology company, co-designed an edge compute platform with AWS that can be packaged and tailored for ultra-low-latency capital markets use cases.

title: Com novo Data Lake na nuvem AWS, Grupo Comerc desenvolve cultura Data Driven
summary: Em pleno processo de digitalização de seus processos, o Grupo Comerc, um dos líderes no mercado brasileiro de energia livre, concluiu em 2021 a criação de seu Data Lake suportado pelos serviços de nuvem da AWS. Com o novo Data Lake, a companhia inicia uma nova jornada, agora suportada por um ambiente que vai permitir a criação e o desenvolvimento de uma cultura Data Driven, fomentando a análise de dados com método científico como ponto de partida para a tomada de decisões mais ágil e efetiva.

title: The Coca-Cola Company in AWS
summary: Nachdem Coca-Cola 20 Jahre lang seine eigenen On-Premises-Rechenzentren betrieben hatte, migrierte das Unternehmen 2013 zu Amazon Web Services (AWS). Zu Beginn des Jahres führte der Super Bowl-Werbespot des Unternehmens zu einem sprunghaften Anstieg des Website-Verkehrs, der die Server von Coca-Cola überlastete und den Ausschlag für den Wechsel in die Cloud gab. Seit der Umstellung hat Coca-Cola seine Betriebskosten um 40 Prozent und das IT-Ticketvolumen um 80 Prozent reduziert. Darüber hinaus beschleunigen viele einzelne Abfüller im globalen Vertriebsnetz des Unternehmens, wie Coca-Cola Andina und Coca-Cola İçecek, ihre digitale Transformation. Coca-Cola setzt seine Innovationen auf AWS fort und nutzte kürzlich AWS-Serverless-Technologien, um in nur 150 Tagen eine berührungslose Benutzererfahrung mit geringer Latenz für seine Coca-Cola Freestyle-Getränkeausschankplattform zu entwickeln.

title: CleverTap Saves 20% with AWS Graviton and Data Lake on Amazon S3 for Petabyte-Scale User Retention Platform
summary: CleverTap migrated to a columnar data lake and Graviton2 processors to save 20 percent on infrastructure and reduce its compute requirements by 50–75 percent. CleverTap is a martech company offering its user engagement and retention platform to more than 10,000 companies worldwide.

title: Cleber ofrece un servicio unificado y de alta calidad gracias a Amazon Connect
summary: Cleber es una empresa automotriz, que se dedica a la venta y servicios de autos. Funciona bajo un modelo de agencias de autos nuevos, que maneja marcas como Toyota, Honda, Nissan, entre otras. Son un total de 17 marcas diferentes en 50 puntos distribuidos en distintas regiones de la República Mexicana. Uno de los retos a los que se enfrentaba era poder unificar la información de cada agencia. Lo prioritario era crear un departamento corporativo de TI que diera servicio a toda la empresa; para ello fue necesario crear la infraestructura y los servicios de manera rápida y eficiente. Así fue como llegaron a Amazon Web Services, donde les ayudaron a generar lo necesario para que se cumpliera con dicha meta.

title: CJ ENM Accelerates Response Times and Delivers Live Customer Chat to Drive Live Commerce
summary: CJ ENM—the first TV home shopping broadcaster in Korea—reduced video latency in live streaming, provided live chat during streams, and improved the overall mobile shopping experience by building CJ ONSTYLE on AWS, leveraging services such as Amazon IVS and AWS Elemental MediaConvert.

title: A través de AWS, Cinépolis apuesta a lo digital, a la omnicanalidad y la personalización
summary: Cinépolis es una empresa mexicana que ofrece servicios de diversión y entretenimiento a los clientes. Es líder de la industria cinematográfica en México y Latinoamérica: es la cuarta cadena más grande a nivel mundial y la más importante fuera de Estados Unidos. Ofrece un servicio de streaming a sus clientes, llamado Cinépolis Klic, el cual vive en la nube de AWS desde que nació. El reto que tenía la compañía era migrar la plataforma de Cinépolis (con exhibición de taquilla y venta de boletos) precisamente a la nube de AWS para digitalizar sus servicios.

title: Con el uso de AWS, la Seguridad Social Española fue capaz de procesar y gestionar rápidamente el Ingreso Mínimo Vital
customer: GISS - Gerencia Informática de la Seguridad Social
summary: La Gerencia Informática de la Seguridad Social (GISS) decidió apostar por la nube de AWS para facilitar al Instituto Nacional de la Seguridad Social (INSS) el tramitar y gestionar las solicitudes del Ingreso Mínimo Vital (IMV), una ayuda del gobierno a los ciudadanos con menos recursos. Las razones por las que eligieron AWS fueron la agilidad que le permitía a la hora de poner en marcha este proyecto, así como contar con todas las garantías de seguridad, dado que los datos que se tratan son de carácter personal y crítico. Accenture y Trend Micro colaboraron en el proyecto.

title: Amazon Web Services Case Study: CardInfoLink
summary: CardInfoLink uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) to deploy EVO Cloud, its payment processing system, and to develop value-added services through customized solutions for supply chain finance and marketing.

title: How Capital One creates remote work environments that optimize security and productivity
summary: Learn about ways to use virtual desktop infrastructure in the cloud with Amazon WorkSpaces and Amazon AppStream 2.0, providing high-performance, low-latency architectures

title: How Capital One and NextEra Energy Achieve Proactive Governance and Compliance for AWS workloads
summary: learn how NextEra Energy and Capital One enable automation and self-service at scale with AWS Cloud operations services.

title: How Capital One builds modern apps: Architecting for observability & resilience
summary: Capital One shares proven architecture best practices, tools, and blueprints for architecting for reliability, observability, and modernization on AWS.

title: Practical experience with a serverless-first strategy at Capital One
summary: Capital One shares how they have implemented serverless patterns, and lessons they have learned from operating AWS Lambda at scale in production.

title: How Capital One accelerates innovation with AWS databases
summary: As part of its digital transformation journey, Capital One adopted several purpose-built AWS databases to help manage data at a large scale and accelerate innovation.

title: AWS re:Invent 2022: AWS On Air ft.Capital One Software: Slingshot and AWS
summary: Capital One Software leverages Identity Access Management (IAM) policies to control access to data stored in AWS based data stores

title: On-Demand Infrastructure on AWS Helps Capital One DevOps Teams Move Faster Than Ever
summary: Capital One is well known for its early adoption of new technologies to help it transform the banking customer experience. Less obvious, but no less crucial, are the practices and mindsets that position the company to make such effective use of those new technologies—practices and mindsets that are the result of the company's conscious self-transformation into a digital technology company. The company’s recent embrace of DevOps is just the latest step.

title: Capillary Modernizes Its AWS Architecture to Scale 15x While Controlling Costs in China
summary: Founded in 2014, ARP Investments is a boutique investment management firm with operations in New York and Mumbai. The company leverages modern statistical methods and vast datasets to create diversified sources of absolute returns.

title: CA Advance Reduces Website Launch Time from 4 Hours to 1 Hour Using AWS Copilot
summary: CA Advance Inc. began using AWS Copilot and increased the reliability and stability of its websites, optimized automatic-scaling strategies, and reduced the time to create production environments.

title: BtoBet Processes Trillions of Betting Requests, Boosts Customer Loyalty Using AWS
summary: Betting on sporting events from the Olympics to Premier League soccer matches is a billion-dollar market characterized by surges in customer demand around live events. BtoBet provides betting and gambling businesses with its sportsbook solution, allowing individuals to place bets on sporting events. Since migrating to AWS, BtoBet can scale compute resources to handle spikes in demand and deliver a responsive experience for its partners and their players. It has also launched in new global markets and has the resources to support triple-digit customer growth. Using AWS, the company can manage double the volume of betting transactions without expanding its IT team.

title: Bosch and BMW: The next generation of vehicle technologies
summary: learn how Bosch and BMW use vehicle data to accelerate innovation by processing data inside the vehicle and in the cloud.

title: BMW: Digital customer engagement for automotive
summary: Learn how BMW use and partner with AWS to deeply engaging shoppers and vehicle owners through service offerings and improving customer trust, sales and lifecycle transparency, and convenience.

title: How BMW Group Innovates with AI/ML
summary: BMW Group explains how the company has overcome barriers to get started with AWS AI/ML services, fueling business profitability and growth.

title: How BMW, Intuit & Morningstar are transforming with AWS & Athena
summary: Whether it’s improving customer experience at BMW, personalizing software in real time at Intuit, or accelerating insights and innovation at Morningstar, data science and ML techniques are being used to improve business processes, speed product development, and enhance customer engagement.

title: BMW Group in AWS
summary: Die BMW Group ist ein weltweiter Hersteller von Premium-Automobilen und -Motorrädern und umfasst die Marken BMW, BMW Motorrad, MINI und Rolls-Royce. Die BMW Group entschied sich für eine Umstrukturierung und Migration ihres On-Premises-Data-Lake in die Cloud mit Amazon Web Services (AWS), um Innovation und Skalierung für die Nachfrage ihrer globalen Stakeholder zu ermöglichen. Der Cloud Data Hub (CDH) des Unternehmens verarbeitet und kombiniert anonymisierte Daten aus Fahrzeugsensoren und weiteren Quellen im gesamten Unternehmen, um internen Teams die Erstellung kundenseitiger und interner Anwendungen zu erleichtern. Die BMW Group setzt auf AWS, um die Agilität und Flexibilität zu erreichen, die sie benötigt, um die Datennutzung in großem Umfang zu demokratisieren und Innovationen zu beschleunigen.

title: BMW Group on AWS
summary: BMW Group builds on AWS to help it achieve the agility and flexibility it needs to democratize data usage at scale and accelerate innovation.

title: BlocPower Decarbonizes Buildings by Deploying SaaS BlocMaps Using HPC to Manage Big Data on AWS
summary: BlocPower built an HPC environment for its data pipeline using AWS Batch and other AWS services, which has helped it process 30 TB of data and accelerate its processing speeds by 16,000 times.

title: Airtel Delivers a Smooth Streaming Experience for Wynk Studio by Adopting Karpenter on Amazon EKS
summary: By adopting Karpenter on Amazon EKS, Airtel has reduced the time to scale by 25–33 percent and is saving 47 percent on infrastructure costs. Airtel is a leading telecommunications company that owns the Wynk Music over-the-top streaming platform.

title: Best Western Uses DataMasque on AWS to Stop Data Breaches and Automate Key Processes
summary: Best Western Hotel and Resorts is serious about preventing data breaches. The global hospitality organization, with 18 brands and 4,700 hotels worldwide, needs to protect sensitive customer information to comply with data privacy regulations, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

title: Com apoio da AWS, Bayer centraliza e padroniza dados do Projeto Carbono
summary: Para ajudar agricultores brasileiros a adotar práticas agrícolas inteligentes em relação ao clima e reduzir as emissões de carbono em suas atividades, a Bayer criou o Projeto Carbono, que tem como objetivo construir uma agricultura Carbono neutra. A iniciativa é parte do compromisso da empresa de reduzir em 30% a emissão de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE) no setor agrícola até 2030. Para centralizar e padronizar os dados recebidos dos diferentes parceiros envolvidos no projeto, a Bayer utiliza a plataforma e serviços AWS, que também dão ao projeto a escalabilidade e agilidade necessárias.

title: Baxter Provides Hospitals Data-Driven Insights Using AWS IoT Core
summary: Baxter, a global medtech company, developed a serverless, cloud-native solution to aggregate and analyze data from its acute therapy devices using AWS IoT Core and other AWS services to provide insights to hospitals that use the devices.

title: BankBazaar Migrates to AWS for Faster Innovation and Builds Video-Based KYC App in Two Months
summary: BankBazaar migrated fully to AWS for increased innovation, agility, and scalability, with 78 systems migrated in a month. BankBazaar provides financial services and content to 50 million users in India.

title: Em ambiente AWS, Banco Pan já ultrapassa 1 milhão de contratos digitais
summary: O Banco Pan oferece serviços financeiros voltados às classes C, D e E. A instituição vem experimentando crescimento e, para continuar entregando boas experiências aos clientes, decidiu substituir a sua infraestrutura on-premises por um ambiente de dados 100% cloud até o final de 2022. Neste vídeo, Leandro Marçal, CTO do Banco Pan, e Samir Migliani, head de dados da instituição, falam sobre a decisão de adotar uma plataforma totalmente baseada na nuvem AWS. O Banco Pan adotou, com o suporte da AWS Professional Services, soluções como AWS DMS, AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, Amazon DynamoDB e Amazon SageMaker, entre outras, e atualmente já ultrapassou a marca de 1 milhão de contratos totalmente digitais, originados no novo aplicativo.

title: Banco VR aumenta disponibilidade de sistemas e velocidade de PIX com AWS
summary: O Banco VR é parte do Grupo VR. Embora não esteja aberto para clientes externos, a instituição é uma peça-chave dentro do ecossistema de negócios VR e, justamente por isso, precisa contar com resiliência e alta disponibilidade de seus serviços. Para otimizar esse desempenho operacional, a empresa decidiu migrar a infraestrutura tecnológica do banco para a nuvem AWS.

title: Inter expande serviços de fintech e atende a 15 milhões de clientes na AWS
summary: A fintech Banco Inter S.A. (Inter) precisava avaliar sua pilha de tecnologia para atender às demandas de consumo após expandir sua base de clientes de 400 mil para 15 milhões de clientes em apenas 3 anos. Para concretizar isso, a empresa precisava agregar e avaliar dados em tempo real para conseguir lançar mais produtos e serviços, além de aprimorar a satisfação do cliente. Com base na solidez dos resultados anteriores, o Inter recorreu à Amazon Web Services (AWS) para ajustar cada detalhe de seu aplicativo e avaliar sua pilha de tecnologia. O Inter conseguiu ampliar sua visibilidade usando o software disponível no AWS Marketplace, um catálogo digital com milhares de ofertas de fornecedores independentes de software que deixam mais simples encontrar, testar, comprar e implantar software executado na AWS.

title: Bancamiga posiciona su marca en Venezuela con proceso de innovación basado en AWS
summary: Bancamiga es un banco universal en Venezuela con más de 500 empleados. La institución llevó un proceso de transformación e innovación tecnológica que le ha permitido idear nuevas estrategias para el sector financiero y posicionar la marca como referencia en el país. En este video, Roberto Parra, vicepresidente de Tecnología de Bancamiga, explica que la empresa eligió a AWS y al partner Siscotel para ayudarla a redefinir su infraestructura tecnológica, lo que le ha permitido más de 40% en esquemas de ahorro en infraestructura on-premises y un aumento promedio de 70% en la interacción con los clientes, entre otros beneficios.

title: Romanian Motor Insurers' Bureau (BAAR) drives faster claims resolutions using AWS
summary: Romania-based BAAR plays a key role in keeping motorists protected on the roads. An independent, nonprofit organization, it’s made up of 11 members, all of which deal with motor third-party liability (MTPL) insurance. MTPL ensures that, in the event of an accident, the driver responsible is covered for any damage to a third-party’s person or property. BAAR is also part of the Green Card system, which insures drivers under one policy for international motor travel across Europe, Asia, and North Africa.

title: B89 cuenta con AWS para ser un referente tecnológico para Fintechs en Latinoamérica
summary: La B89 es una techfin que tiene como objetivo crear nuevas oportunidades en el sistema financiero de Perú y también para los demás países hispánicos. La opción por cloud se dio por su necesidad de alta disponibilidad, escalabilidad y seguridad, y con AWS pudieron evolucionar su plataforma sin preocuparse de los costes. La empresa utiliza servicios cómo Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) y Amazon EMR, contribuyendo para la creación de una plataforma accesible desde cualquier parte del mundo.

title: AstraZeneca Delivers Life-Changing Medicines with Data and AI on AWS
summary: Using AWS services including Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Amazon Open Search Service, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and open-source tools, AstraZeneca optimizes its platform to host predictive machine learning models, generative AI, a global analytical database, and molecule search capabilities.

title: AstraZeneca Breaks the Boundaries of Science to Deliver Life-changing Medicines, Powered by AWS
summary: AstraZeneca discovers, develops, and commercializes prescription medicines in oncology and biopharmaceuticals, including in cardiovascular, respiratory, and immunology fields. It serves millions of patients across 145 countries and 70 markets.

title: Arezzo&Co. inova em relacionamento com mais de 10 milhões de clientes
summary: A Arezzo&Co. transformou o relacionamento com os seus mais de 10 milhões de clientes, especialmente como resultado das demandas trazidas com a pandemia. Murilo Jovtei, head de Negócios digitais da Arezzo&Co, conta como a empresa integrou produtos de suas três verticais no app ZZ Mall. E, mais importante, como utilizou serviços AWS para promover essa integração, permitindo que 4.500 vendedores utilizem a solução para fazer mais de 2 milhões de ativações todos os meses, gerando uma receita influenciada de R$ 50 milhões/mês, cifra que representa um rescimento de 70% para a companhia.

title: Como a Arcos Dorados usa os serviços da AWS para evoluir do ponto de vista digital
summary: A Arcos Dorados é a maior franquia mundial da marca McDonald's, operando em 20 países ou territórios da América Latina. Há alguns anos, a empresa iniciou um processo de transformação digital com o desafio de oferecer aos clientes um atendimento mais conveniente e com um relacionamento cada vez mais personalizado. Neste vídeo, Magdalena González Victorica, Chief Technology Officer da Arcos Dorados, conta como a empresa utilizou as soluções e serviços profissionais da AWS e do parceiro Econocomdigital. title: HBO Max: Using Canaries for Outside-in Validation
summary: HBO Max's operational experience team has built a system which uses canaries to enable outside-in validation for their web application. What this means is that they can test and verify what customers are seeing, and capture the results of these tests, trigger alerts based on these results. These show up on a status app that internal stakeholder teams use. They can see the last and historical runs, and document and store the artifacts from each run for debugging purposes. The HBO operational experience team has focused on 3 core categories for these validations: customer journeys, configurations, and content quality. The application architecture consists of Cloudwatch Synthetics, S3, AppSync, Amplify and Lambda. The Cloudwatch Synthetics canaries are deployed and run on time-based triggers in multiple AWS regions globally. The Status App is hosted on Amplify, making requests to AppSync to fetch metric data from the canary runs. AppSync in turn triggers a Lambda handler that queries the canaries data from AWS Cloudwatch Synthetics and artifacts in S3 via the AWS SDK. The status web app then display the overall status and the associated artifacts (HAR files, screenshots, logs) for each of the canary runs. This makes it easy for ops and customer care teams to get visibility into both behavior and performance issues that customers are seeing in close to real time.

title: Nationwide Children’s Hospital Uses AWS Technology for Processing and Securing Clinical Genomics Data
summary: Building on AWS, Nationwide Children's Hospital created a set of applications to perform clinical genomics quickly and securely in the cloud.

title: hc1 Uses AWS to Turn Billions of Quest Lab Tests into Healthcare Insights
summary: A third of Americans have had a test performed by Quest Diagnostics, which generates billions of test results. hc1 uses several HIPAA-compliant AWS tools to power its platform to store and process the data from Quest. The platform has processed more than 10 billion results, including 290 million lab orders organized and associated with 153 million patient profiles, with some tests being flagged more than 30 percent of the time.

title: Carbon Lighthouse Tackles CO2 Emissions with Machine Learning on AWS
summary: Carbon Lighthouse is on a mission to stop climate change by making it easy and profitable for building owners to cut carbon emissions caused by wasted energy. In this video, learn how the company uses machine learning on AWS to develop insights that deliver energy savings and decrease CO2 emissions in commercial real estate, reducing more than 260,000 metric tons of emissions to date.

title: Altium Enables Remote Electronics Design with Altium 365 on AWS
summary: Printed circuit board (PCB) design software provider Altium launched Altium 365 on AWS to enable customers worldwide to collaborate on PCB design and realization and create higher-yield products faster.

title: Fix This Podcast #31 - Expanding financial access
summary: Hear how two organizations are creating a more financially inclusive world using the AWS Cloud.

title: Zalora Logs 6,000 AWS Training Hours to Boost Fluency in Cloud Operations
summary: Zalora promotes a culture of learning and security fluency, empowering its technology team to manage their projects end-to-end in the cloud with an AWS Training and Certification program.

title: VNR Builds Cloud-Optimal Platform after AWS Training and Certification
summary: The development team of German publishing company VNR participated in AWS Training and Certification courses, helping the company build a revenue-producing digital product and set of offerings using AWS services and AWS best practices.

title: TracFone Uses AWS Training and Certification to Save Costs and Build Employee Confidence
summary: Telecommunications company TracFone Wireless used AWS Training and Certification to build an organization-wide training plan, saving millions of dollars, increasing efficiency, and boosting employee confidence.

title: Egypt’s MCIT Builds Nationwide Digital Culture Using AWS Training in AI and ML
customer: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
summary: Egypt’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology spurred a digital transformation, using AWS Training and Certification to build a workforce skilled in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

title: Huuuge Boosts Its Productivity and Upskills Technical Talent Using AWS Training
summary: Mobile gaming developer Huuuge used AWS Training and Certification to increase innovation, enhance its security posture, and develop a program that it hopes will attract technical talent.

title: HPE Drives Cloud Centricity by Engaging in AWS Training and Certification
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is using Amazon Web Services (AWS) to drive an edge-to-cloud strategy across its organization and provide value to its customers at each stage of their cloud journeys. In this video Alexia Clements, vice president of worldwide sales and cloud services; Harris Schneiderman, enterprise sales director; and Laura Manfre, director of the learning, advisory, and professional services team, describe how engaging in AWS Training and Certification enhanced HPE’s delivery, resources, experience, and expertise on AWS.

title: EPAM Builds Client Confidence Using AWS Training and Certification Initiative
summary: Using AWS Training and Certification, EPAM is upskilling its engineers; developing a more agile, proficient workforce; and building the confidence of its clients.

title: Deutsche Telekom IT GmbH Uses AWS Training and Certification to Modernize in the Cloud
summary: Deutsche Telekom IT GmbH accelerated its journey to the cloud by upskilling more than 2,000 employees using AWS Training and Certification.

title: Choice Hotels Speeds Deployment, Supports Cloud Migration Using AWS Training and Certification
summary: Choice Hotels opted to go all in on AWS and used AWS Training and Certification to upskill its employees, boosting staff engagement and speed to market, cutting costs, and simplifying its cloud migration.

title: BPPTIK Kominfo Bridges the Digital Skills Gap with LMS on AWS
summary: BPPTIK Kominfo gained the confidence and skills to migrate its learning management system to AWS through support from AWS Training and Certification. BPPTIK Kominfo delivers in-person and virtual courses to civil servants and members of the public as part of the country’s drive to increase digital skills. BPPTIK’s IT team has taken part in AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials, AWS Technical Essentials, and Architecting on AWS courses to build cloud skills.

title: Boticário Group Uses AWS Training to Increase Employee Engagement and Overhaul Digital Strategy
summary: Brazilian beauty company Boticário Group used AWS Training and Certification programs to expand its technology division, improve employee engagement, and support the digital transformation of its business.

title: BAE Systems AI Upskills Employees to Meet Customer Demand for AWS Expertise
summary: BAE Systems AI, a division of arms, security, and aerospace company BAE Systems, upskills employees and wins new business using AWS Training and Certification courses delivered by AWS Select Consulting Partner QA.

title: 123RF Technology Empowers Developers to Solve Business Challenges with AWS Training and Certification
summary: 123RF Technology has upskilled its developers with AWS Training and Certification to accelerate cloud migrations by 35 percent and quickly solve business problems. 123RF provides digital stock imagery to individuals and businesses. By completing the Developing on AWS training course, 123RF adopted Amazon Pinpoint to lower cart abandonment by focusing on customer experience.

title: WorkApps’ Video Platform Reduces Bank Customer Verification Time from Days to Seconds
summary: When India went into lockdown recently, banks turned to digital KYC tools to onboard customers virtually. Using AWS, WorkApps could help customers implement video KYC in just a week, minimizing any business disruption.

title: Upstox Powers High-Speed Trades in Seconds with AWS
summary: Upstox is rapidly growing its customer base and powering high-speed trades in several financial markets thanks to the performance of AWS.

title: Omise Ensures Global Compliance by Going All-in on AWS
summary: By pursuing a single-cloud strategy on AWS, Omise can ensure a high availability of 99.99 percent and simplify compliance as it expands operations.

title: Episource boosts productivity and delivers quicker healthcare insights with machine learning
summary: AWS's seamless integration with open-source tools has allowed Episource to streamline its machine learning platform, simplify its document review process, and deliver quality risk adjustment insights to its clients at speed.

title: DSP Invests in AWS Cloud for Long-Term Gains
summary: By migrating to AWS, DSP Investment Managers has reduced time spent on maintenance by 25 percent and is able to quickly experiment with new technologies tied to business growth.

title: Yuki Counts on AWS to Power Automated Accountancy
summary: A pioneer in its field, Yuki has kickstarted innovation in traditional on-premises accounting software. Founded in 2007, the Dutch company provides its 70,000 customers with an easy-to-use, automated accountancy and tax service.

title: Open Banking Provider Yapily Powers Growth with AWS
summary: Open banking has disrupted the financial services landscape. Using AWS, open banking infrastructure provider Yapily now has the power to deliver faster products and deploy new AI and machine-learning tools, all while optimizing its own development processes. Working with AWS, Yapily has unlocked its growth potential and is helping to define the future of financial services.

title: Yamisok Plays to Win by Running Nationwide Gaming Events Concurrently on AWS
summary: Yamisok is able to support 3,000 concurrent gamers per second and 15,000 new registrations in a day by using AWS. It is the largest esports platform in Indonesia, running gaming tournaments for the government and private-event organizers.

title: Writer Safeguard Achieves 99.999% Availability with Cash Management Solution on AWS
summary: By migrating its cash management application to AWS, Writer Safeguard has improved its ability to experiment with new technologies and scale instantly to respond to business demand. Writer Business Services provides cash management, information management, realty, and relocation services to corporate customers in India.

title: Les données au cœur des énergies renouvelables
summary: WPO est une plateforme indépendante de gestion d'actifs spécialisée dans la production d'énergie éolienne et solaire. Le groupe supervise un parc de deux mille éoliennes et douze millions de panneaux solaires situés sur six cents sites répartis dans douze pays européens. Tous les ans, ses équipes contribuent à une production d’électricité de source renouvelable équivalente à la consommation de la ville de Paris. WPO propose des solutions techniques, commerciales et financières à ses clients propriétaires des centrales de production parmi lesquels des grands énergéticiens, des fonds d’investissement, des producteurs indépendants d’électricité ou encore des collectifs citoyens.

title: WillyWeather Runs Nowcasting Model for Weather Predictions on AWS
summary: By building its nowcasting system on AWS, WillyWeather can provide real-time rain forecasts in intervals as short as 2 minutes for its 5 million monthly users.

title: Waitrose Rises to Pandemic Challenge and Amazes Customers with AWS
summary: Thanks to the way Waitrose implemented its move to AWS, its online grocery service can now accommodate spikes in customer grocery orders, launch software updates 900 times a year, and respond to real-time customer behavior when developing new features. Since moving to AWS, Waitrose has reduced checkout times on the website, boosted performance, and increased customer conversion rates.

title: Votorantim Energia desenvolve programa de transformação digital baseado na nuvem e serviços AWS
summary: Uma das maiores empresas de energia do País, a Votorantim Energia iniciou uma nova jornada de transformação, que culminou na criação do programa Vértice, que prevê a substituição de sistemas legados e digitalização de processos de sua Comercializadora por uma nova plataforma analítica baseada na nuvem AWS.

title: VOD Factory : l'histoire d'une solution clé en main pour créer sa propre plateforme de streaming
summary: Fondé à Paris en 2013, VOD Factory est le spécialiste de la vidéo à la demande en France. S’appuyant sur AWS pour développer sa solution "Otto", VOD Factory permet aux propriétaires de contenu de créer leur propre plateforme de streaming. Également éditeur de services SVOD (Queerscreen, Shadowz, Spicee), VOD Factory est ainsi en mesure de faire bénéficier à ses clients de sa propre expérience métier. Amené à accueillir un nombre important et variable de connexions, VOD Factory tire parti de l’élasticité du Cloud AWS pour adapter son infrastructure à la demande et garantir à ses utilisateurs performance et disponibilité dans le monde entier. Dans cette vidéo, Julien Vin-Ramarony, Président de VOD Factory, nous explique pourquoi ses équipes ont fait appel à AWS et nous éclaire sur les défis que son entreprise souhaite relever à l'avenir.

tag_names.rosa: Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS
