summary: La Confederación Nacional de Organismos de Apoyo al Tránsito (CONFEORG) es una entidad sin ánimo de lucro que agremia y representa a los organismos de apoyo a las autoridades de tránsito; empresas que prestan servicios relacionados con el tránsito en Colombia como: exámenes de aptitud médica y psicométrica, cursos de enseñanza automovilística para aspirantes a conducir vehículos, revisiones técnico-mecánicas y de emisiones contaminantes de vehículos, y cursos sobre normas de tránsito para infractores. Con la ayuda de AWS y su partner IKTINUS, lograron lanzar la aplicación en tiempo récord y cumplieron con todos los requisitos exigidos por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), entre ellos, tener una disponibilidad del 98.5%.

title: Comerc garante mais segurança, agilidade e inovação com uso da nuvem AWS
summary: A Comerc Energia comercializa uma média de 1,4 GW de energia por mês. Com o mercado livre de energia em expansão, a companhia sentiu a necessidade de inovar, criando um novo ambiente, agora na nuvem AWS, que lhe permitisse crescer com agilidade de implementação, alcance e escalabilidade.

title: Coinhako Migrates to AWS for Compliance Support and High Availability
summary: Singapore-based cryptocurrency platform Coinhako migrated to AWS with the aim of accelerating compliance and achieving higher availability. The platform focuses on localizing cryptocurrency services and currently serves over 300,000 customers. It uses AWS Managed Services for architecture guidance and out-of-the-box compliance support. It also uses Amazon EKS for container orchestration and AWS Secrets Manager for data encryption.

title: codemantra Helps Businesses Improve Digital Document Accessibility with AI-Powered Platform on AWS
summary: codemantra leverages the Batch Transform feature of Amazon SageMaker and Amazon SageMaker Multi-Model Endpoints to reduce the time and cost required for machine learning (ML)–powered document processing. It is an intelligent document processing company that uses software and deep learning to automate workflows and achieve accessibility compliance. The company is using Amazon SageMaker for concurrent document processing at scale, AWS Lambda to invoke batch processing, and Amazon S3 to store documents and ML predictions.

title: Coca-Cola Andina incrementa productividad de análisis en un 80%, garantizando decisiones inteligentes y manteniendo ventaja competitiva a través de servicios AWS
summary: Coca-Cola Andina tiene la visión de promover el crecimiento rentable de su negocio, apoyando a sus clientes y garantizando las mejores experiencias a los más de 54 millones de consumidores en Chile, Argentina, Brasil y Paraguay. Para eso, desarrolla procesos de clase mundial con el fin de aumentar su productividad y la calidad del servicio. Una de las iniciativas para alcanzar ese desafío fue el desarrollo de un data lake basado en la tecnología cloud de AWS. Al adoptar almacenamiento, bases de datos, cómputo y capacidades analíticas basadas en tecnología AWS, la compañía logró aumentar la productividad del equipo de análisis en un 80%, permitiendo al propio negocio y a sus clientes tomar decisiones basadas en datos confiables, favoreciendo el crecimiento conjunto de todo el ecosistema, manteniendo su ventaja competitiva y aumentando los ingresos de la compañía.

title: CNA moderniza estrutura de dados com Data Lake desenvolvido em plataforma AWS
customer: Editora CNA Cultural Norte Americano SA
summary: Com 47 anos de experiência no ensino de inglês e espanhol, o CNA é uma das maiores redes de ensino de idiomas do país, com mais de 600 escolas em todo o território nacional. Como parte de sua jornada de transformação digital, e para suportar sua cultura de decisão direcionada a dados, a companhia sentiu a necessidade de modernizar sua infraestrutura de dados e analytics evoluindo para uma arquitetura mais ágil e escalável, construída sobre um Data Lake utilizando a plataforma AWS.

title: Proyecto global de astroinformática en la nube AWS promete cambiar el futuro de la sociedad
summary: Hace más de una década, el Centro de Modelamiento Matemático (CMM) de la Universidad de Chile anticipó que las tecnologías de información jugarían un rol fundamental en el desarrollo de la astronomía. De ese modo, los investigadores del CMM apostaron a que la computación en la nube sería un pilar fundamental del futuro de esta ciencia. Desde 2016 han utilizado dicha tecnología comprobando múltiples beneficios en cuanto a flexibilidad e interoperabilidad en sus proyectos de investigación.

title: Cleo One Video Testimonial
summary: Cleo One reduced developer infrastructure by 66 percent and saved over 40 percent on costs by migrating to Amazon Web Services (AWS). Cleo One is a financial technology provider that makes complex and fragmented trading tools available to everyone.

title: Classic Group Builds Better Homes 60% Faster with AWS
summary: Classic Group engaged Amazon Web Services (AWS) to migrate a mission critical on-premises application to the cloud and accelerated the process when frequent performance issues prevented the company from using its application or operating efficiently. It runs on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and Amazon Aurora to package its application, with little to no changes to the application itself.

title: Cinematic Media espera éxito de taquilla con AWS
summary: Cinematic Media, una instalación de postproducción de películas y televisión con sede en la Ciudad de México, implementó Amazon Web Services para permitirle crear máquinas virtuales para renderizar contenido de video bajo demanda cuando tiene grandes proyectos. La decisión le ha permitido a la empresa ver importantes ahorros de tiempo y costos, lo que le ha permitido tomar más proyectos y entregarlos a tiempo.

title: Controladoria Geral da União migra sistemas voltados ao cidadão para nuvem AWS
summary: A CGU é o órgão de controle interno do Governo Federal responsável por realizar atividades relacionadas à defesa do patrimônio público e ao incremento da transparência da gestão. Com a necessidade de ampliação da estrutura que os suportava, o órgão optou por sua migração para a nuvem da AWS.

title: A través de un campus virtual, el Centro Europeo de Educación Física fortalece su oferta de capacitación
customer: Centro Europeo de Educación Física SRL
summary: En la búsqueda de dotar de mayor agilidad y alcance a su plataforma de formación, el CEEF consolidó un modelo flexible y escalable que le permite ofrecer más y mejores servicios, incluso en tiempos de pandemia.

title: Com estrutura AWS, Cemig reduz em 10 vezes o tempo de processamento de modelos de simulação
customer: CEMIG - Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais
summary: Atuando nas áreas de geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, a Cemig é hoje a maior comercializadora de energia para clientes livres do país e um dos maiores grupos geradores. Uma das funções fundamentais de sua área de comercialização é o processamento de modelos de simulação do setor elétrico, responsável por fornecer projeções da operação do sistema elétrico e dos custos desta operação. Na Cemig, esse processamento era feito internamente, até que o crescimento da demanda aumentou a volume de projeções, que tinham que ser feitas no mesmo prazo. Ao migrar este processamento para a AWS, a Cemig ampliou em 10 vezes o volume de cenários processados no mesmo período.

title: Carro Group Drives Hypergrowth with AWS Managed Services
summary: By outsourcing infrastructure management to AWS Managed Services, Carro Group has improved service availability to 99.99% on its Jualo website and is able to achieve ongoing cost optimization.

title: Caring Pharmacy Runs SAP on AWS as the Data Foundation for Rapid Expansion
summary: By migrating to SAP on AWS, Caring Pharmacy has improved scalability and stability for its core enterprise resource planning (ERP) operations, allowing IT to focus more on innovation. Caring Pharmacy is a leading pharmaceutical chain in Malaysia with 150 stores across the country.

title: Capital One su AWS
summary: Capital One ha rivoluzionato il settore dei servizi finanziari dal 1994, utilizzando la tecnologia per trasformare i servizi bancari e i pagamenti. Oggi la "banca digitale" punta tutto su AWS, sfruttando analisi dei dati, microservizi, IA/ML e altre soluzioni per continuare a innovare.

title: Capital One on AWS
summary: Capital One went “cloud-first” in 2016 and is now using or experimenting with nearly every AWS service to develop, test, build, and run its most critical workloads, including its new flagship mobile-banking application.

title: Capella Space Detects and Tracks Millions of Daily Changes on Earth Using AWS
summary: Capella Space is an American space company that operates a network of small observation satellites that take precise measurements to track changes on Earth. In this video, Payam Banazadeh, CEO and founder, describes how Capella Space uses AWS solutions to collect, process, and make available petabytes of data in near real time, with low latency and low reactivity.

title: Canva Helps Enterprises Redefine Brand Management and Collaboration with Design Tools Powered by AWS
summary: By launching its Canva for Enterprise platform on AWS, Canva ensures reliability, performance, and enhanced security for enterprises globally. Canva is an Australian company that provides an online visual communications and design solution for global customers. The company runs its platform on Amazon ECS, with Amazon S3 and AWS KMS to store and encrypt data.

tag_names.kafka-managed-streaming: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK)

title: Canopy Uses Machine Learning to Automate Financial Statement Processing on AWS
summary: To automate its core function of processing financial statements, Canopy turned to AWS to help it build its machine learning capabilities using Amazon Sagemaker

title: Com mais de 10 milhões de clientes, C6 Bank usa AWS como nuvem preferencial
summary: Lançado no segundo semestre de 2019, o C6 Bank chegou ao mercado se posicionando como um banco completo de varejo 100% digital. A instituição conta hoje com mais de 10 milhões de clientes e oferece uma série de serviços, que vão de conta corrente internacional a plataforma de investimentos. Acompanhar esse crescimento exigiu uma estrutura de TI ágil e escalável, com estrutura em nuvem na AWS.

title: Plataforma bursátil b.trader se mueve a toda velocidad con la nube de AWS
summary: Poincenot Tech Studio, una empresa con sede en Argentina que se especializa en el desarrollo de negocios digitales, desarrolló b.trader, su solución fintech marca blanca para la transformación digital del negocio bursátil en entidades financieras, sobre la nube de Amazon Web Services. Utilizando los servicios de AWS, la compañía logró lanzar el nuevo producto en ocho meses y ha podido cumplir con la regulación argentina para la apertura de cuentas de inversión de forma 100% digital.

title: Con la tecnología como aliada, Brook’s School of English se posiciona para el futuro en la enseñanza de idiomas
summary: A pocos días de comenzar un nuevo ciclo lectivo, la pandemia de covid-19 modificaba todo el escenario previsto y Brook’s School of English enfrentaba la posibilidad cierta de tener que cerrar sus puertas y dejar sin clases a sus alumnos. Sin embargo, en el instituto exploraron otras posibilidades y decidieron adoptar un campus virtual para poder seguir cumpliendo su misión. Así descubrieron la propuesta de Aulasneo, con la que pudieron sortear el año sin obstáculos, ampliar la matrícula, ganar en flexibilidad e identificar nuevos mercados y oportunidades.

title: Data Lakes with BMW
summary: In this session, we will explore the BMW Cloud Data Hub, and how BMW and AWS have teamed up to accelerate data driven innovation enterprise-wide. We'll then switch gears to discuss the AWS Autonomous Driving Data Lake reference architecture to learn how customers manage the challenge of ingesting, transforming, labeling, and cataloging massive amounts of data to develop automated driving systems by using Amazon EMR, Amazon S3 and Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth, among others.

title: Bit Soft Video Testimonial
summary: With Amazon Web Services (AWS), Bit Soft Romania increased availability to 99.95 percent. Bit Soft is a Romanian company that provides digital solutions to the hotel, restaurant, and café (HORECA) industry. Migrating to AWS allowed Bit Soft to ensure constant security and availability of its services and customer data.

title: Biarri Builds Optimization Engines on AWS to Maximize Customers’ Profits
summary: Biarri builds web-based optimization engines on AWS to help its customers make better decisions that maximize profits. Biarri is an Australian company that designs custom tools to simplify complex forecasting and optimization activities. The group uses Amazon RDS for database management, AWS CloudFormation for quick provisioning, and Amazon EKS for container orchestration.

title: La nube de AWS ayuda a Belcorp a adaptarse a los crecientes desafíos del negocio
summary: Belcorp ha apostado por impulsar su estrategia digital para que sus consumidores puedan ser atendidos en cualquiera de sus canales disponibles (venta directa, E-commerce, retail) y obtengan experiencias cada vez más personalizadas sin importar las complicaciones del entorno. Además, la conectividad, la alineación entre sus sedes y brindar herramientas tecnológicas ágiles y seguras a sus colaboradores han sido sus principales objetivos en su viaje digital.

title: Beetrack usa AWS para entregar una excelente experiencia a todo un ecosistema
summary: Beetrack es un software para la optimización y el monitoreo de entregas de última milla. La empresa comenzó en 2013 con una infraestructura en la nube de Amazon Web Services (AWS). Con una cultura de innovación continua, Beetrack siempre fue adoptando las más nuevas tecnologías de AWS, lo que le ha permitido crecer rápidamente y avanzar en las ofertas de servicios entregando cada vez mayor valor a sus clientes. Actualmente también utiliza tecnologías de seguridad, para contenedores y de desarrollos de aplicaciones serverless que garantizan integración con ERPs de los clientes, además de flexibilidad casi infinita para el procesamiento de más de 400 requests por segundo.

title: Big Data : comment Bedrock, fondé par le Groupe M6 et RTL Group, a décuplé ses capacités pour offrir une meilleure expérience client à ses 45 millions d’utilisateurs avec AWS Graviton
summary: Champion français du streaming vidéo à la demande, Bedrock conçoit des plateformes de pointe pour les médias leaders nationaux en Europe. Avec près de 45 millions d’utilisateurs et un besoin d’agilité de plus en plus grand, Bedrock fait confiance aux services AWS pour traiter des volumes de données de plus en plus importants ; le tout, avec une réduction globale des coûts de 40%. Zoom sur une migration cloud réussie avec Quentin Nambot, Data Engineer chez Bedrock.

title: Banregio acelera su tiempo de salida al mercado con el análisis de datos en la nube de AWS
summary: Banregio Grupo Financerio (BanRegio) adoptó Amazon Sagemaker para ayudar a desarrollar el aprendizaje automático y el análisis de big data en la nube. La tecnología ha permitido a la empresa estudiar el comportamiento de los consumidores y acelerar su tiempo de salida al mercado con nuevos productos, algo que no podría haber hecho en un ambiente on-premises. El banco también tiene previsto utilizar los servicios de Amazon Web Services para el procesamiento del lenguaje natural y la transcripción de voz a texto.

title: Banco de Bogotá utiliza soluciones de reconocimiento facial de AWS para aumentar la conversión de nuevos clientes
summary: Banco de Bogotá es la institución financiera con más historia en Colombia. Desde 2017, el Banco trabaja en su transformación digital; de hecho, fue pionero en lanzar la primera cuenta 100% digital de extremo a extremo en la región. Ahora, las soluciones de reconocimiento facial de AWS implementadas por el Banco han permitido un aumento de 10% en la tasa de conversión de nuevos clientes, además de disminuir los casos de suplantación.

title: Game On! Baazi Games Builds Enhanced Cyber Defenses with AWS Security Services
summary: Baazi Games, an India technology gaming company specializing in skill-based real money games for over 10 million users, turned to AWS to secure its IT infrastructure against external threats. It successfully mitigated more than 50 DDoS attacks within 6 months to ensure business continuity.

title: Autoglass utiliza serviços AWS para garantir eficiência da operação e a continuidade do negócio
summary: A Autoglass oferece assistências a vidros e peças automotivas, além de reparo à lataria para as principais seguradoras do Brasil. Cerca de cinco anos atrás surgiu o desafio de otimizar o processamento dos dados em seu data warehouse para garantir desempenho e agilidade na entrega dos serviços. Graças aos serviços AWS, a empresa também pode enviar todos os colaboradores para suas casas durante a pandemia sem interromper as suas operações.

title: A Autodesk aumenta a eficiência e reduz os custos por meio de migração e modernização em grande escala na AWS
summary: A Autodesk é líder em software para design, engenharia e entretenimento em 3D. Se você já dirigiu um carro, admirou um arranha-céu gigantesco, usou um smartphone ou assistiu a um bom filme, é possível que tenha vivenciado o que milhões de clientes da Autodesk fazem com o software da empresa.

title: AWS Enables Audiencerate to Process Over a Billion Requests per Week
summary: AWS and its managed services allow the small technical team at Audiencerate to respond quickly to 250 million requests a day and store and analyze 50 terabytes of data a month. Amazon Kinesis can match cookies in 15 seconds and, by enabling encryption on all managed services, removes security headaches.

title: “Database improvement” by migrating to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
summary: At Home Co., Ltd., a pioneer in the real estate information service industry that provides vast volumes of property-related information and know-how, is shifting its system infrastructure to the cloud in stages. After migrating multiple applications to AWS, the company also shifted its on-premises Oracle Database Real Application Clusters (RAC) to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. As a result of its migrations to AWS, including its database infrastructure shift, At Home has seen improvements in scalability and development speed as well as reductions in licensing costs.

title: AstraZeneca Transforms Pharmaceutical Research and Development with Industrialized Machine Learning on AWS
summary: In this presentation, hear about AstraZeneca’s journey to build a flexible, compliant platform to accelerate their drug research process, and how it collaborated with the Amazon Machine Learning (ML) Solutions Lab to make it happen.

title: How AstraZeneca built a large scale cloud compute system in record time with AWS
summary: Learn how AstraZeneca scaled their machine learning model to the cloud using Amazon EC2 P3 instances and Amazon EKS to accelerate their drug discovery process.

title: Grupo ASOEC entrega ensino online para mais de 30 mil alunos com o uso da tecnologia da AWS
summary: Com a determinação do isolamento social, a plataforma de ensino a distância do grupo ASOEC, que atendia 1,8 mil alunos simultaneamente, passou a atender todo o contingente de estudantes, o que foi feito com o uso da estrutura AWS.

title: La Asociación de Ingenieros Estructurales elige el camino de la innovación para capacitar a sus asociados
customer: Asociación de Ingenieros Estructurales de Argentina
summary: En 2018, los jóvenes profesionales a cargo de las capacitaciones en la Asociación de Ingenieros Estructurales (AIE) de la República Argentina asumieron una estrategia de innovación para poder ofrecer mejores servicios a sus asociados. Aun antes de la pandemia, el esfuerzo realizado rindió sus frutos. Y ya en tiempos de covid-19 fueron capaces de ofrecer, a través de su campus virtual exclusivo, cursos a demanda que pudieron monetizar en pocos días brindando ingresos esenciales la asociación.

title: Aramex Taps on Amazon Connect to Launch Contact Center in 7 Days, 20X Faster than Legacy Solution
summary: Aramex used AWS to help consolidate its call center operations without having to invest more in infrastructure.

title: Apptus Boosts Customer Experience and Innovation with AWS
summary: Sweden’s Apptus migrated to AWS in less than a month, and now provides a reliable, secure ecommerce platform for its retail customers and the shoppers that use their websites. Thanks to AWS, it’s able to quickly scale to meet customers’ changing needs, expand internationally, and innovate for the future.

title: ank entrega mejores servicios a sus clientes con proceso de conciliación basado en AWS
summary: Para lograr su objetivo de simplificar la vida de las personas, la fintech argentina ank permite administrar múltiples cuentas bancarias mediante una sola app fácil, rápida y segura. Para esto desarrolló la función de envío de dinero desde una cuenta bancaria a otras cuentas CBU/CVU y los pagos mediante códigos QR interoperables.

title: AnandRathi Innovates “at Breakneck Speed” on AWS
summary: By migrating to AWS, AnandRathi has reduced the time it takes to process financial reports from 15 minutes to a few seconds.

title: American Family Insurance Powers a Frictionless Customer Experience on AWS
summary: Homesite Insurance, an American Family Insurance company, stakes its brand on delivering frictionless online insurance purchasing experiences. Offering customers the ability to quickly search, analyze, and select the right product options requires a real-time data pipeline, which the company built on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

title: AMA Expands Online Education with a Learning Management System on AWS
summary: By migrating its learning management system to AWS, AMA University has cost effectively innovated to expand online learning in the Philippines. AMA University is part of AMA Education System, with 200 campuses offering blended-learning models across the country.

title: Allianz Argentina migra 100% de su infraestructura a Amazon Web Services
summary: En los últimos cinco años, Allianz Argentina viene haciendo una transformación global de las plataformas con mucho foco en robótica y automatización. Uno de los grandes pilares que tenía era la migración de toda su infraestructura a la nube. En este vídeo, los ejecutivos de Tecnología de Allianz Argentina explican porque eligieron a Amazon Web Services y cómo la empresa, con el apoyo del partner AWS Escala 24x7 y de los Servicios Profesionales de AWS, fue una de las primeras sucursales a migrar el 100% de su infraestructura a la nube, mejorado un 10% en todos sus procesos y logrando una ventaja competitiva y de innovación.

title: Central Asian Neobank Alif Expands Across Borders with Hybrid Migration to AWS
summary: Alif is a buy-now-pay-later and mobile-first disruptor in retail banking. Founded in Tajikistan in 2014, the company offers a banking app with no-fee mobile payments, remittances, and consumer financing that customers can manage with their iOS or Android devices.

title: Grupo AJE acelera transformación digital y crecimiento con AWS
summary: Grupo AJE, la cuarta empresa más grande a nivel mundial dedicada a la fabricación de bebidas, apoyó su proceso de transformación digital en las soluciones de Amazon Web Services. De la mano con el partner CloudHesive y expertos de AWS, Grupo AJE implementó soluciones como Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), lambda, AD Connector y AWS VPN, reduciendo en un 10% los tiempos de procesos en ejecución de modelos analíticos y en un 30% los gastos de infraestructura.

title: AWS ayuda a gobierno de Panamá a mantener plan de emergencia durante la pandemia
customer: Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental (AIG)
summary: Ante el escenario y las demandas creadas por la pandemia del COVID-19, la Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental (AIG) enfrentó un importante desafío tecnológico para garantizar la disponibilidad de las aplicaciones y del sitio destinado al soporte del Plan Panamá Solidario. Para asegurar acceso a más de 1,3 millones de familias al sistema de consulta al bono y al crédito disponible, la entidad contó con la ayuda de AWS, que le proporcionó su infraestructura en nube como parte de una acción social de ayuda a los afectados por la pandemia. En pocas horas puso en producción todos los recursos tecnológicos necesarios para asistir al plan de emergencia.

title: Jornada digital no Agibank conta com tecnologia AWS
summary: O Agibank tem ampliado seus canais e portfólio, na busca por tornar as jornadas cada vez mais digitais e sem atrito, independentemente do canal que o cliente acessa. Ao longo desse processo, o Agibank contou com a estrutura e os serviços da AWS.

title: Con AWS, Uruguay pone sistema de solicitud de agenda de vacunación en operación en tiempo récord
customer: Agencia de Sistemas de la Informacion (AGESIC)
summary: El Ministerio de Salud Pública (MSP) de Uruguay junto con la Agencia de Gobierno Electrónico y Sociedad de la Información y del Conocimiento (Agesic), el programa Salud.uy y otros proveedores de tecnología han desarrollado un nuevo sistema de solicitud de agenda para la campaña de vacunas contra el Covid-19 utilizando servicios en la nube de Amazon Web Services. El sistema fue puesto en producción en dos días y actualmente permite que toda la población adulta pueda solicitar agenda y obtener día y hora para vacunarse.

title: Adobe Uses Amazon S3 Glacier to Balance Performance and Cost in Cloud Storage
summary: Adobe provides software solutions for creative and marketing professionals and is using Amazon Web Services (AWS) to provide new capabilities to customers who need fast, reliable access to their photos, videos, and other content in the cloud. In this video, Brandon Pulsipher, vice president of Adobe Cloud Operations, discusses how Adobe uses the Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) Glacier Instant Retrieval storage class to provide its customers with new options for low-latency, cost-effective cloud storage for photos, video, and other creative assets.

title: 88i aposta na tecnologia AWS para brigar com grandes seguradoras
summary: A 88i é a primeira seguradora digital focada em ecossistemas massivos digitais. Fundada há menos de dois anos, a empresa modernizou e digitalizou todo o processo de seguros, da cotação ao momento da liquidação ou pagamento ao cliente, para trazer ao mercado soluções capazes de simplificar os processos e levar seguros também para a população desbancarizada. Neste vídeo, os idealizadores da 88i explicam como o uso dos serviços Amazon Web Services viabilizou o negócio da startup e, mais do que isso, lhe permitiu focar o budget especificamente na parte criativa, de desenvolvimento e de disponibilização de novos recursos para os clientes. Além disso, contam que conseguiram, com o suporte da BRLink e da Darede, ambas empresas parceiras AWS, colocar em prática a sua premissa de ser o mais serverless possível para levar os melhores serviços, mais rapidamente, para os clientes.

title: Vocareum Delivers Virtual Labs to One Million Learners with the Help of AWS EdStart
summary: Vocareum took advantage of Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS, and the guidance of the AWS EdStart program to scale its labs to one million cumulative learners since its inception.

title: Studos Helps Students in Brazil Prepare for University Entrance Exams with Assistance from AWS EdStart
summary: Studos uses the AWS Cloud to deliver a platform that analyzes the skills and abilities of students in basic education. The company's goal is to enable Brazilian students to better prepare for college entrance exams. Studos uses Amazon S3, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Aurora, and the support and guidance of the AWS EdStart program to scale its platform to approximately 10,000 daily users and more than 150,000 users per week.

title: SchoolBzz Improves Critical School-to-Parent Communication with AWS EdStart
summary: SchoolBzz used Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and the guidance of AWS EdStart to scale its service from 600 users to more than 6,400 users.

title: CropX Runs Soil Sensor Application on AWS to Help Global Farmers Enable Sustainability
summary: CropX uses an AWS-based big data solution to enable agricultural sustainability, support a fourfold increase in soil sensor data, quadruple annual sales, and give farmers new insights into their crops.

title: BMW Group sfrutta al meglio la potenza dei dati con un data lake basato su AWS
summary: BMW Group utilizza AWS per elaborare 10 TB di dati al giorno da 1,2 milioni di veicoli, creare un assistente personale a bordo del veicolo ad attivazione vocale e ricavare informazioni in tempo reale dai dati del veicolo e di telemetria del cliente.

title: BMW Group Menggunakan Danau Data Berbasis AWS untuk Membuka Kekuatan Data
summary: BMW Group menggunakan AWS untuk memproses 10 TB data setiap hari dari 1,2 juta kendaraan, menciptakan asisten dalam kendaraan pribadi yang diaktifkan oleh suara, dan memperoleh wawasan waktu nyata dari data telemetri kendaraan dan pelanggan.

title: BMW Group utilise le lac de données basé sur AWS pour exploiter la puissance des données
summary: AWS permet à BMW Group de traiter quotidiennement 10 To de données provenant de 1,2 million de véhicules, de créer un assistant personnel embarqué à commande vocale et de tirer des enseignements en temps réel des données télémétriques des véhicules et des clients.

title: BMW Group utiliza un lago de datos basado en AWS para liberar el poder de los datos

title: Ânima Educação: Digitizing Student Experience for Colleges in Brazil
summary: Join us to learn how João's team at Ânima Educação is building a digital platform for students in Brazil. Legacy learning management systems (LMK) are usually based on premises. Frequently students had to stand in long lines to physically register for classes or manage their assignments. Learn how João's team is migrating from a monolithic, on premises architecture, to a microservices-based architecture on AWS, by leveraging Amazon KMS, optimizing content loading with Amazon Route 53, and integrating Amazon Aurora and Amazon S3 for analytics.

title: Fiverr: Simplifying PCI DSS Compliance with Fully Managed Services
summary: Moshe from Fiverr describes the journey to achieving PCI DSS compliance for his company’s payments processing system. By relying on AWS services that are PCI-compliant and simplifying the design, Fiverr has reduced its architecture in order to minimize both operational and compliance overhead.

title: Etude de cas AWS : Cycloid
summary: Cycloid est une plateforme DevOps permettant d’industrialiser l’approche DevOps et l’accélération / adoption du Cloud. L’objectif: simplifier l’interaction entre les dev et les Ops sur les sujets d’infra / infra as code, favorisant le respect des bonnes pratiques, sans lock-in car implémentant de l’Open Source et complètement interopérable avec tout ce qui se fait en API.

title: The Washington Post: Building a Content Management Platform with Speed at its Core
summary: Arc Publishing is The Washington Post’s state-of-the-art digital publishing platform for media companies, broadcasters, and brands. In this video, Zach showcases how webpages are delivered in Arc’s PageBuilder website development platform. Learn about building a scalable microservices architecture for static and dynamic content rendering used by thousands of websites such as The Washington Post with AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon ElastiCache, Amazon DymamoDB, and other AWS Services.

title: Fix This Podcast #15 - Mission Critical Cloud: State and local government

summary: Part three of the Mission Critical Cloud mini-series explores the future of work and how state and local governments use the cloud to deliver services to citizens.

title: St. Louis University: Using Amazon Lex to Answer Students' Questions Through Alexa and a Mobile App
summary: Learn how St. Louis University uses Amazon Lex, Amazon OpenSearch Service, and Amazon Comprehend to build a Q&A chatbot for students and staff. Learn how users can get up-to-date answers to their questions on the go, while providing insight to content owners to ensure they are providing the information their students and faculty need.

title: Innovapost: Scaling to 5M Package Deliveries with Serverless
summary: With e-commerce driving up package deliveries into the millions per day, the systems that manage shipping and freight need to be reimagined. Learn how Innovapost and Purolator developed an all serverless solution with AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, and Amazon RDS to not only scale, but also simplify and add extensibility to the workflow.

title: Mahindra Electric: Building a Connected Electric Vehicle Platform on AWS
summary: Mahindra Electric foresees a large scale adoption of electric vehicles in India by 2030. In this episode, learn how Santhosh and his team created NEMO, a cloud-based mobility platform that enables a new generation of shared, connected & electric services. Dive deep into how the team leverages Amazon Kinesis for real time data streaming, Amazon Athena and Amazon Glue to build advanced actionable intelligence around vehicle, charging and fleet performance. Santhosh also walks us through how to leverage a data lake on Amazon S3 and AWS Serverless architecture to build a new set of business models around shared mobility, while enabling fleet operators to seamlessly manage a fleet of electric vehicles.

title: Fix This Podcast #14 - Mission Critical Cloud: Remote education
customer: Los Angeles Unified School District, Athabasca University, Pearson
summary: Part two of the Mission Critical Cloud mini-series by Teresa Carlson dives deep to explore remote education.

title: AXA Scales Cloud Adoption on AWS
summary: For AXA, creating technical standards to ensure consistency across the organization was critical. AXA turned to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to overcome this challenge by implementing a custom global landing zone using AWS services and best practices.

title: WarnerMedia: Cloud-based Linear Playout System
summary: WarnerMedia presents its file-based broadcast-channel playout system. Due to high-profile content such as Game of Thrones, the system provides three paths of resiliency for broadcast, including affiliate delivery plus an emergency workflow that includes remote access. WarnerMedia has also designed its system to auto-failover between on-premises and cloud playout including dual AWS Direct Connect paths. The system leverages the broad library of HBO assets stored in Amazon S3, enabling playout on-demand.

title: AQR: Using ECS to Provide Dev Teams Security & Authentication on a Scalable Container Platform
summary: Alan from AQR, a global investment management firm, explains how he and his team created an AWS platform as a service (PaaS), enabling teams to develop their containerized applications on Amazon ECS while providing free security certificates, SSL communication, and Kerberos authentication as side-car security services.

title: ViacomCBS: Multiplatform Distribution Powered by AWS
summary: ViacomCBS's Multiplatform Distribution uses AWS services and partners as its media supply chain to process, orchestrate, and deliver media for linear and video-on-demand (VOD) distribution platforms. The system uses AWS to safely ingest media as well as categorize and collate various metadata formats into a single standard to (1) allow a single company-wide metadata schema upstream for all downstream product/platforms and distribution; (2) improve the use and accuracy of AI and personnel-assisted de-duplication of archive assets stored in a data lake containing in excess of 40+ PB; and (3) package media and metadata for long-term storage and archiving in the cloud.

title: Fix This Podcast #13 - Mission Critical Cloud: A chat with AWS leaders
summary: Join Teresa Carlson for a chat with other AWS leaders. We dive into how technology helps public sector organizations deliver on their missions.

title: Vizio: Smart TV Analytics at Scale
summary: In this episode of This Is My Architecture, learn how Vizio ingests billions of messages from millions of smart TVs into its analytics solution on AWS. You'll see how they leverage Kinesis, Redshift, S3, and QuickSight to ingest messages, store them, and turn them into actionable data.

title: Fix This Podcast #12 - Happy Earth Day
customer: Jour de la Terre, Nat Sahlstrom
summary: Explore how the AWS Cloud can reduce an organization's IT carbon footprint by up to 88%.

title: Unlocking siloed data to further cancer research
summary: Using Amazon Web Services (AWS) and open-source software, Fred Hutch built a single, user-friendly, browser-based solution, Motuz, to streamline and simplify upload of large quantities of data.

title: Zappos: Back Office Migration, starring Amazon ECS and Amazon Aurora
summary: Learn how Zappos updated its back office systems by using Amazon ECS for consistent deployments and how the company migrated off of Oracle onto Amazon Aurora MySQL.

title: Homesite: Event-Driven Data Analytics Platform Using Amazon Neptune
summary: Learn how How Homesite Insurance uses an Amazon Neptune graph database as a pipeline processing stage to connect customer activities through a variety of touchpoints and data sources.

title: Fix This Podcast #11 - Tracking birds
summary: Open data connects the world in unexpected ways—like tracking birds using weather data & machine learning.

title: JD Power: Building a Rankings & Insights Engine with Data Lakes & Machine Learning on AWS
summary: Sandeep from JD Power tells us how the company built a data analytics solution on AWS called AI Cloud. JD Power processes terabytes of data performing customer satisfaction research on thousands of product categories producing product insights and rankings in industries such as automotive, healthcare, and electronics. Learn how to build a data lake on Amazon S3 pulling in data from multiple inputs, such as FTP, Amazon S3, and Amazon RDS. Once the data is centrally located, Sandeep shows us how to build catalogs with AWS Glue and custom crawlers running on AWS Fargate. You will also learn how to use Amazon Athena and Amazon Redshift for analytics and machine learning to draw insights from these datasets.

title: VietJet: Proactively Defending Your Systems from Bad Bots
summary: Servicing 25M requests from their website per day, VietJet needed a clever solution to mitigate bot traffic to its airline booking system preventing denial of inventory to its customers. In this episode of This is my Architecture we look at how they extended Amazon CloudFront and AWS WAF by incorporating additional pattern matching logic with Lambda at edge. We also learn how to use Kinesis Firehose, S3, Lambda and Athena to analyze all the traffic and proactively identify new threats.

title: Truffle: Build and Deploy Ethereum Smart Contracts with Truffle and AWS Cloud9
summary: Tim from Truffle shows us how to build a Decentralized Application (dApp) with Truffle Suite on AWS. Blockchain developers will learn how to write an Ethereum smart contract, configure a project using the Truffle Framework, create a local instance of their Ethereum test network with Ganache, and leverage the collection of front-end libraries that make writing dApp user interfaces easier and more predictable with Drizzle, all from the Cloud9 console.

title: Fix This Podcast #10 - Zero waste trucking
summary: Buckle up, we're driving into the world of sustainable trucking and the machine learning that powers it.

title: Dentsu Tracking: Using Serverless to Power an EU Government Supply-Chain Control System
summary: Hear how Dentsu Tracking, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, is powering one of the world’s largest traceability platforms using serverless technologies. The platform is a government supply-chain control system, used by the European Commission to protect citizen health and combat illicit trade. Hear how Dentsu Tracking addresses the immense scalability challenges, tracking and tracing 150 billion products in near real-time from production to retail. The system is based on AWS serverless technologies and combines the use of multiple Lambda Functions, an API Gateway, SQS queues, DynamoDB tables, ElasticCache, Amazon S3, and Redshift.

title: Miroculus: Digital Microfluidics Platform
summary: Miroculus has developed a novel digital microfluidics technology to automate and miniaturize genomic protocols such as next generation sequencing sample preparation, synthetic biology, cell editing, and combinatorial chemistry, in a compact, user-friendly system. This includes seamless workflow integration from novel molecular protocols to data analytics. By combining AWS IoT, AWS SQS and Amazon OpenSearch Service Miroculus is able to scale to have hundreds of devices connected on the same platform. They generate thousands of messages per second, that are consumed by different API’s in order to give their users the flexibility and the visibility needed for their businesses. The solution relies on queues in order to decouple the producers from the consumers. On a completely separate tier, a combination of microservices and visualization provides flexibility to present analytical data to Miroculus customers. With these AWS tools Miroculus is able to make the most complex protocols easy and accessible to scientists everywhere.

title: Halodoc: Building the Future of Tele-Health One Microservice at a Time (Special Episode)
summary: Halodoc, a Jakarta-based healthtech platform, uses tele-health and artificial intelligence to connect patients, doctors, and pharmacies. Join builder Adrian De Luca as he dives deep into the solutions architecture of this Indonesian health-tech platform that provides healthcare services in one of the most challenging traffic environments in the world. Explore how they evolved their monolithic back end into decoupled microservices with Amazon EC2 & SQS, adopted serverless to cost effectively support new user functionality with AWS Lambda, and manage the high volume and velocity of data with Amazon DynamoDB, RDS and Redshift.

title: RavenPack Shifts Analytics Service up a Gear with Amazon Athena
summary: RavenPack improves the efficiency of big data querying for financial services clients, helping them make better decisions. The company provides news and text analytics services to organizations such as hedge funds and banks. It uses interactive serverless query service Amazon Athena to run customers’ analytics requests.

title: Expedia: Salesforce Integration with AWS
summary: Sandeep from Expedia will explain how they built scalable & flexible system to ingest high data Volume both real time & batch leveraging AWS platform & services. You will learn how Amazon Glue and Amazon EC2 helped ingesting & transforming heterogenous data, use bookmark capabilities of Glue & push data to Centralized S3 Data Lake. You will also learn how Amazon Dynamo and Amazon ECS helped ingesting real time data & loading into RDS Aurora along with monitoring & alerting using Cloud watch . You will also learn how Expedia systems and Salesforce platform integrate using the power of the AWS platform with seamless experience to users.

title: Mueller Water Products: A Water Intelligent Platform
summary: On the next This Is My Architecture, Heath from Mueller Water Products will explain how his team built a machine learning pipeline using AWS managed services. You will learn how Amazon Direct Connect is used to ingest data from a network of IoT connected smart fire hydrants. You will learn how Amazon ECS services are used to analyze and filter IoT data. You will learn how Amazon ECS and Amazon SageMaker are used to turn that curated data into actionable intelligence.

title: Fix This Podcast #9 - More than voting…
summary: From voter engagement to elections management, innovative use of the cloud can help make the election process more accessible.

title: Tsukuba City

title: PixelStrings by Cinnafilm: A Flexible & Scalable Platform for Video/Audio Optimization & Conversion
summary: Alfred She from Cinnafilm, Inc. explains how the company uses native AWS services to implement PixelStrings, a flexible and scalable platform for video and audio processing. PixelStrings offers transcoding, high-quality motion-based frame rate conversion, audio and video retiming, deinterlacing, denoising, and re-texturing. Learn how Amazon EC2 (general compute and GPU instances), Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda work together in the PixelStrings video/audio processing PaaS (Platform as a Service). PixelStrings provides a full-stack web application and a JSON-RPC API that customers use to upload, process, and download video and audio assets.

title: Fix This Podcast #8 - Data in homelessness
summary: Learn how the cloud & data interoperability can improve outcomes for homeless populations.

title: Fix This Podcast #7 - From Kenya to space
summary: From workforce development to preserving artifacts—the cloud changes how we think about the future.

title: NextGen Healthcare: Build and Deployment Pipelines in the Highly Regulated Healthcare Sector
summary: Owen from NextGen Healthcare, explains how the company developed a series of build and deployment pipelines using native AWS services in the highly regulated healthcare sector. Learn how AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CloudFormation can be used to build and deploy infrastructure and application code. Discover how AWS resources can be rapidly created and updated as part of a CI/CD pipeline while ensuring HIPAA compliance through approved/vetted AWS IAM Roles that AWS CloudFormation is permitted to assume.

title: Zalando: Highly Scalable Data Processing Pipeline
summary: Learn how Zalando built a serverless event data processing pipeline that handles thousands of events per second and dumps them into a data lake.

title: AWS Solutions: Real-Time IoT Device Monitoring with Kinesis Data Analytics
summary: Monitoring IoT devices in real-time can provide valuable insight that can help you maintain the reliability, availability, and performance of your IoT devices. You can track time series data on device connectivity and activity. This insight can help you react quickly to changing conditions and emerging situations.

title: William Hill: High-performance DDOS Protection with AWS
summary: William Hill have built a high-performance DDOS and Edge Protection platform using AWS Services - (CloudFront, Shield Advanced, WAF, R5 Instances, Lambda and DynamoDB and Streams). The solution has been effective in mitigating a 177 GBPS DDOS attack and 48 million attempted exploits (so far in 2019) from across 121,000 IPs and 196 countries. In addition, their build successfully blocked 63 million requests from 180,000 IPs from 202 countries - all trying to scrape pricing and event data, which is successful is highly detrimental to the business and customer experience.

title: Nike: A Social Graph at Scale with Amazon Neptune
summary: Getting a graph database to be performant and easy to use is very different from making a NoSQL (non-relational) database high-performing. Listen in as Todd Escalona of AWS talks with Marc Wangenheim, Senior Engineering Manager at Nike, about how the company powers a number of applications via a social graph, built on Amazon Neptune, which effectively maps millions of relationships among its users.

title: Pason Systems: Petabyte Scale Drilling Datamart on AWS (LIVE)
summary: Learn how Pason built a petabyte scalable customer-facing drilling datamart using AWS services. Ed Quan from Pason describes how Amazon EMR, along with Presto, can be used to provide a secure and seamless SQL interface to data that is stored in Amazon RDS and Hive. Hive is used to periodically ETL billions of sensor data points from microservices into S3 and EMRFS. You will also learn how multiple EMR clusters were used to provide high availability and distribute workloads across this solution.

title: Fix This Podcast #6 - Quest to end modern slavery

Using AWS IoT Core we explore how sensor data is collected and streamed into AWS Lambda-based microservices to process at scale. We also explore large scale distributed data aggregate using services like Amazon API Gateway and Amazon SQS.

title: UltraServe: Application Vending Machine with Runtime Event Control (LIVE)
summary: Troy Fisher, CTO of UltraServe, explains the complexity of achieving parity for application environments. Learn how UltraServe built a fully automated environment and application vending machine with AWS' serverless technologies.

title: The Trade Desk: Real-time Ad Bidding in the Cloud with AWS Global Accelerator (LIVE)
summary: Learn how The Trade Desk built a global, real-time ad bidding system on AWS without having to implement major architectural changes, thanks to its use of AWS Global Accelerator. The Trade Desk processes millions of messages per second while keeping latency low, and can scale to handle many gigabits of data per second on the back end. You'll also learn how the company uses Amazon S3-backed Vertica with Eon Mode for long-term storage and analytics with petabytes of data.

title: Mueller Water Products: Scalable Ingestion of Sensor Data for Municipal Water Conservation (LIVE)
summary: Eugene Alfonso from Mueller Water Products explains how he built a scalable and cost-effective notifications engine using native AWS services. Learn how Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon SES, and AWS Lambda can be leveraged to notify your customers of alerts in real time. By leveraging these elastic services, you can handle any number of notifications in your system, from 10s to millions, with the same workflow, only paying for what you use and having automated scaling.

title: AWS Solutions: Multi-Region Availability with Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, and Amazon Cognito (LIVE)
summary: George Bearden from the AWS Solutions Builders team sheds light on common challenges of multi-region availability. In many cases, data redundancy can be achieved through built-in features such as Amazon S3's cross-region replication and versioning. However, services like Amazon Cognito require a bit more work. Learn what AWS has done to help you minimize your effort.

title: Adobe: Simplifying Networking Across Thousands of AWS Accounts with AWS Transit Gateway (LIVE)
summary: In this special live segment of TMA, you’ll hear about the challenges the networking team at Adobe had when managing and provisioning thousands of AWS accounts. Discover how they solved these challenges with AWS Transit Gateway and AWS PrivateLink.

title: Accolade: Security and Operational Excellence in Healthcare (LIVE)
summary: With cutting-edge technology like serverless on AWS, Accolade connects personal health data, employer programs, and wellness tools to provide personalized health and benefits solutions for employees. Accolade moved toward a serverless approach centered on Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, AWS Lambda@Edge, and Amazon CloudFront to complement their use of containers. Minhui Burket, Senior Software Engineer at Accolade, explains how AWS has enabled Accolade to modernize its services, reduce cost, and improve security.

title: Formula 1: Using Amazon SageMaker to Deliver Real-Time Insights to Fans (LIVE)
summary: In this special live segment of TMA, you’ll see what’s under the hood of Formula 1's F1 Insights. Hear about the machine learning algorithms they train on Amazon SageMaker and how they make inferences during races to deliver insights to fans.

summary: The AI Powered Speech Analytics for Amazon Connect solution provides customer insights in real time, and helps agents and supervisors better understand and respond to customer needs so they can resolve customer issues and improve the overall customer experience. The solution includes pre-trained AWS artificial intelligence (AI) services that enable customers to transcribe, translate, and analyze each customer interaction in Amazon Connect, and presents this information to assist contact center agents during their conversations.

Its primary focus is providing accommodation information, a reservation platform, budget hotel franchise offers, and travel content to prospective travelers.

summary: Xylem is a leading water technology company committed to "solving water" by creating innovative and smart technologies to meet the world's water, wastewater, and energy needs. summary: With AWS, WhaTap Labs services can monitor various IT environments in one place simultaneously, and if downtime occurs, also provides a real-time detection and notification function.

summary: Volkswagen Group is building its Industrial Cloud, a cloud-based digital production platform that will transform Volkswagen’s automotive manufacturing and logistics processes, on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

title: Il Gruppo Volkswagen in AWS
summary: Innovatore del settore automobilistico da oltre 80 anni, il Gruppo Volkswagen è il più grande costruttore di automobili in Europa e produce 11 milioni di auto all'anno. Per trasformare i processi produttivi e logistici del settore automobilistico, il Gruppo ha creato il Volkswagen Industrial Cloud su Amazon Web Services (AWS), che utilizza i servizi AWS Internet delle cose (IoT) per collegare i dati di tutte le macchine, gli impianti e i sistemi di oltre 120 siti produttivi. Il Volkswagen Industrial Cloud mira a ottenere un aumento del 30% della produttività, una riduzione del 30% dei costi di fabbrica e un miliardo di euro di risparmi nella catena di distribuzione.

title: Die Volkswagen Gruppe in AWS

Um seine Automobilfertigungs- und Logistikprozesse zu transformieren, hat der Konzern die Volkswagen Industrial Cloud auf Amazon Web Services (AWS) aufgebaut, die AWS-Internet-of-Things-Services (IoT) nutzt, um Daten von allen Maschinen, Anlagen und Systemen in mehr als 120 Fabriken zu verbinden. Die Volkswagen Industrial Cloud soll eine Produktivitätssteigerung von 30 Prozent, eine Senkung der Fabrikkosten um 30 Prozent und eine Einsparung von 1 Milliarde Euro in den Kosten der Lieferkette ermöglichen. Die Gruppe nutzt AWS auch, um über die Fertigung hinaus in Mitfahrservices, vernetzte Fahrzeuge und immersive, virtuelle Autokauferlebnisse zu expandieren und so die Zukunft der Mobilität zu gestalten.

title: Uploadcare Handles Millions of Files a Day for Businesses Worldwide
