title: TV1.EU Uses AWS to Reliably Stream Live Events to Hundreds of Thousands of Viewers
TransferWise Grows Globally by Migrating Financial Applications to AWS
summary: TransferWise migrated its applications and databases to AWS using services including AWS Storage Gateway and AWS Backup to support global business growth.

title: The Trade Desk Transforms its Real-time Bidding Strategy with AWS
summary: The Trade Desk is an advertising technology company that provides a self-service platform through which media buyers can purchase digital advertising. The company recently began shifting its real-time bidding workload—which receives 10 million queries per second, 800 billion queries per day, and requires an average response-time of less than 15 milliseconds—to the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud, building four new sites in 2019.

title: Toyota Research Institute. Advanced Development, Inc.
summary: Toyota Research Institute Advanced Development, Inc. (TRI-AD) uses AWS to keep pace with the accelerating development of automated driving, developing an automatic map generation platform on an AWS serverless architecture in just two months.

title: Toracom aumenta facturación un 200% con servicios de IoT e AI con AWS
summary: TORAcom se dedica al desarrollo de plataformas digitales en internet. Hace seis años, la compañía empezó usando a los servidores de Amazon Elastic compute Cloud (ec2) como host para las aplicaciones que desarrollaban para sus clientes. Después de algunos años, con el crecimiento del negocio, Toracom conoció la arquitectura sin servidores. Desde 2018, la compañía se inclinó por la parte de serverless applications y desde entonces lo que hace con los clientes es automáticamente autoescalable, muy seguro y flexible.

title: TNG Management Saves 30–40% of Its Time With AWS as a Single-Source Provider
summary: TNG FinTech Group securely migrated targeted workloads to AWS to reduce analytics processing time through automation.

title: T-Mobile Drives Innovation in the AWS Cloud
summary: Watch this video featuring Warren McNeel, SVP of product and technology at T-Mobile, to hear more about the company’s journey of business transformation on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and how that transformation has helped grow its customer base from 33 million subscribers in 2012 to 84 million subscribers today.

title: The Pokémon Company esegue la migrazione a database AWS dedicati
summary: The Pokémon Company International ha eseguito la migrazione da un database di documenti NoSQL di terze parti a un servizio di database AWS completamente gestito, riducendo significativamente i costi mensili e passando da 300 a 30 nodi.

title: The Pokémon Company Migrates to AWS Purpose-Built Databases
summary: The Pokémon Company International migrated from a third-party NoSQL document database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, significantly reducing monthly costs and consolidating 300 nodes to 30.

title: Synchronized and TF1 use AWS Rekognition to automate thumbnail creation for more than 500 hours of programmes
summary: The Synchronized platform transforms linear and passive videos into smart videos. Its artificial intelligence understands the content of a video and enriches it with metadata.

title: Indonesian Magazine Transitions Seamlessly from Print to Digital Using AWS
summary: Tempo.co relies on AWS to support its website and mobile app to make sure that readers of online news stay informed even when the biggest stories break and site visits spike 400 percent.

title: Telecom Argentina inicia su estrategia de cloud hibrida con AWS
summary: Telecom Argentina es una empresa líder de soluciones de conectividad y entretenimiento con más de 23.000 colaboradores. Ofrece a más de 29 millones de clientes individuales, empresas e instituciones de todo el país servicio seguro, flexible y dinámico, en todos sus dispositivos, con conexiones fijas y móviles de alta velocidad, y una plataforma de contenidos en vivo y a demanda que integra series, películas, gaming, música y programas de TV. En la actualidad está transitando un camino de profunda transformación digital de sus operaciones y de su cultura, en la que la cloudificación resulta uno de los principales habilitadores tecnológicos.

title: Caso de Éxito AWS: El Tajonaso
summary: Super Centro El Tajonaso es una importante cadena de supermercados, con más de 400 empleados en tres sucursales ubicadas en distintos puntos de Panamá Oeste y, más recientemente, en una red de restaurantes. En este video, Jorge Velásquez, administrador de sistemas del Tajonaso, nos cuenta que la compañía tuvo el reto de la implementación de un nuevo sistema financiero contable. El desafío era el costo inicial de infraestructura, por lo que AWS, con la flexibilidad que ofrece en temas de infraestructura fue clave para dar este paso.

title: Swiss Medical utiliza tecnologías AWS para obtener más agilidad e innovar sus operaciones
summary: Swiss Medical es un grupo de capitales argentinos, con más de 12,500 empleados y empresas en múltiples divisiones de la salud, incluyendo clínicas, centros médicos, centros de ortodoncia y grupos de financiación. Los negocios de Swiss Medical estaban creciendo mucho más que su departamento de TI, lo que llevó la empresa a buscar soluciones AWS que pudieran generar agilidad e innovación. En este momento, la empresa está trabajando en la migración de su ERP SAP con la nube. Y en el lado de la innovación, Swiss Medical está desarrollando un asistente virtual para los pacientes, sus clínicas, utilizando las plataformas AWS Cloud9 y lambda.

title: Swiss Post Innovates on Secure Foundation with AWS
summary: Swiss Post had innovation and growth plans but it was being held back by legacy IT. AWS helped Swiss Post transform its entire technology stack to make it more agile, responsive, and secure.

title: Sweetgreen case study
summary: California-based restaurant chain Sweetgreen serves up freshly-made salads and other sustainably-grown foods. The company acquires data from more 30 data sources across its ecosystem, including farms, wholesale distributors, point-of-sales (POS) systems, chatbots, and Sweetgreen's mobile and web applications. Sweetgreen stores hundreds of terabytes of that data in its data lake, built on Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) using Amazon S3 Standard and Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage classes.

title: Seguros Sura obtiene flexibilidad en sus negocios con tecnologías AWS
summary: Seguros Sura se dedica a los seguros y a la gestión de tendencias y riesgos. Es una compañía que opera en Argentina y en otros 9 países de Latinoamérica. Puntualmente en Argentina tiene aproximadamente un millón de clientes y un millón y medio de ítems asegurados. En Latinoamérica Sura tiene acerca de 17 millones de clientes. Buscando obtener más flexibilidad en sus operaciones diarias, Sura identificó en AWS las tecnologías necesarias para trabajar de manera más eficiente y enfocada en sus clientes. Con la implementación de Amazon Connect junto con lambda, Sura puede predecir lo que el cliente quiere hacer y dárselo de una manera más rápida y sencilla. Sura ha trabajado en este proyecto con el socio de negocios APN Edrans para la creación de la arquitectura.

title: Dominik Safaric, Head of Infrastructure, Styria.AI on Benefits of Using AWS as a Platform
summary: Dominik Safaric, Head of Engineering and Infrastructure, Styria.AI, Croatian Media News and Marketplace Solution Provider on benefits of using AWS as a platform, and also on why and how serverless and AI/ML solutions are important for their business.

title: StashAway Expands Wealth Management Platform on AWS
summary: By building its app on AWS, StashAway has cut infrastructure costs for development by 90 percent while also ensuring compliance with various country-specific financial regulations.

title: Breaking the Banking Mould
summary: Find out how UK-based digital bank uses AWS to disrupt the financial services industry.

title: Sportsbet Migrates to AWS to Support 50,000 Bets Per Minute and Personalize Customer Experience
summary: Amazon Lab126 uses AWS to run HPC jobs and scale workloads three times faster, onboard new users in less than a day instead of weeks, and drive award-winning product design innovation.

title: Uso da plataforma AWS amplia capacidade de expansão da Sponte
summary: Com todos seus clientes rodando na nuvem, hoje a Sponte atende aproximadamente 30 mil usuários conectados. Na área educacional, são mais de 2 milhões de alunos gerenciados com apoio da AWS.

title: Spectro reduce sus costos de infraestructura en 90 % con migración a la nube AWS
summary: Spectro es una empresa que toma datos de telecomunicaciones y provee, con base en ello, análisis de alto valor agregado para espacios comerciales. Con 4 años de existencia, la compañía cuenta con operaciones en Argentina y en Chile. Con la migración de sus sistemas a la nube, Spectro ha logrado reducir los costos de una serie de componentes importantes de su infraestructura en más de un 90 %, en menos de 6 meses.

title: TBC Launches Space Neobank in 8 Months Using AWS
summary: TBC Bank gets its digital, cloud-only bank to market in 8 months using AWS. Established in 2018, Space Neobank provides retail banking services to more than 200,000 customers across Georgia. It uses Amazon Rekognition as well as services such as Corezoid Process Engine from the Amazon Marketplace to accelerate provisioning and innovation.

title: Sony Bank is one of the first financial institutions to adopt the cloud that helped it reduce costs by up to 60%
summary: Sony Bank, a member of the Sony Financial Group, provides high-quality financial services. With an IT strategy focused on the latest technology, the company became one of the first financial institutions in Japan to adopt Amazon Web Services (AWS). The bank began progressively migrating its general in-house business systems and peripheral banking systems at the end of 2013, and by late 2019, about 80% of all systems ran on AWS. The bank is now building a cloud-native core banking system that uses the abundant services of AWS for a full-scale release in fiscal 2022.

title: How Sony Music is Innovating on Digital Rights Management with Amazon Managed Blockchain
summary: Sony Music discusses how it is building its new digital rights management solution leveraging blockchain and why it chose to build using Amazon Managed Blockchain.

title: How Sony Interactive Entertainment renders with AWS
summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) Worldwide Studios is a diverse network of highly successful and passionate game development studios and support functions, responsible for creating some of the world’s most well-known PlayStation games. In this session, SIE Cloud Infrastructure Project Manager Asghar Nisar and Engineer Andy Taylor share how SIE is modernizing its existing infrastructure to remotely render visual images and effects using AWS.

title: Estudio de caso AWS: Solutions HTech
summary: Solutions HTech, una empresa 100% mexicana prestadora de servicios de tecnología de información, tales como aplicaciones web, telefonía móvil y plataformas de conexión para medianas y grandes empresas en las áreas de comunicación y entretenimiento. La compañía también ofrece servicios de desarrollo de software a través de los cuales entrega desde sistemas a la medida acorde a las necesidades específicas de sus clientes, hasta innovadoras y eficientes aplicaciones que se adaptan a los dispositivos móviles más utilizados en el mundo. El portafolio de HTech incluye outsourcing y soporte técnico para tareas de TI, garantizando a los clientes optimización de costos de infraestructura y una mayor capacidad de respuesta con soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas.

title: AWS Customer Success Story: Solarisbank
summary: Berlin-based Solarisbank is Europe's leading banking-as-a-service (BaaS) platform for business customers across all industries. As a bank with a full German banking license, Solarisbank enables other companies to offer their own financial services. In 2020, the FinTech has gone all-in on AWS. Watch Solarisbank share their migration journey to AWS, how their platform is evolving, and how they operate securely and in-compliance using AWS.

title: Social Quantum Finds AWS a Game Changer
summary: Social Quantum, an established, mid-sized Russian game developer needed to reduce costs and reduce time to market. It has already shut down 50 legacy servers and improved reliability using AWS.

title: Paint Firm Is Primed for International Growth withSAP on AWS
summary: With AWS, Śnieżka has lowered costs, freed up its IT team, and gained a scalable SAP environment to help it expand internationally. The company is the market leader in paints and varnishes in Poland, Belarus, Ukraine, and Hungary. It worked with AWS APN Partner SE16N to build its AWS environment for SAP using AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, and Amazon Aurora.

title: Snap Finance acelera procesos de innovación con AWS
summary: Snap Finance, empresa que otorga crédito a consumidores, con clientes en Estados Unidos y UK, cuenta con una oficina de back office operacional y soporte de tecnología en Costa Rica. La compañía tiene en ese momento el 100% de su infraestructura en AWS. Con el soporte del partner Escala 24/7, Snap Finance migró la infraestructura sin ningún problema y sin la necesidad de hacer inversiones en hardware adicional.

title: Mortgage Closings in 15 Minutes with Snapdocs on AWS
summary: Snapdocs, a real estate technology company, uses AI on AWS to enable a digital mortgage-closing experience for mortgage lenders, title companies, signing agents, and homebuyers at unlimited scale.

title: Skyscanner Improves Response Time by 98% Using AWS Global Accelerator
summary: Skyscanner uses AWS Global Accelerator to further strengthen availability and performance by routing customer traffic to the closest application endpoint over the congestion-free AWS global network.

title: SkyAlert utiliza servicios AWS para ayudar a salvar vidas ante riesgos naturales
summary: SkyAlert es una empresa de tecnología innovadora que contribuye a alertar oportunamente a millones de personas que viven en zonas vulnerables, promoviendo una cultura de prevención ante riesgos naturales. Con el objetivo de brindar a los clientes, tanto empresas y negocios como particulares, las herramientas adecuadas para que puedan estar prevenidos ante un evento sísmico, SkyAlert migró recientemente su infraestructura de Azure a la nube de Amazon Web Services. Bajo la nueva tecnología, la empresa logró integrar una operación del Internet de las Cosas (IoT) a los servicios y servidores AWS, además de implantar un servicio eficiente de envío de alertas que le permite escalar y enviar millones de mensajes en pocos segundos, ayudando a salvar vidas en casos de sismos.

title: SiteMinder Scales Quickly, Reduces Costs on AWS
summary: SiteMinder, a hotel guest acquisition platform, works with some of the world's largest hospitality companies. Buidling on Amazon Web Services (AWS), SiteMinder has been able to scale quickly and innovate with new technologies like machine learning to stay one step ahead and delight guests.

title: SGX Uses Amazon Managed Blockchain to Build Innovative Payment Solution
summary: SGX relies on Amazon Managed Blockchain to create a blockchain environment in days, increase data transfer and transaction efficiency, and cut trade settlement time by up to 60 percent.

title: Siemens su AWS
summary: Siemens AG, leader globale nell'elettrificazione, nell'automazione e nella digitalizzazione, guida l'innovazione in vari settori da oltre 175 anni. Siemens utilizza una gamma di tecnologie Amazon Web Services (AWS) per portare avanti la tradizione della trasformazione, portando l'Internet delle cose industriale (IIoT) a ferrovie e fabbriche, sviluppando infrastrutture intelligenti per edifici e sistemi di energia distribuiti, implementando l'intelligenza artificiale (IA) sulla piattaforma di cybersecurity e molto altro. Dalla modernizzazione dell'infrastruttura di dati e delle funzionalità di analisi con AWS Glue e Amazon Athena all'utilizzo di Amazon Neptune e AWS Lambda per creare Building Twin di Siemens. Ogni passaggio intrapreso dall'organizzazione nel cloud AWS apporta nuova efficienza, valore e informazioni per migliorare le operazioni per Siemens e i suoi clienti.

title: Siemens on AWS
summary: Die Siemens AG ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen in den Bereichen Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung. Seit fast 175 Jahren treibt Siemens Innovationen in verschiedenen Branchen voran. Das Unternehmen setzt zahlreiche AWS-Services ein, um diese Tradition des Wandels fortzuführen: Beispielsweise bringt es das industrielle Internet der Dinge (Industrial Internet of Things, IIoT) in Eisenbahnen und Fabriken, entwickelt intelligente Infrastruktur für Gebäude sowie verteilte Energiesysteme und implementiert AI in seine Cybersicherheit-Plattform.

title: Siemens on AWS
summary: Siemens uses an array of AWS services to bring IIOT to railways and factories, developing intelligent infrastructure for buildings and distributed energy systems, implementing AI into its cybersecurity platform, and more.

title: Siemens Energy Accelerates Application Development with metaphactory Knowledge Graph
summary: Through the metaphactory platform procured from AWS Marketplace, Siemens Energy built and deployed an end-user oriented custom knowledge graph application for managing its fleet of large gas turbines in just six months.

title: ShopBack Cuts Infrastructure Costs by 60% with Amazon EC2 Spot Instances
summary: ShopBack, which provides consumers with a loyalty rewards platform to earn cashback on purchases, uses Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to cut costs and improve site stability and scalability as it grows.

title: Shih Chien University Drives Cloud-Based Training on AWS
summary: By migrating to the AWS Cloud, Shih Chien University (USC) expects to save 20 percent on labor costs, lower utility bills by 25 percent, improve data security, and enhance its reputation as a leading-edge technical institution.

title: Etude de cas AWS : SendinBlue
summary: Racheter son concurrent allemand et bâtir le géant européen du marketing digital : Mickael Arias, le CTO de la startup SendinBlue nous partage ses meilleurs conseils pour scaler rapidement et construire des équipes solides.

title: Seguros Múltiples incorpora Alexa para beneficio de sus clientes
customer: Cooperativa de Seguros Multiples de Puerto Rico
summary: La Cooperativa Seguros Múltiples es una de las más grandes aseguradoras de Puerto Rico, con más de 600 mil clientes. Para mantenerse a la vanguardia en tecnología, la compañía hace inversiones continuas para fortalecer sus canales virtuales y todo lo que es innovación para mejorar la experiencia de sus asociados. Este año, Seguros Múltiples incorporó el asistente virtual Alexa de Amazon a los servicios de atención que ofrecen a los asegurados.

title: Seguros Bolívar aumenta competitividad y ventas con plataforma de interconexión vía APIs
summary: Seguros Bolívar es una compañía aseguradora colombiana que brinda una gran variedad de productos y servicios a sus clientes. Para ampliar su competitividad en una industria que se vuelve cada vez más digital, la compañía desarrolló el proyecto Seguros Bolívar Conecta. Por medio de esta plataforma de interconexión con intermediarios y demás aliados externos, la empresa logró ofrecer funciones, servicios e información que pueden resultar en un crecimiento en primas del 57% en ventas digitales.

title: Segment Enables Customers to Create Custom Recommendations with Amazon Personalize
summary: Segment is a customer data infrastructure company that uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help its customers collect and unify data about their users and create personalized recommendations from that data with Amazon Personalize. The company processes 450 billion events per month, using thousands of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) instances, and runs more than 16,000 Docker containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS).

title: schuh Case Study
summary: UK footwear retailer schuh uses Amazon Comprehend to categorise and intelligently allocate the right support to customers. This gives it confidence that it can deliver a superior customer experience.

title: SCB Abacus Promotes Financial Inclusion With AWS AI & Big Data Technologies
summary: By leveraging AWS AI and Big Data technologies for its financial services platform, SCB Abacus has been able to make the loan process for customers seamless, update service features quickly, and comply with international standards.

title: Samsung Engineering Streams Complex Apps Using Amazon AppStream 2.0
summary: Samsung Engineering streams complex design and information management applications from the cloud using Amazon AppStream 2.0, cuts costs by 20 percent, and enables faster expansion into new markets.

title: Sallie Mae Goes All-in on the Cloud in Just Months with AWS Managed Services
summary: Sallie Mae used AWS to go all-in on cloud services in a matter of months. The bank provides financing and know-how for college-bound students, and it offers products and resources to help customers make new goals and experiences possible beyond college. Sallie Mae turned to AWS Managed Services to help execute its digital transformation to the cloud, positioning the bank to better serve its digital-native clientele.

title: Saildrone Explore the Oceans Using AWS Machine Learning
summary: Saildrone collects global environment data with its wind-powered ocean drones. The company uses machine learning on AWS to better quantify the behavior and trends of major fish stocks and their predators, such as sharks and seals, to help with conservation efforts and sustainable fishery management. Saildrone has recently completed the first successful autonomous circumnavigation of Antarctica, producing key insights into ocean and climate processes, and used machine learning on AWS to identify the risk of collision with icebergs.

title: Salesforce CDP Unifies Consumer Data at Exabyte Scale on AWS
summary: In this session, get an inside look at how Salesforce builds on AWS to process exabytes of data, resolve known and anonymized IDs into highly accurate user profiles, and deliver audience segments across activation channels.

title: SACDE moderniza sus operaciones con apoyo de la nube de AWS
summary: SACDE es una empresa de construcción, actualmente con obras en las principales provincias argentinas. Su equipo de tecnología está centralizado en la capital federal, y en cada obra de cada provincia SACDE cuenta con un referente técnico. En su estrategia de cambio digital, SACDE trabaja con una implementación de SAP S/4 Hana y un programa de implementaciones con búsqueda en lo que es la automatización, digitalización, implementación de IoT y otras soluciones que buscan que el negocio pueda trabajar distinto en el día a día en cada obra y proyecto. Para esto, SACDE cuenta con instancias Amazon Elastic compute Cloud, Amazon Simple Storage Service, Amazon S3 Glacier y Amazon Route 53 para la resolución de DNS. En esta transición a la nube, la compañía trabaja con el apoyo del socio de negocios APN Escala 24/7.

title: Ryanair Saves 65% on Their Backup Costs With AWS Storage Gateway
summary: Ryanair switched tape backups to the cloud using AWS Storage Gateway's Tape Gateway and stored them in Amazon S3 Glacier and Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive for long-term storage, saving 65% in costs.

title: Flo Case Study
summary: Flo Health is the number one women’s health app in both the Android and Apple app stores with 120 million installs and 31 million monthly active users. Using AWS, Flo releases four times more updates than with its previous infrastructure and maintains a lean engineering team while growing app functionality and performance.

title: Royal FrieslandCampina Builds Global Data Platform on AWS
summary: Royal FrieslandCampina uses Amazon Redshift to support data-driven decision making across the enterprise as well as AWS Lambda for processing tasks, including big data analysis.

title: RIO Builds On AWS to Bring Digital Innovation to the Transportation and Logistics Sector
summary: Part of the TRATON Group (previously Volkswagen Truck & Bus), RIO develops digital products that connect logistics and telematics data to offer shippers and carriers real-time visibility on their shipments. RIO collaborates with Volkswagen Group Logistics, which operates 18,000 truckloads across Europe daily. The company started in the cloud and is now embracing an Amazon Web Services (AWS)–first mentality, favoring solutions built on AWS over self-hosted ones.

title: Ringier Axel Springer Goes All-in on AWS
summary: Mark Dekan, CEO of Ringier Axel Springer, a leading digital publisher in Central and Eastern Europe, discusses how technology impacts media, why the company went all-in on AWS, and the benefits of using AWS as a platform.

title: RepricerExpress Moves to AWS from Azure for Lower Costs, Higher Performance
summary: RepricerExpress reduced costs by $60,000 a year and obtained larger, higher-performing compute resources by migrating a Windows Server and SQL Server environment to AWS from Microsoft Azure.

title: Redcat Picks AWS over Azure for Strong Scalability and Simple Integration
summary: By migrating its Windows and Linux workloads to AWS, Redcat can handle millions of login requests an hour and say "yes" to even the largest loyalty-campaign requests from its customers.

title: RCN Televisión realiza transformación digital completa basada en AWS
summary: RCN Televisión es una empresa de medios de comunicación de las más grandes de Colombia. Uno de los retos del equipo de tecnología de la compañía era soportar todo el tráfico que tienen en todos los portales. Para garantizar el éxito en ese desafío, RCN TV promovió una transformación digital de sus actividades al migrar toda su infraestructura de servidores físicos a la nube AWS.

title: Restaurant Brands International Innovates While Staying Lean on AWS
summary: The parent company of Burger King, Popeyes, and Tim Hortons, Restaurant Brands International (RBI) prides itself on its lean organization, but its IT team struggled to keep pace with ever-growing data demands. To meet the demands of its business while maintaining a lean IT team, RBI migrated from its traditional data centers to the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

title: How Ralali.Com Scales and Grows Exponentially With AWS
summary: Since using AWS, Ralali.com has been able to grow its BIG Agent business from 400 agents to over 100 thousand agents in a year, with only a small fraction of infrastructure cost, innovate and start new projects less than 3 days, scale quickly to provide highly available services for their end users.

title: Caso de Éxito AWS: Rackspace
summary: Rackspace es una de las empresas de servicios tecnológicos más grandes del mundo. Con presencia en más de 21 países y más de 6.500 empleados, Rackspace toma las mejores tecnologías que existen en el mercado y las convierte en servicios para los clientes. Hace unos años, la compañía entendió que era más eficiente asociarse con AWS que invertir en su propia nube para llevar servicios al mercado. En este video, Dafne Fernandez de Castro, Directora de Alianzas de Rackspace en Latinoamérica, explica como la experiencia de AWS se sumó al expertise de administración de esta infraestructura que tiene Rackspace. A partir de la alianza, la empresa ha crecido su base de clientes más del 250% año al año, creció en diferentes industrias y diferentes tamaños de mercado.

title: Com suporte da AWS, Quero Educação conecta estudantes a mais de 6 mil instituições de ensino
summary: Com o sucesso do programa Quero Bolsa, a instituição decidiu utilizar diretamente a infraestrutura da AWS para outros serviços, garantindo a flexibilidade, a segurança e a escalabilidade necessárias ao negócio.

title: Quantic Dream Case Study
summary: Game development, publishing, and motion capture studio Quantic Dream takes control of remote working using AWS.

title: QT Medical Aims to Combat Heart Disease Globally Using SAP Business One on AWS
summary: QT Medical uses AWS to drive growth worldwide while saving 15 percent on the cost of running SAP to maintain operational efficiency.

title: How Qlue Drives Smart City Solutions with AWS
summary: Since using AWS, Qlue has been able to reduce time to market by 50% with streamlined deployment process, with the ability to scale seamlessly while processing large volumes of real time data.

title: Qiscus Empowers Websites with Chat SDK Built on AWS
summary: By building its chat SDK on AWS, Qiscus has maintained a consistent end-to-end latency of 100 milliseconds or less and an SLA of 99.9 percent.

title: Q2 Solutions Migrates to AWS to Enhance Capabilities
summary: Q2 Solutions, a leading global clinical laboratory services organization that helps customers achieve better clinical trial outcomes, migrated to the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud to keep pace with new advances in the clinical trials space. According to Steven Lucovsky, corporate lead for cloud operations at Q2 Solutions, “The new advances in sequencing required ten times more compute and ten times more storage, and it just wasn’t going to work in an on-premises environment.” Considering the costs of owning and maintaining equipment, Lucovsky proposed instead moving to the cloud.

title: Cambio a la nube AWS hace Provident más ágil y competitiva
summary: Provident es la empresa líder de préstamos personales en México. Desde el año 2003, la compañía lleva servicios financieros oportunos, responsables y transparentes, principalmente a la población aún no bancarizada, contribuyendo a la inclusión financiera en el país. Con el reto de impulsar el crecimiento y llevar mejores servicios a los clientes, en 2017 la empresa implementó la estrategia para trasladar sus aplicaciones a la nube.

title: Propeller Health Leverages AWS to Help Patients Manage Respiratory Disease
summary: Propeller Health is a leading digital health company dedicated to the management of chronic respiratory disease. Propeller Health develops a digital health platform, Propeller, that improves outcomes for people with asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and allows providers to monitor their patients remotely, stratify patients based on risk, and make data-driven decisions on treatment.

title: Preply Becomes a Global Provider of Online Courses with AWS
summary: Preply grows from a startup servicing eastern European countries to a global online business with AWS. The company helps students find online tutors in multiple subjects and 50 languages. Preply uses a wide range of AWS services including Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service to automate development pipelines and Amazon ElastiCache to improve website speed.

title: Plume Meets Demands of Explosive Growth with Migration to Amazon DocumentDB
summary: Smart home services leader Plume increased scalability and improved security while saving the equivalent of three to five approximately $150,000 Silicon Valley salaries by migrating from MongoDB to Amazon DocumentDB.

title: Plaza Premium Digitalizes the Travel Journey on AWS
summary: By migrating its data centers to the AWS Cloud, Plaza Premium Group deploys resources 20 times faster and standardizes compliance as it expands internationally. Plaza Premium Group operates airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, and airport hospitality services in more than 180 locations. The group uses AWS CloudTrail for log retention, Amazon CloudFront for low-latency content delivery, and Amazon API Gateway to build its software-as-a-service solution.

title: Pif Paf Alimentos migra 100% de sua infraestrutura de TI para nuvem AWS
summary: Diante da necessidade de atualizar seu parque de hardware, a Pif Paf avaliou alternativas o optou por migrar toda a sua infraestrutura para a nuvem da AWS, incluindo seu sistema SAP.

title: Online Supermarket Picnic Leverages AWS to Meet Growing Demand
summary: Dimitar Nedev, lead infrastructure engineer at Picnic, explains how the company leverages AWS services, including machine learning, to optimize processes to meet growing demand and deliver the best customer experience possible.

title: Phorest Case Study
summary: Phorest uses AWS Lambda to offer fast and reliable services to salons despite heavy, infrequent traffic spikes. High customer satisfaction has allowed it to expand into new geographic regions.

title: How Philips Turns the AWS Cloud into a Telehealth Business
summary: Philips built HealthSuite Digital Platform—a healthcare cloud infrastructure providing data privacy, compliance, and open, highly secure, platform-as-a-service capabilities—using many AWS services.

Desde hace años, la empresa viene evolucionando su cultura y prácticas de desarrollo, inteligencia artificial y operaciones. As that record volume increased over time, Nasdaq opted to migrate to a data lake solution in order to scale the ingest process and query data in a more parallel manner. Nasdaq moved its entire ingest process to Amazon Web Services (AWS), writing the data to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).
