summary: With AWS, AbiBird delivers a global solution that will help elderly people live independently at home. AbiBird provides a service that uses smart sensors that monitor lifestyle routines of elderly people at home without intruding on their personal privacy. The backend for the service uses AWS Lambda and AWS IoT Core to ingest, process, and distribute data from the sensors.

title: AWS re:Invent 2019 – Christopher Cerruto of Avis Budget Group Talks About Cloud Transformation
summary: Avis Budget leverages the AWS Connected Vehicle Solution for its Global Telematics Hub, which collects vehicle data from across the company's fleet into a single environment.

title: Avio Aero Accelerates Business Growth with HPC Solution on AWS
summary: Avio Aero overcame limited on-premises HPC resources for computational fluid dynamics simulations by building a solution on AWS that uses Amazon EC2 C5 instances when on-premises capacity is exceeded.

title: Athabasca University Case Study
summary: Athabasca University considers a more skilled citizenry and new opportunities for startups among the top benefits of moving to the AWS Cloud. The institution is Canada's only 100 percent open and online digital university, and 70 percent of its students are the first in their families to achieve a university degree.

title: Astera Labs Uses AWS to Accelerate Chip Development
summary: Astera Labs uses AWS to run hundreds of simulations in parallel, completing chip design in months instead of years and avoiding millions of dollars in additional investment. Based in northern California, the growing semiconductor manufacturer runs its HPC environment on AWS, using Amazon EC2 R5, C5, and z1d instances to support chip design and verification simulations.

title: Asianet News Cuts Operating Costs by 50% Using AWS Serverless Architecture
summary: Asianet News built a serverless infrastructure with AWS to minimize workload and support 70 percent growth. Asianet News is one of India's largest media groups.

title: Aramisauto : vers un traitement des données en temps réel
summary: Aramisauto utilise les déclencheurs DynamoDB pour la réconciliation des données de navigation post-sauvegarde, c’est-à-dire pour regrouper les navigations qui concernent la même personne, par exemple quelqu’un qui navigue sur un ordinateur puis sur son mobile, ce qui permet à Aramisauto de mieux la cibler et connaître son parcours.

title: Apixio Provides Clinically Useful Patient Insights Using Machine Learning on AWS
summary: Apixio uses machine learning to analyze structured and unstructured health data sets to model the quality of patient care. Apixio is a data science company for healthcare that extracts and analyzes data from health records to generate longitudinal insights into patient health.

title: Apervita’s Application Platform Simplifies Development, Sharing of Healthcare Apps Using AWS
summary: Using AWS, Apervita built an application development platform specifically for the healthcare industry, to make it easier to build apps that exchange clinical, operational, and financial data and perform analytics. Apervita's platform as a service (PaaS) allows users to easily build and share applications across networks of providers, payers, and healthcare enterprises.

title: Annalect Uses Containers and Amazon Redshift Spectrum to Cost-Effectively Process Trillions of Events
summary: Annalect, a subsidiary of Omnicom Media Group, unifies and integrates data into Omnicom’s people-based marketing platform, Omni. The company analyzes consumer attributes and event-level data including demographic data, purchase data, television viewership, location data, clickstream web events, and CRM data to form a 360-degree view of customer behavior. In this re:Invent 2019 session, Eric Whitney, global CTO at Annalect, dives into how the company cost-effectively processes more than 3 trillion events and analyzes petabytes of data using containers, Amazon Athena, and Amazon Redshift Spectrum.

title: Amazon GameOn Case Study
summary: Amazon GameOn used off-the-shelf AWS tools and technologies to build a microservices architecture that scales effortlessly and delivers P90 response times of about 47 milliseconds. Amazon GameOn enables external game developers to offer leaderboards, multiplayer play, and tournaments with real-world prizes, fulfilled by Amazon.

title: Amazon Fulfillment Technologies Aurora Case Study
summary: Amazon migrated its Inventory Management Services from Oracle Database to Amazon Aurora to improve availability and scalability and reduce its operational burden. Amazon is the world's leading online retailer and provides a wide range of cloud services through its Amazon Web Services (AWS) division.

title: Amazing Fables Case Study
summary: Using Amazon Polly, Amazing Fables has added a new dimension to storytelling by integrating text-to-speech for video books in 10 languages. Amazing Fables is a Malaysian startup offering personalized children's books to customers across the globe.

title: AiSIN AW case study
summary: AiSIN AW is working on the development of advanced technologies for the next generation of automotive manufacturing, including those for electric vehicles and automatic driving assistance. The company looked into building a status-monitoring platform to utilize the enormous amount of data output from its production equipment. About two weeks after going live with the status-monitoring system built with AWS and Brains Technology, the company was able to avoid costs associated with extended downtime when the system detected abnormal conditions.

title: Airbnb Uses Amazon EFS to Scale CI/CD Pipeline for Expanding Online Marketplace
summary: Airbnb uses Amazon EFS for Linux-based workloads for use with AWS Cloud services and on-premises resources. Online travel marketplace Airbnb supports hundreds of critical services on its platform, making it essential to maintain a reliable source control infrastructure. The company uses GitHub Enterprise for both source control and management of its continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes.

title: Airbnb Case Study
summary: A year after Airbnb launched, the company decided to migrate nearly all of its cloud computing functions to AWS because of service administration challenges experienced with its original provider. Founded in 2008, San Francisco-based Airbnb is a community marketplace with over 7 million accommodations and more than 40,000 unique experiences for customers to book on the company's website or through its iOS and Android applications.

title: Aidoc Brings Lifesaving AI Advancements to Medical Imaging on AWS
summary: Aidoc offers clinically proven, AI-based technology that analyzes medical imaging. It uses Amazon EC2 P3 instances to train ML models and execute inference processes, releasing new algorithms quarterly

title: adidas Chooses AWS to Drive Mobile Innovation
summary: adidas is Europe’s largest sportswear company and one of the most recognizable brands on the planet. In 2019, it sold 1.1 billion items worldwide.With consumers having more choice and more ways to shop than ever before, adidas wanted to drive real-time engagement with its customers through mobile apps. This required the company to change the way it built and deployed applications.In this video, Markus Rautert, vice president of platform engineering and architecture at adidas Global IT, explains how AWS helps the company connect with customers. adidas uses data streaming, machine learning, and artificial intelligence services to recognize trends and predict future product offerings.adidas can now deploy applications 40-times faster. It has also improved page-load times by 50 percent and was able to scale easily when a popular sneaker generated 1 million sales in just 2 days.

title: Etude de cas AWS : 3DVIA
summary: 3DVIA propose des solutions intelligentes d'aménagement d'espace 3D pour les professionnels et les particuliers, en leur offrant un nouveau moyen d'interagir, d'aborder leur projet et de faire le meilleur choix.

title: ZOTT
summary: Using AWS, ZOTT creates a safe space for patients and families, enabling a "walled-garden experience." Inside this safe environment, ZOTT offers opportunities for entertainment, play, learning, and socializing, fostering a sense of community and togetherness through meaningful interactions.

title: Zocdoc Builds Patient Confidence Using TensorFlow on AWS
summary: Zocdoc uses TensorFlow to create machine learning algorithms that match patients to doctors, reducing the wait time for appointments.

title: Zendesk Case Study
summary: Zendesk develops and trains deep-learning applications on AWS to deliver new capabilities to customer-service organizations and scale to support for current and future application demand. The company provides an online customer support platform used by more than 114,000 companies across the globe.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Youse
summary: A Youse tem como áreas de atuação seguros automotivos, residenciais e de vida. A empresa utiliza as soluções AWS em busca de flexibilidade e agilidade, além da possibilidade de crescimento sem a necessidade de se preocupar com infraestrutura.

title: Yieldmo Case Study
summary: Using Amazon Kinesis, Yieldmo analyzes online ad-interaction data in milliseconds, gains real-time insights, and optimizes ad placements to deliver more efficient ad campaigns for mobile advertisers. Yieldmo provides advertising technologies that help publishers monetize digital content.

title: Caso práctico de Xcaret
summary: AWS permitió a Xcaret pasar de un sistema analógico de venta de fotos a otro digital en tres meses. Apenas puesto en marcha el sistema digital, los clientes descargaron 22 TB de fotos ofrecidas en 4 diferentes tamaños y formatos para múltiples aplicaciones y dispositivos.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Wappa
summary: A Wappa nasceu há 15 anos com a proposta de revolucionar o mercado de gestão de despesas corporativas com transporte. Desde que migrou seu do banco de dados para Amazon Aurora seu processo de validação de usuários ficou 60% mais rápido, o tempo de report caiu 75% e o processo de pagamento está 70% mais ágil.

title: Volkswagen Builds Digital Ecosystem Using AWS
summary: Volkswagen Group is setting up a cloud platform as a landing zone in AWS, using services such as AWS Direct Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon RDS, and Amazon Route 53 for migrating and replatforming its existing on-premises backend, in-sourcing development, empowering internal teams, and transforming internal processes.

title: ViewFin Metaverse Case Study
summary: With AWS, ViewFin Metaverse is able to build a secure, stable, and dependable blockchain-as-a-service (BaaS) platform to provide blockchain-based digital solutions to customers from a wide range of sectors including finance, business, art, and medical. ViewFin Metaverse is a fintech company focusing on blockchain technologies; its main offerings include Metaverse and Metaverse BaaS.

title: ViaSat Case Study
summary: Viasat built a business-critical data-ingestion platform using AWS, adopting Amazon EBS st1 volumes for optimal I/O performance and simplified storage management. Viasat is a satellite-communications provider that connects residential customers, flight passengers and crews, and military operations across the globe to the internet through trusted communications ground services, infrastructure, and personnel.

title: Caso de Éxito: UVM
customer: UVM - Universidad del Valle de Mexico
summary: La Universidad del Valle de México (UVM) es la institución universitaria de carácter privado más grande de la República. Con la nueva plataforma en la nube, la operatividad del portal de UVM alcanzó navegabilidad óptima las 24 horas al día y en épocas de alta concurrencia.

title: University of Oklahoma Case Study
summary: The University of Oklahoma IT department aims to affect the student experience on campus in more ways than just delivering technology. Technology innovation, like Amazon Alexa, will play a major role in that mission.

title: University of Arizona Case Study
summary: The University of Arizona (UA) addressed the challenge of creating a more efficient and agile IT operation by migrating to the cloud. After initial success in migrating its Research Administration system, UA became the first major university to migrate its PeopleSoft application environments—Learning (EL), Human Resources (HR), and Student (SA)—to AWS.

title: Union Medical Healthcare (UMH) Case Study
summary: Union Medical Healthcare (UMH) can produce key financial reports 50 percent faster while giving executives real-time insight into the company's business performance with SAP S/4HANA Finance running on AWS. UMH provides medical and healthcare services in the Greater China Region.

title: Caso de Éxito de Ualá
summary: Ualá es la aplicación móvil de finanzas personales número 1 de Argentina. Con AWS, Uala pudo agregar 170,000 usuarios al servicio, sin preocuparse por la infraestructura.

title: TerrAvion Case Study
summary: TerrAvion uses AWS to store and process aerial imagery, deliver images to agricultural customers overnight, and help farmers improve crop yields. The company is one of the largest providers of high-resolution aerial images by volume for farmers across the US and Brazil.

title: Caso de Éxito: Televisa News
summary: Televisa News es la plataforma multimedia de Noticieros Televisa. Con AWS Elemental Televisa News alcanzó la cifra de 8 millones de nuevos visitantes partiendo de una base que oscilaba entre 1,6 y 2 millones.

title: TechSoup Case Study
summary: Using AWS, TechSoup quickly and securely provides technology to nonprofits around the world. TechSoup offers a range of technology implementation and management services to nonprofits with diverse missions including promoting health and welfare, achieving medical breakthroughs, protecting wildlife, and many other causes.

title: T-Mobile Case Study
summary: T-Mobile accelerated build and deploy steps on AWS by 90 percent with an internally created serverless development platform called Jazz. T-Mobile is a technology company that offers wireless services over a nationwide 4G LTE network to more than 70 million customers.

title: How Supercell Runs Giant Games with Tiny Teams on AWS
summary: Supercell is a mobile games company founded in 2010 in Helsinki, Finland. It has offices in the United States, China, Japan, Korea, and Denmark. Supercell has 100 million daily active users with 4 million concurrent players at peak times, producing 500 TB of data a day.In this video, Heikki Verta, head of engineering at Supercell, explains how its 20-person game teams run some of the world’s most popular titles, including Clash of Clans and Boom Beach. The teams have a high degree of autonomy over the games they build and maintain. On the Clash of Clans team, 3 server developers maintain more than 2,000 Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances and 300 MySQL databases, as well as developing the game. They achieve this with loosely coupled, well-architected microservices, using infrastructure as code to automate scaling and recovery. The company also makes use of managed services like Amazon DynamoDB where possible, so teams spend less time on infrastructure administration.

title: Sunday Insurance Case Study
summary: Sunday brings InsurTech to Thailand with the support of AWS and giving customers lower-cost premiums for a wide range of insurance policies. Sunday applies machine learning to determine risks and delivers highly customized insurance policies.

title: Estudo de Caso AWS: Sua Música
summary: Sua Música, umas das maiores plataformas de entretenimento focada em música regional do Brasil, migra para a nuvem e utiliza as soluções AWS para atingir milhões de fãs. O Sua Música gerencia conteúdo de 12 mil artistas e suporta mais de 50 milhões de visitas por mês.

title: State of Minnesota
summary: Using the cloud, Minnesota IT Services (MNIT) gained the agility and automation it needs to quickly and efficiently deliver innovative services to the state's citizens. MNIT is the information-technology agency for the State of Minnesota's executive branch, serving 70 agencies, boards, and commissions within the state.

title: SoundExchange Case Study
summary: Using AWS, SoundExchange was able to transform its technology to be efficient, reliable, flexible, and fast. SoundExchange develops business solutions to benefit the entire music industry, and collects and distributes digital performance royalties on behalf of more than 155,000 recording artists and master rights owners.

title: Soundbus Case Study
summary: SoundBus Technologies Co., Ltd. uses AWS to maintain stable operations around the clock and faster service time, greatly improving the user experience while reducing the operation and maintenance workload and labor costs. SoundBus is a new-media technology company that enables users to interact with each other through an innovative "sound code" technology similar to QR code.

title: Skyscanner support case study
summary: Skyscanner uses AWS to completely operate its IT infrastructure in the cloud. AWS Support helps Skyscanner to ensure it has the right balance for its large volume of Amazon Enterprise Compute Cloud (EC2) instances to make sure its business is optimized for both performance and cost.

title: SKF Case Study
summary: Using AWS, SKF is optimizing its production processes, reducing costs, and providing a better experience to its customers. SKF is a bearing manufacturer founded in Sweden in 1907.

title: Siemens Uses Matillion ETL for Amazon Redshift to Build Out Its Software Quickly
summary: Siemens Power and Gas division was looking for ways to accelerate its data-analytics and customer-digitalization projects. After choosing Amazon Redshift, it wanted to build out the solution with best-in-class software. A search through AWS Marketplace led Siemens to run a free trial of Matillion ETL for Amazon Redshift, which took less than one hour to try, buy and implement within their existing AWS environments.

title: Siemens Mindsphere Case Study
summary: Siemens has deployed an IoT environment at a plant in Mexico in less than eight weeks, which will help it double efficiency. The company is Europe's largest industrial manufacturer with a global workforce of more than 377,000 and annual revenue exceeding €80 billion.

title: Scripps Case Study
summary: Scripps Networks Interactive reduced its CGI render time by 95 percent using a solution based on AWS Thinkbox Deadline. Scripps Networks Interactive is a mass-media company specializing in factual and lifestyle television brands such as HGTV, DIY Network, and Food Network.

title: Scout24 Case Study
summary: Founded in 1998, Scout24 is a leading operator of digital marketplaces for cars and real estate in Germany and other European countries. By running a data lake on AWS, Scout24 helps its teams stay agile, identify new use cases to enable its customers to make smart buying decisions, focus on their core business, and scale solutions cost-efficiently.

title: Santa Monica College Case Study
summary: The California Cloud Workforce Project, a consortium of 19 LA County community colleges and their sister high schools, offers a Cloud Computing Certificate. The CA Cloud curriculum was designed collaboratively by faculty at Santa Monica College and AWS Educate, with the support of subject matter experts from AWS and other LA-based tech companies to equip students with cloud skills needed for careers in the tech industry.

title: Saint Louis University Case Study
summary: Saint Louis University (SLU) is the first university to bring virtual personal assistants into every student residence on its campus and to equip them with a private, SLU-specific skill using Alexa for Business. SLU placed more than 2,300 Amazon Echo Dots in residence hall rooms and student apartments in the fall of 2018.

title: Royal Dutch Shell Case Study
summary: Relying on AWS as its infrastructure provider of choice for its Splunk Enterprise cybersecurity solution, Royal Dutch Shell matured a large data lake for historical analysis. Headquartered in the Netherlands, Royal Dutch Shell is a British-Dutch multinational oil and gas company with operations in more than 70 countries and an interest in 22 refineries around the globe.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Rocketmat
summary: A Rocketmat criou uma solução de machine learning voltada para a área de Recursos Humanos, e descobriu como utilizar o potencial da computação em nuvem AWS para processar informações sobre comportamentos humanos e propor decisões assertivas para a aquisição de novos talentos.

title: Renault Transforms IT for a New Automotive Sector
summary: Founded in 1899, Groupe Renault manufactures and sells 3.75 million cars and light commercial vehicles each year under five main brands.The automotive industry is changing. People are using more mobility services like ride-sharing apps, and those that own cars are buying more used vehicles. This represents a challenge to the business models of long-established automakers like Renault.The group has responded with a wide-ranging digital transformation, focusing more on services. Central to this transformation has been the use of Amazon Web Services, specifically Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), AWS Lambda, and Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS).In this video, Pierre Houlès, chief information officer for sales and marketing at Renault, explains how the group handled the challenge of decades of legacy technology and how a shift to DevOps changed the way the business operates. Plus, see how the success of Renault’s first project on the new platform increased sales conversion rates by 15X and customer contacts by 25X, giving the business the confidence to continue its cloud journey.

title: RedAwning case study
summary: RedAwning simplifies vacation rentals for guests and property managers alike and offers more than 140,000 properties in over 10,000 destinations. Using Amazon Connect, RedAwning easily built an intelligent virtual agent to answer calls, match guests with their reservations, and engage naturally with users.

title: red violet Case Study
summary: Software and services company red violet significantly reduces compute costs for large parallel-processing clusters using Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. The company uses cloud computing, proprietary algorithms, and big data to resolve complex data problems.

title: Caso práctico de Rappi
summary: Descubra cómo las tecnologías de AWS apoyan a Rappi en todas sus iniciativas y permiten el crecimiento, la creación de nuevas operaciones, la implementación de nuevos servicios y respaldan el éxito de Rappi en América Latina.

title: Rackspace Case Study
summary: Rackspace modernized its contact center using Amazon Connect, enabling it to easily optimize call flows without specialized engineering skills. Rackspace is one of the world's largest IT managed-services providers.

title: QTAC Case Study
summary: Queensland Tertiary Admissions Centre (QTAC) operates a centralized application service for Queensland, Australia. QTAC uses AWS to offer more reliable services with nearly 100 percent uptime, even with traffic spiking to 80,000 hits per minute.

title: Prime Video - Boosts Scale and Resilience
summary: Amazon.com migrated a service that supports Prime Video from Oracle to Amazon Web Services to increase elasticity and reliability while reducing cost. Prime Video is the video-streaming service from Amazon, the world's leading online retailer.

title: Caso di studio: Pixartprinting
summary: Fondata nel 1994, Pixartprinting offre una gamma di servizi di stampa online: dai piccoli formati come riviste, cataloghi, etichette e volantini, ai grandi formati quali stampe ad alta risoluzione, poster per interni ed esterni e striscioni.

title: Pixartprinting Case Study
summary: By using AWS, Pixartprinting has built a scalable, agile infrastructure that allows the firm to gross more than €1 million ($1.2 million) a day in sales. The Italy-based company, part of Cimpress, offers custom printed materials to 600,000 clients across Europe.

title: Pirelli Brings Cloud Intelligence to Its Tires with AWS
summary: Founded in Milan, Italy, in 1872, Pirelli makes more than 75 million high-performance tires a year for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. The organization employs more than 30,000 people in 13 countries.Pirelli has a history of manufacturing innovation and has recently set up Pirelli Digital, which is dedicated to developing smart products such as Pirelli Connesso. Connesso combines in-tire sensors with a mobile app to inform drivers about tire pressure, temperature, wear, and more in real time.The backend for Connesso—and several other digital services at Pirelli—is built on Amazon Web Services (AWS), with Amazon Aurora powering its database. Pirelli chose AWS to give its digital teams the ability to quickly develop and test products and build a highly secure environment for sensitive data.In this video, Daniel Benedict, head of ICT innovation architecture at Pirelli, explains how the company uses AWS to develop new products.

title: Pinterest on AWS
summary: Hosting billions of images for over 450 million monthly users to discover.

title: Pinsight Case Study
summary: Pinsight Media analyzed six months of mobile-carrier signal data—a process requiring 100,000 compute hours—in just eight days using AWS. Pinsight is a leading mobile data and insights company that offers customer modeling, analysis of brand affinity, competitive benchmarking, and market analysis.

title: Pick n Pay Embraces Fresh Thinking on AWS
summary: Pick n Pay was founded in South Africa in 1967. Today, it has more than 1,600 stores across southern Africa and employs 40,000 people.In this video, Andrew Mayes, business intelligence specialist at Pick n Pay, explains how rehosting the company’s SAP-based business intelligence platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS) helps it stay relevant and accessible in the digital marketplace.The firm moved from an on-premises infrastructure to one based on Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances. Pick n Pay chose X1 instances, which are designed for running large-scale and in-memory applications like SAP BW/4HANA.Using AWS, Pick n Pay has boosted its agility. It can now replicate its production environment in 2 hours for testing and quickly increase the capacity or performance of instances as needed. Costs have dropped, too, largely because Pick n Pay no longer needs to run a second physical environment for disaster recovery.

title: Photobox Case Study
summary: By migrating from its EMC Isilon and IBM Cleversafe on-premises storage arrays to Amazon S3 using AWS Snowball Edge, Photobox saved a significant amount on costs on storage for its 10 PB of photo storage. Photobox is an online, personalized photo-products company that serves millions of customers each year in over ten markets.

title: Peloton Case Study
summary: In-home fitness company Peloton relies on AWS to power its on-demand, live leaderboard. Peloton's leaderboard requires high elasticity, low latency, and real-time processing to deliver customizable rider data for the community of users riding together virtually from the comfort of their homes.

title: PDEvidence
summary: PDEvidence uses AWS to create a Laboratory Information Systems solution that securely automates crime lab data management, helping the Pennsylvania State Police Computer Crime Unit get criminals off the street faster and save money for taxpayers. PDEvidence is an AWS Technology partner that offers digital laboratory management solutions for law enforcement.

title: Caso de Éxito: Pampa Energía
summary: Pampa Energía es uno de los grupos económicos más grandes de Argentina con foco en energía. Pampa actualizó su SAP Hana y decidió hacerlo sobre la nube de AWS, para una mayor rentabilidad y agilidad.

title: Pakwheels Case Study
summary: Since migrating to AWS, Pakwheels has been able to reduce its image processing time from 15 mins to 60 seconds, and also enjoys a 99.9 percent uptime. Pakwheels is the largest online marketplace for car shoppers and sellers in Pakistan, providing users with automotive reviews, shopping advice, and comparison tools for car financing and insurance information.

title: Otto Opens Doors to Further Growth in the Cloud
summary: Otto Group is one of the world’s largest online retailers. It operates 30 major companies across the globe, employing 52,000 people and generating €14.3 billion in revenue in 2019/20.One of its brands—Otto—is a 60-year-old mail order business that now takes 90 percent of its orders online, totaling €5.3 billion a year from half a billion visits.Managing an ecommerce company of this size is only possible because of Otto’s scalable architecture, which it migrated to Amazon Web Services (AWS) in 2017. The architecture comprises around 160 microservices running in 3,000 containers and is maintained by 25 autonomous development teams.In this video, Daniel Barthelmes, head of platform operations at otto.de talks about his teams’ journey to AWS. He also shares tips for a successful migration, covering everything from analysis and preparation to team autonomy.

title: Ottawa Hospital Research Institute Case Study
summary: The Ottawa Hospital Research Institute uses AWS to enable Canadian citizens to manage immunization records on mobile devices. The application uses Amazon EC2, Amazon Cognito, and Amazon RDS.

title: Openeye Scientific Case Study
summary: OpenEye Scientific Software uses AWS to save $800,000 yearly, help pharmaceutical companies deploy tens of thousands of processing cores in weeks instead of months, and improve the sharing of drug data. The company, based in Santa Fe, New Mexico, develops drug discovery software for large pharmaceutical companies and other life sciences organizations.

title: Estudo de Caso OLX
summary: O AWS Enterprise Support é o principal apoio da OLX para otimizar a utilização dos serviços que suportam a infraestrutura de uma das maiores plataformas de compra e venda online do Brasil. O aplicativo da OLX conta com o suporte da AWS para estar sempre inovando.

title: NWEA Case Study
summary: Using AWS, the Northwest Evaluation Association (NWEA) delivers adaptive, personalized tests to improve the learning experience for the student. NWEA provides the insights that help students learn, teachers teach, and leaders lead.

title: Estudo de Caso AWS: Nubank
summary: Saiba mais sobre como o AWS Enterprise Support apoia o Nubank em seu processo de crescimento e inovação.

title: Northern Virginia Community College Case Study
summary: Northern Virginia Community College (NOVA), in collaboration with the AWS Educate program, rolled out a Cloud Computing specialization as part of its Information Systems Technology (IST) Associate of Applied Science degree starting in Fall 2018. The program is one of the first cloud computing degrees in the nation offered by a community college.

title: NextGen Healthcare case study
summary: NextGen Healthcare went all in on AWS in 2018, moving its legacy Microsoft Windows and SQL Server platforms to the AWS Cloud while maintaining HIPAA compliance. By running its business-critical applications on AWS, NextGen Healthcare has improved performance and can focus on enhancing the patient care experience.

title: Another Day in the Life of a Cloud Network Engineer at Netflix
summary: In this AWS re:Invent session from 2018, learn how the cloud network engineering team at Netflix automates and manages an infrastructure that services over 125 million customers using Amazon Route 53 and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2).

title: Netafim Helps Farmers Grow More with Less
summary: Headquartered in Israel, Netafim is the world's largest irrigation company by market share, with more than $1 billion in sales and 5,000 employees. Its 17 plants manufacture precision drip irrigation equipment, which is sold in 110 countries. The firm's guiding principle is to help farmers grow more with less—a mantra that is becoming increasingly relevant as the global population increases and climate change makes water a scarce resource for billions of people. Netafim's NETBEAT—“the world's first irrigation system with a brain”—places sensors in fields to collect data about crops and sends the information to cloud-connected units that control fertilizer and watering systems. The units incorporate data from weather forecasts and Netafim's algorithms to aid plant growth. In this video, Izhar Gilad, vice president of product and business development for digital farming at Netafim, explains why the company uses AWS to deliver NETBEAT, and how AWS helped it transform from an industrial manufacturer to a firm focused on services and data.

title: National Australia Bank Case Study
summary: National Australia Bank (NAB), Australia's largest business bank, started to accelerate its cloud journey with AWS in 2017. For NAB's initial migration of 30 applications, AMS oversaw all infrastructure operations tasks needed to run AWS at scale, reducing the operational overhead and risk for NAB. This allowed the bank to direct its time and resources to up-leveling their staff and developing business strategy.

title: Monzo Case Study
summary: Monzo has grown from an idea to a fully regulated bank on the AWS Cloud. A bank that "lives on your smartphone," Monzo has already handled £1 billion worth of transactions for half a million customers in the United Kingdom.

title: Miovision trasforma i trasporti tramite AWS IoT e dispositivi intelligenti
summary: Attraverso sensori collegati e analisi intelligenti, Miovision consente a più di 17.000 comuni in 50 paesi di essere più intelligenti, migliorando la capacità di trasporto, la sicurezza, la convenienza e le prestazioni. Distribuite agli incroci e lungo le strade, le soluzioni Spectrum e Scout, l'hardware, l'analisi e i servizi dell'azienda trasformano l'infrastruttura fisica in asset di dati.

title: Miovision Case Study
summary: Miovision uses AWS to capture and analyze IoT data from thousands of connected devices at traffic intersections around the world. Through connected sensors and intelligent analytics, Miovision empowers more than 17,000 municipalities in 50 countries to be smarter, improving transportation capacity, safety, cost-effectiveness, and performance.

title: Microfun Case Study
summary: Microfun Inc., a company dedicated to developing high-quality casual mobile games, has greatly enhanced system stability and reduced O&M costs by using AWS, ensuring secure and reliable operation of its gaming business.

title: Caso práctico de Mercadoni
summary: Mercadoni es una startup de crecimiento exponencial con sede en Bogotá, Colombia, que ofrece un servicio sencillo, rápido y completo de entrega a domicilio de compras de supermercado. Con los servicios de AWS, Mercadoni aumentó de 2-3 veces por semana a más de 150 la cantidad en que envía su desarrollo a producción.

title: Mercado Libre Case Study
summary: Mercado Libre is an e-commerce retailer based in Latin America. The company uses several AWS products including Amazon S3, Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift for big data, and AWS Lambda, which, along with Amazon Kinesis, enables the development of real-time solutions quickly and easily.

title: Mawdoo3 Case Study
summary: Mawdoo3's artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives run on AWS, giving site visitors new ways of accessing information and a faster experience. Its online encyclopedia, launched in 2012, is the world's largest Arabic-language content platform.

title: MAPFRE Lowers Time to Market by 40% Using AWS
summary: Spain-based Insurance firm MAPFRE employs 36,000 people in 100 countries and serves 30 million customers worldwide. In this video, Mónica García Cristóbal, digital IT director at MAPFRE, explains how the company developed its framework for building mobile apps on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with services such as AWS Lambda. The framework relies on the principles of continuous deployment and infrastructure as code, so MAPFRE can quickly deliver scalable mobile applications to a global customer base.Using AWS, MAPFRE has lowered time to market by 40 percent because it can deploy on various device types with one source of code. The business has also reduced costs by 20 percent by paying for infrastructure only when it needs it, and scaling up and down quickly to match demand.

title: Caso práctico de AWS: la aplicación Mach, de Bci Chile
summary: Mach promueve un importante impacto social en Chile, con la creación de la primera aplicación de tarjeta prepago virtual de la banca, diseñada por Bci para todos los chilenos.

title: LoanLogics Case Study
summary: LoanLogics is able to scale to meet its storage demands in days instead of weeks using AWS Storage Gateway and Amazon EFS. LoanLogics is a software company that helps its customers validate compliance and manage risk during the manufacture and acquisition of loan assets.

title: Liulishuo Case Study
summary: Using AWS, Liulishuo has created a stable and reliable online learning platform, which provides tens of millions of users with personalized English language learning services. Liulishuo is a leading AI-driven education technology company dedicated to providing each and every user with personalized and adaptive online learning courses.

title: Larsen & Toubro Infotech (LTI) Case Study
summary: LTI is running SAP S/4HANA on the highly agile AWS Cloud, enabling the company to scale the environment in minutes when it used to take weeks to scale the company's former on-premises environments. LTI provides IT consulting and digital services to companies in 27 countries.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Lady Driver
summary: A Lady Driver é um aplicativo de transporte somente para mulheres, que conecta passageiras a motoristas, e já é o maior app de transporte feminino da América Latina. Com a AWS, a empresa encontrou novas soluções para seus desafios.

title: Caso práctico de Kueski
summary: Fintech Kueski gana terreno en el mercado mexicano con AWS, especialmente con Amazon Sagemaker para el análisis de perfiles y la reducción del fraude.

title: Caso práctico de Komatsu
summary: Descubra cómo Komatsu trabaja con máquinas virtuales, migra su plataforma SAP a la nube y planifica sus próximos pasos para utilizar las herramientas de Business Intelligence con AWS.

title: JUMO Case Study
summary: JUMO provides products and services for the 80 percent of the world's population that is excluded or underserved by traditional financial services. JUMO was born in the AWS Cloud and uses AWS to power mobile money for people and businesses in Africa.

title: Jaguar Land Rover Builds Experiences for Tomorrow’s Drivers Using AWS
summary: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) combines the heritage of two iconic British automotive brands while continuing to innovate in a rapidly changing industry. Customers expect more autonomous, connected, and electrified vehicles, so Jaguar Land Rover is using Amazon Web Services (AWS) to share its application programming interfaces (APIs) with trusted partners to innovate faster.In this video, Peter Virk, the company’s director of connected car and future technology, explains how the company is using AWS to integrate new, cloud-based technology into Jaguar Land Rover cars. For example, JLR has added Amazon Alexa features to vehicles, including the fully electric Jaguar I-PACE, so that customers can ask Alexa whether their car has enough range to complete their journey. Engineers are also using cloud-based analytics to improve battery performance, helping customers ensure batteries are fully charged for their journey.

title: Intuit on AWS
summary: Intuit is all-in on AWS and uses Amazon SageMaker to train its machine-learning models quickly and at scale, cutting the time needed to deploy the models by 90 percent.

title: Intercom Case Study
summary: Intercom designed, prototyped, tested, and deployed a stream-processing service in less than two weeks using an AWS serverless architecture. Intercom offers a suite of messaging-first products that integrate seamlessly with other companies' websites and mobile apps to help them acquire, engage with, and support their own customers.

title: Innovaccer Case Study
summary: Innovaccer built a scalable, zero-latency data platform using AWS that is 81 percent more cost-effective than an on-premises equivalent. Innovaccer is a leading healthcare data platform company, empowering healthcare organizations in the United States with data-driven insights for faster clinical decision making and efficient care processes.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: iFood
summary: O iFood, um dos marketplaces de maior destaque na América Latina atuando no segmento de entrega de alimentos, conta com a elasticidade dos serviços da AWS para o sucesso de suas operações

title: ICMEC Case Study
summary: By moving to the AWS Cloud, the International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC) reduced the costs of maintenance and pushed its IT teams to be more creative. ICMEC's mission is to eradicate child abduction, sexual abuse, and exploitation.

title: Here on AWS
summary: HERE uses the scalability, reliability, and global reach of the AWS platform to deliver its HD Live Maps and connected-car solutions to customers around the world.

title: HeartFlow Case Study
summary: HeartFlow is a medical technology company that is transforming how heart disease is diagnosed and treated. HeartFlow uses a SaaS model to receive computed tomography data, then applies deep learning to create a digital 3D model of the heart.

title: Hearst Data Analytics Case Study
summary: With its data analytics pipeline, the Hearst Corporation processes clickstream data from more than 300 websites and delivers it to website editors within minutes. Hearst is one of the largest diversified media and information organizations in the world, with more than 360 businesses.

title: graylink Case Study
summary: Traditionally a Microsoft customer, graylink chose the AWS Cloud ahead of Microsoft Azure when it decided to improve the flexibility and performance of its software-as-a-service (SaaS) recruitment solutions. graylink helps businesses from across Africa in sectors like retail, financial services, and mining automate and streamline their recruitment processes.

title: Globe Telecom Case Study
summary: By migrating the database for a key workload out of Oracle and onto the AWS Cloud, Globe Telecom has freed up 20 processors and 40 cores and will save $1 million in licensing fees. Globe Telecom is the leading provider of mobile and broadband services in the Philippines.

title: GetSmarter Uses Denodo Business Intelligence to Get Business Insights in Minutes Rather Than Weeks
summary: The GetSmarter data team provided business users with real-time self-service reporting capabilities and simplified data governance and security across more than 15 disparate data sources by using Denodo Platform in AWS Marketplace.

title: GE Power Case Study
summary: GE Power uses data analytics on AWS to help power plant customers save millions of dollars, stream 500,000 data records per second, and scale to support the ingestion of 20 billion sensor-data tags. The company provides utilities and power companies throughout the world with solutions for power generation.

title: GE Appliances Case Study
summary: In just two years, GE Appliances shifted to a DevOps approach, adopted a cloud-only policy, and achieved total visibility into its hybrid infrastructure by using AWS Management Tools and other AWS solutions. The company has been making appliances for more than 125 years.

title: FuseFX Case Study
summary: FuseFX achieves unlimited CGI render-farm scale by seamlessly adding cloud render nodes with AWS Thinkbox Deadline. FuseFX uses its proprietary content-creation pipeline to build visual effects for episodic television, feature films, commercials, and virtual-reality productions.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Fundação Roberto Marinho
summary: A Fundação Roberto Marinho está à frente de diversos projetos educacionais pioneiros no Brasil. Com a AWS, a Fundação atingiu a escalabilidade e estabilidade necessárias para disponibilizar seu conteúdo online de maneira mais ágil.

title: Flytrex Delivers Food Fast Using AWS
summary: Flytrex was founded in Israel in 2013 with the goal of building the world’s largest on-demand food delivery service using drones.The company is currently trialing its service in Reykjavik, Iceland, where it has replaced 25-minute car deliveries with 4-minute drone drops and reduced the cost of delivery by 60 percent.For this, Flytrex needs a highly available underlying system to pilot the vehicles while managing air traffic and complying with aviation regulations. Flytrex also provides APIs so restaurants can integrate its service into their own food ordering apps.In this video, Yariv Bash, cofounder and chief executive officer at Flytrex, explains why the company was built on Amazon Web Services (AWS) from day one.

title: Financial Engines Cuts Costs 90% Using AWS Lambda and Serverless Computing
summary: Financial Engines is using AWS to reduce infrastructure costs by more than 90 percent and gain immense scalability. The largest independent investment advisor in the United States, Financial Engines offers technology-enabled portfolio-management services, financial planning, and investment guidance to more than nine million people nationwide.

title: Fife Public Schools
summary: By using Amazon AppStream 2.0, Fife School District's students can now access applications from anywhere, anytime, on any device. Fife Public Schools in Washington aspires to be a top-tier learning organization in which all students are being prepared for college, career, and life.

title: Fender Case Study
summary: Fender went all in on AWS to better engage with customers and gain supply-chain efficiencies. Fender, made famous by the likes of Jimi Hendrix, is the world's largest maker of stringed instruments by revenue. Fender runs its Fender Play, Fender Tune, and Fender Tone apps on AWS, which help customers learn to play guitar, tune their instruments, and control digital amplifiers.

title: Caso di studio: Fatture in Cloud
summary: Fatture in Cloud fornisce fatturazione tramite software-as-a-service per lavoratori autonomi e piccole e medie imprese.

title: Fatture in Cloud Case Study
summary: Fatture in Cloud migrated from its existing cloud provider to AWS to improve performance by 100 percent, deliver a highly reliable service to customers, and reduce costs by 50 percent. Based in Italy, the company provides customers with invoicing and billing services 24/7 from any device—disrupting a largely traditional market by offering features such as real-time access to data.

title: Fanatics Gets Data Insights Faster and Saves Costs Using AWS Marketplace
summary: Using AWS and Attunity CloudBeam, Fanatics set up a new data lake in minutes and loaded data continuously, with zero system downtime.

title: Expedia Group Explores a New World of Data
summary: Expedia Group and its brands, including Hotels.com, let travelers plan and book travel services such as flights, package holidays, car rentals, event tickets, accommodation, and cruises. In 2018, its customers booked 352 million room nights via the group’s 200 global sites.In this video, Matthew Fryer, vice president and chief data science officer at Expedia Group and Hotels.com, explains the increasingly important role machine learning plays at the company. Operating at such a large scale, the most efficient way for Expedia Group to make decisions is through robust, automated analysis of its large datasets.The group uses technology from Amazon Web Services (AWS) including Amazon SageMaker and Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX). These help serve the most relevant photos and reviews for each customer at sub-millisecond latency and with more than 99 percent accuracy. Plus, the lower cost of delivery versus an on-premises deployment has allowed Expedia Group to experiment with emerging technology and find new use cases for it.

title: Euronext Gets More Agile with AWS
summary: Euronext operates stock exchanges in several major European capitals. It is home to more than 1,300 corporate stock issuers with a market capitalization of over €3.7 trillion, making it the largest exchange in continental Europe. The company handles millions of transactions a day comprising 1.5 billion digital messages.Euronext wanted to make better use of its data and start using artificial intelligence. But with data processing taking 6 hours after trading each day—12 hours on the busiest days—clients and business units struggled to analyze data in time for the next day’s trading.Using Amazon Web Services (AWS), analytics now happen in near real time, Euronext can scale up at short notice on high-volume days, and it can provide data scientists with analytics consoles in 1 day instead of 45 days.In this video, Nicolas Rivard, chief innovation officer at Euronext, outlines the decision-making process behind the organization’s move to AWS in 2017.

title: AWS re:Invent 2018: Epic Games nutzt AWS, um Fortnite für 200 Millionen Spieler bereitzustellen
summary: Epic Games nutzt AWS, um Fortnite mehr als 200 Millionen Spielern weltweit bereitzustellen, ein Wachstum um das 100-fache in nur zwölf Monaten zu fördern und mit Analysen eine Verbesserung des Spiels zu erreichen. Fortnite, eines der weltweit beliebtesten Videospiele, wird nahezu vollständig auf AWS ausgeführt: seine weltweite Gameserver-Flotte, Backend-Services, Datenbanken, Websites, Analyse-Pipeline- und Verarbeitungssysteme und mehr. Mit Hilfe diverser AWS-Services kann Epic Games die erforderliche Verfügbarkeit bereitstellen, um Nutzungsspitzen, die bis zu 10-mal höher als Nebenzeiten sind, zu unterstützen. Auch die nötige Skalierbarkeit, um Spieleereignisse mit allen 200 Millionen Nutzern zu hosten, kann Epic Games so gewährleisten. Chris Dyl, Director of Platform bei Epic Games, im Rahmen eines Vortrags auf der re:Invent 2018.

title: Epic Games Case Study
summary: Epic Games uses AWS to deliver Fortnite to more than 200 million players around the world, support growth of more than 100 times in just 12 months, and perform analysis that helps it improve the game. Fortnite, one of the world's most popular video games, runs nearly entirely on AWS, including its worldwide game-server fleet, backend services, databases, websites, and analytics pipeline and processing systems.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Echoenergia
summary: Empresa atuando no setor de energia eólica no Brasil, a Echoenergia conta com a elasticidade da tecnologia AWS para gerenciar remotamente seu parque de geração, incluindo todo seu sistema de automação.

title: DXC Technology Case Study
summary: DXC Technology uses AWS to cut provisioning time from three months to one week, automate software patching, reduce costs by two-thirds, and ensure high availability and reliability. The organization provides IT solutions and services to thousands of enterprises across the globe.

title: Estudo de Caso AWS: Duratex
summary: De olho no mercado de Smart Homes, a Duratex encarou com a AWS o desafio tecnológico de desenvolver um dispositivo de IoT que transformasse produtos tradicionais de toda casa, como chuveiros e torneiras, em produtos inteligentes que pudessem ser monitorados e até mesmo controlados remotamente.

title: Directive Games Case Study
summary: Directive Games built a SaaS game development platform using AWS, meeting the need of game developers for a rapid development of cross-platform VR/AR games. Directive Games is a start-up focusing on the development of mobile VR/AR games and providing game development platforms and service support to other game developers.

title: Digital Relab Case Study
summary: Digital ReLab adapted its digital-asset-management platform to the cloud by taking advantage of flexible AWS storage options. Digital ReLab provides software solutions that let users find, update, and share vast quantities of digital assets seamlessly and affordably, anywhere, through a secure central database.

title: Cloud Migration Means Transformation at Deutsche Börse Group
summary: Deutsche Börse Group is an international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. Its exchange handles 150 million deals each month and the group manages assets worth 11 trillion Euros.In 2015, the company saw that it needed faster, more agile ways to develop software features and products. It restructured teams around products and, with help from Amazon Web Services (AWS), upskilled 700 people for the cloud within a year.The move to AWS has allowed developers to access previously unavailable resources so they can experiment with technologies like serverless computing and big data to develop better software. The group also benefits from the scale and transparency of AWS.In this video, Thomas Aidan Curran, innovation and technology advisor at Deutsche Börse Group, explains how the group transformed its organization and technology using AWS.

title: Deloitte Cuts Deployment Time by 99% Using AWS
summary: Deloitte uses AWS CloudFormation to embody infrastructure in code and AWS Service Catalog for automated deployment of the entire solution.

title: AWS Support - In Deliveroo's Words
summary: Amy Harms, Senior Engineering Manager at Deliveroo, shares how AWS Support helps Deliveroo grow quickly and effectively. Amy highlights the value that the Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers and also talks about Deliveroo’s use of the Trusted Advisor tool.

title: Estudo de Caso AWS: Dedalus
summary: Dedalus se beneficia com o uso do AWS Enterprise Support para atender seus clientes e auxiliá-los na transformação de seus negócios com o uso da tecnologia AWS. Com o apoio do time de especialistas AWS, a Dedalus consegue estar sempre à frente das novidades em serviços na nuvem.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: CVC
summary: A CVC, uma das maiores empresas de turismo da América Latina, utiliza a tecnologia da AWS para suas operações da data analytics. A empresa encara os desafios de integração entre o varejo físico e online, faz a gestão de riscos da operação, se concentra no aumento das vendas.

title: Custos Media Technology Case Study
summary: South Africa's Custos Media Technologies provides services that combat media piracy by tracing a leak to its source in a decentralised way using cryptocurrency. The company grew its business internationally using AWS's global infrastructure.

title: Custora Case Study

Custora is an advanced customer-segmentation platform built for retail, enabling marketing and CRM teams to easily create targeted customer lists to improve ROI for email, display ads, Facebook, and direct-mail campaigns.

title: Customer Snapshot: Weever Apps & Partner DevOps
summary: Using AWS, Weever Apps can focus on software development rather than infrastructure management, and AWS Partner Network partner base2Services adds another layer of support by handling upgrades, changes, and service health. Weever Apps creates enterprise-class software products to help customer initiate, execute, and complete work more efficiently.

title: Cornell University Case Study
summary: Cornell University adopted AWS Cloud solutions to achieve outcomes including increased in-class interactivity, eliminating the need for visits to the on-campus computer labs, and an improved experience for distance learners.

title: Communications Security Establishment
summary: The Communications Security Establishment (CSE) uses AWS to collaborate with the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity at the University of New Brunswick to generate and host new datasets, scale to simulate cyberattacks on 500 PCs, cut costs, and advance cybersecurity research worldwide. CSE is one of the Canadian government's leading security and intelligence organizations.

title: Club Automation Scales Its Growth and Enables Innovation with AWS Marketplace
summary: Club Automation drives new business growth, protects customer data, and provisions firewalls in 15 minutes instead of several hours by using Barracuda NextGen Firewalls from AWS Marketplace.

title: City of Iowa City Case Study
summary: Using AWS, the City of Iowa City, Iowa is able to predict and identify populations that would benefit from a pre-jail diversion program, better understand infrastructure costs and potential efficiencies, and use data to demonstrate improved outcomes. The City of Iowa City is located in eastern Iowa and has a population of about 75,000.

title: Cerner Case Study
summary: Cerner uses AWS and big data to gain actionable, real-time insights, simplifying healthcare delivery while reducing costs for payers, providers, and patients. Cerner, one of the leading suppliers of health information technology (HIT) solutions, chose AWS for its global reach and breadth of services, including machine learning and artificial intelligence.

title: Caso práctico de Cencosud
summary: Utilizando tecnología AWS, Cencosud buscó soluciones para un control de costos optimizado y alcanzar más agilidad en sus operaciones. Con esto, la empresa ha logrado desarrollar proyectos que permiten brindar un mejor servicio a sus clientes, disminuyendo incluso sus tiempos de compra.

title: Caso práctico de Carvajal Tecnología y Servicios
summary: Carvajal pasó por una compleja migración a AWS, pues contaba con varios servidores instalados desde 1998, 2000 y 2003, con muchas aplicaciones basadas en plataformas de software antiguas. Trabajando con el socio de negocios Avanxo, Carvajal utiliza la mayoría de los servicios de AWS.

title: Cargotec Shares Its Vision for the Future of Shipping

Its products deal with one-quarter of the world’s 700 million annual container movements and can be found on half of all ships listed with the International Maritime Organization.Today, the company’s focus lies in bringing data-driven solutions to market that help cargo carriers increase efficiency, transparency, and cooperation. The aim is to reduce the €17 billion a year loss that the industry suffers globally due to inefficiency, as well as the 90 million equivalent metric tons of CO2 wasted in moving empty containers.In this video, Soili Mäkinen, chief information officer and senior vice president, digitalization, at Cargotec, explains how the firm uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) to make sense of data, bringing a new level of intelligence to cargo handling.

title: Capital One Training Case Study
summary: By providing its employees with training about cloud technology and the ability to gain AWS certifications, Capital One is attracting and retaining top talent. Capital One is one of the largest banks in the United States and offers credit cards, checking and savings accounts, auto loans, rewards, and online banking services for consumers and businesses.

title: AWS Technology Enables Capital One's Move to Machine Learning
summary: Using AWS, Capital One turns data into insights through machine learning, allowing the company to innovate quickly on behalf of its customers.

title: Capital One Enterprise Case Study
summary: Using AWS, Capital One reduced its data-center footprint, expanded its use of microservices, and reimagined banking. Capital One is a leading information-based technology company that is on a mission to help its customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking.

title: Canadian Pharmacists Association Case Study
summary: The Canadian Pharmacists Association (CPhA) uses AWS to provide healthcare practitioners and patients with accurate information about medications. Services driving CPhA's digital transformation include Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon SES, and Elastic Load Balancing.

title: California Polytechnic State University Case Study
summary: California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly) is one of the top engineering schools in the nation, but the university was struggling with legacy technology that put data at risk. The university invested in cloud-based training for its IT staff and decided to go all in on the AWS Cloud, breaking free from a lift-and-shift mentality, and found success in adopting a people-first, technology-second strategy.

title: Caso práctico de Cachivaches
summary: En 2016, Cachivaches tuvo un tráfico de visitantes totalmente inesperado y su página llegó a estar inoperativa en una de las temporadas más importantes para la empresa. Esto los llevó a buscar soluciones en la nube, llegando hasta Amazon Web Services.

title: BYJU'S Case Study
summary: BYJU'S uses AWS to deliver interactive learning content to more than 15 million students, gain deeper data analytics, and create innovative new products. The company provides online learning through a website and mobile app, reaching more than 900,000 subscribers globally.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: BTG Pactual Digital
summary: O BTG Pactual iniciou sua jornada com a AWS com sua operação digital, o BTG Pactual Digital. A missão da organização era lançar um banco totalmente online.

title: Estudo de caso AWS: Boxnet
summary: A Boxnet é uma empresa de serviços de informação especializada em monitorar, coletar e organizar um enorme volume de informações veiculados na internet. Com o uso de AWS, a empresa observou um expressivo aumento em sua carteira de clientes.

title: BMW's Unified Configurator Platform
summary: At the AWS Summit Berlin 2018, BMW Group presented a deep dive into the journey from an on-premises, monolithic application to a microservices-based platform in the cloud.

title: Caso práctico de Bice Vida
summary: Con casi 30 años de operación en Chile, Bice Vida es una compañía de seguros y servicios financieros personales y empresariales caracterizada por ofrecer tecnología de punta a sus clientes. Para esto, desarrolla aplicaciones dirigidas a optimizar permanentemente el servicio y la atención a sus asegurados.

title: BBC Case Study
summary: By using Amazon EFS to share files, the BBC was able to build an agile and cost-effective solution, migrating its on-premises Red Button interactive TV service to the AWS Cloud.

title: Babylon Case Study
summary: Founded in 2013, Babylon is a subscription health service provider that enables users to have virtual consultations with doctors and health care professionals via text and video messaging through its mobile application. Using AWS, the company can innovate using artificial intelligence and scale globally.

title: AWS Case Study: The Washington Post Arc Publishing
summary: Arc Publishing (Arc) is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform built by the Washington Post that lets any media company take advantage of the scalable, flexible publishing platform The Washington Post built for its own newsroom. Arc is built as containerized microservices running on AWS. Docker containers and Amazon Elastic Container Service were critical in enabling the Washington Post to expand Arc into a multi-tenant architecture, scale rapidly, and increase the speed of development.

title: AWS Case Study - SETTour
summary: SETTour reduces its IT costs by 20 percent and cuts IT management expense in half by migrating to AWS. The company is a leading travel and tourism operator in Taiwan.

title: AWS Case Study: River Island
summary: Founded in 1948, River Island is a leading U.K. high street fashion brand with 300 stores and a thriving digital business. Using AWS allows the company to innovate at speed and scale its systems to handle major demand peaks on Black Friday.

title: AWS Case Study - FinFabrik
summary: Using AWS, FinFabrik can easily make changes and deploy new systems in just 10 minutes, ensuring data privacy and latency targets are met. The fintech uses Amazon Virtual Private Cloud to segregate client networks, Amazon Elastic Container Service to run serverless computing, and AWS Identity and Access Management for account authentication.

title: AWS Case Study: Fabric Genomic
summary: Fabric Genomics uses AWS to process whole genomes in minutes, help physicians diagnose diseases faster, and scale to support large genomic datasets. The company offers a computational genomics software platform that clinical labs use to rapidly and accurately process and analyze genomic data.

title: AWS Case Study - CyberLink
summary: CyberLink cuts development time for U Webinar in half by using AWS and cuts IT administration by 28 percent. CyberLink is a leading provider of multimedia software and a pioneer in video and audio technologies.

title: AWS Case Study: All Nippon Airways
summary: All Nippon Airways (ANA) is Japan's largest airline, operating domestic and international routes. Seeking a data-analysis platform with flexibility and extensibility, ANA decided to migrate its data warehouse to AWS.

title: Avazu Case Study
summary: Avazu used AWS to dramatically improve system stability and scalability to meet the advertising platform's processing needs of more than 20 billion impressions per day and more than 1 million queries per second (QPS). Avazu, a subsidiary of the DotC United Group, is a technology-driven company that engages in performance marketing through programmatic advertising technologies.

title: Autodesk WorkSpaces Case Study
summary: Using AWS, Autodesk is able to set up and deploy 450 workstations at its Autodesk University events, saving nearly a week's worth of time and thousands of dollars. Autodesk develops software for the engineering, design, and entertainment industries.

title: Autodesk Log Analytics Case Study
summary: Autodesk uses AWS to detect and fix application problems faster, improve log file analytics, and create an enterprise unified log data solution with a small IT team. The company creates software used by organizations in the architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, media, and entertainment industries.

title: Atresmedia Case Study
summary: By using AWS, Atresmedia has created two new platforms that have grown its digital user base by 25 times to 5 million. The global media group caters to an international audience of 73 million people and already operates six TV channels and four radio stations.

title: Astro Technology Case Study
summary: By using AWS deep-learning technologies, Astro took only six weeks to develop and deploy Astrobot Voice, the enterprise-grade voice email assistant that ships with its Astro email app. The company enables workplace teams to focus on what's important by using machine learning to make their communications more effective and less time-consuming.

title: Askey Case Study
summary: By using AWS, Askey Computer Corporation is ensuring that the growing number of travelers using Taipei Main Station, a railway station and major transportation hub in Taiwan, can move around easily and safely. Askey builds cutting-edge IT solutions that can support smart projects in major cities worldwide.

title: Arizona State University
summary: Using AWS, Arizona State University (ASU) is enhancing student life and driving deep learner engagement. ASU is committed to bringing cutting-edge technology and innovation to those on campus and in the greater Phoenix community.

title: Amazon Items and Offers Case Study
summary: Amazon migrated its Item Master Service from Oracle to Amazon DynamoDB to improve availability and scalability, reduce operational burden, and improve utilization. Amazon used AWS Database Migration Service to migrate 150 TB of data in just two months with zero downtime, and now relies on Amazon DynamoDB to process more than five billion catalog updates every day without significant manual effort.

title: Amazon Advertising Case Study
summary: Amazon Advertising Engineering and Development (AED) increased throughput and avoided a three-year project to rebuild performance monitors and management tools by shifting data held in Oracle databases to Amazon RDS. AED builds, manages, and scales the technologies that undergird Amazon's programmatic advertising offerings.

title: Alpha Vertex Case Study
summary: Alpha Vertex achieved the multi-gigabyte throughput crucial to its central line of business by using Amazon EFS. Alpha Vertex uses artificial-intelligence tools to build a model of the global financial system so it can provide investors with returns predictions, research assistance, and automated monitoring and analysis of worldwide financial media.

title: Airbnb su AWS
summary: Fondato nel 2008, Airbnb è un marketplace condiviso con sede a San Francisco che offre alla clientela oltre 7 milioni di alloggi e più di 40.000 di esperienze prenotabili sul sito web della compagnia o tramite le applicazioni iOS e Android corrispondenti.

title: Airbnb on AWS
summary: A year after Airbnb launched, the company decided to migrate nearly all of its cloud computing functions to AWS. As the company has grown, it has adopted almost all of the features AWS provides.

title: Aerobotics Tackles Tree Pests with Machine Learning
summary: Aerobotics was founded in Cape Town, South Africa, in 2014 to help tree-crop farmers solve their pest and disease problems. The company uses machine learning to analyze imagery from drone and satellite photography, allowing farmers to understand the condition of individual trees. Monitoring every tree for pests and diseases on a 50-hectare farm would previously take a farmer an entire day. Aerobotics has reduced this to 20 minutes with drone technology. In this video, Aerobotics Chief Executive Officer James Paterson explains why the firm chose Amazon Web Services (AWS). Built on the AWS Cloud, its product can process large amounts of data and still work reliably for thousands of farmers in remote rural areas. The company runs an auto-scaling microservices architecture with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and serves data to customers using Amazon CloudFront. Its continuous integration and deployment pipelines allow software developers and data scientists to work independently in containerized environments.

title: Aella Credit Case Study
